孔庙大成门

No.134
Gate of Great Achievement in Temple of Confucius
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：莆田市涵江区1路至国货商场站
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构遗址唐敬宗宝历二年孔仲良任莆田令南宋淳祐五年创建孔庙明成化元年正学门
中文 Chinese

据说唐敬宗宝历二年（826年），孔子的第41代嫡孙孔仲良由青阳丞升任莆田令，从此子孙世居莆田涵江璜山，就是今天的紫璜山。到了南宋，淳祐五年（1245年）创建孔庙。

史书中还曾明确提到过明成化元年（1465年）兴化知府岳正建正学门，也就是今天唯一保留下来的孔庙建筑。按照孔庙的基本规制，牌楼、半月形的泮池是大成殿等中轴线上的建筑是必不可少的，架在泮池上的小桥则是石工表现手艺的好舞台。

涵江孔庙的泮池和壁水桥得以保留，再前行，泮池前甬道两边有碑廊，集宋、明、清历代碑碣；甬道尽头有四十九级台阶，条石砌成，上到台阶尽头，空地上就是原大成殿遗址。

今天最主要的建筑遗存正学门是一座面阔三间，进深两间，单檐歇山顶的门座，三间面阔上立柱不同高，划分成三段，屋顶也分成三段，每段都是翼角飞扬之势，为典型的地方做法，连莆田现代的高速公路收费站大门都会模仿这个样式。

正学门孤零零地立在居民住宅楼和平房中间，居民则闲坐在正学门的中间，里外里全是一幅人民当家做主的画面。

English

It is said that in 826 (the second year of Baoli reign, Emperor Jingzong of Tang), Kong Zhongliang, the 41st-generation direct descendant of Confucius, was promoted from Qingyang Magistrate to Putian Magistrate; from then on his descendants lived in Huangshan, Hanjiang, Putian — today's Zihuang Mountain.

By the Southern Song, in 1245 (the fifth year of Chunyou reign), a Confucian Temple was founded.

Historical records also explicitly mention that in 1465 (the first year of Chenghua reign, Ming), Xinghua Prefect Yue Zheng built the Zhengxue Gate, which is today the only remaining Confucian Temple building.

According to the basic regulations of a Confucian Temple, the paifang and the crescent-shaped Pan Pond are indispensable buildings on the central axis along with the Dacheng Hall; the small bridge spanning the Pan Pond is a good stage for stone masons to show their craftsmanship.

The Pan Pond and Bishui Bridge of Hanjiang Confucian Temple have been preserved; going further, on both sides of the passage in front of the Pan Pond there are stele corridors, collecting steles from the Song, Ming, and Qing dynasties; at the end of the passage there are forty-nine stone steps built of dressed stone; at the top of the steps, the open ground is the site of the original Dacheng Hall.

Today's main surviving building, Zhengxue Gate, is a gate structure three bays wide and two deep, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof; the columns on the three-bay facade are of different heights, dividing it into three sections, and the roof is also divided into three sections, each with soaring wing corners — a typical local method, even modern Putian highway toll station gates imitate this style.

Zhengxue Gate stands alone among residential apartment buildings and bungalows, while residents sit idly in the middle of Zhengxue Gate — inside and out, it is entirely a picture of the people being masters of the country.

推荐级别：★★

巩溪宫

No.135
Gongxi Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：莆田市涵江区新县镇广宫村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构宋建炎四年黄彻创建供奉妈祖明清代重修咸丰三年前殿洪水损
中文 Chinese

巩溪宫是因地得名的，宫中供奉的是妈祖。宫为宋邑人黄彻于宋建炎四年（1130年）所创建，成于宋绍兴年间（1131—1162年）。

明代宫庙得到重修；清乾隆年间再次重修；清咸丰三年（1853年）前殿为洪水所损，旋修复。

还有一件憾事也是幸事，大殿脊檩上原有的绍兴年号也一直得以保留，20世纪80年代重新粉刷时被覆盖，我们或者还有机会利用科技手段揭露历史，并再次向人们进行展示。宫坐西南朝东北，非常紧凑，中轴线上依次为砖埕、前殿、天井、正殿。

前埕尺度不大，三面围墙，两翼抹角，并与左右抹角处各开一门，地铺方砖，有许多凤凰、奔马、花卉、扇面等图形的砖刻穿插其间。前殿和正殿均面阔五间，抬梁式结构，单檐歇山顶。二殿间距紧凑，只留狭小天井。

从前殿望去，晦明变化，幽深之感顿生。细观殿内屋架则与常见莆仙民居不同。一是刹牵弯曲，装饰感甚强，且入襻间斗拱，相互衔接，配合紧密；二是殿内保留梭形瓜楞石柱16根，以及覆盆莲花瓣式柱础，为晚期建筑中不见。

English

Gongxi Temple is named after its location, and enshrines Mazu inside.

The temple was founded by Huang Che, a local of the Song, in 1130 (the fourth year of Jianyan reign, Song), and completed during the Shaoxing reign (1131–1162).

In the Ming the temple was restored; in the Qing Qianlong reign it was restored again; in 1853 (the third year of Xianfeng reign, Qing), the front hall was damaged by floods and was soon repaired.

There is also a matter that is both a pity and a blessing: the original Shaoxing reign year on the main hall's ridge purlin has always been preserved, but was covered during repainting in the 1980s; we may still have the opportunity to use technological means to reveal history and display it to people again.

The temple faces northeast from the southwest, very compact, with brick courtyard, front hall, skylight, and main hall依次 on the central axis.

The front courtyard is not large in scale, with walls on three sides, chamfered corners on both wings, and a gate at each of the left and right chamfered corners; the ground is paved with square bricks, with many brick carvings of phoenixes, galloping horses, flowers, and fan shapes interspersed.

Both the front hall and main hall are five bays wide, with beam-lifting structure and single-eave hip-and-gable roof.

The distance between the two halls is compact, leaving only a narrow skylight.Looking from the front hall, with changes of light and shadow, a sense of depth immediately arises.

Examining the roof frame inside the hall carefully, it differs from common Puxian residences.

First, the shaqian (tie beam) is curved, with strong decorative sense, and enters the panjian bracket sets, interconnecting and fitting tightly; second, the hall retains 16 spindle-shaped melon-ridged stone columns and inverted-basin lotus-petal column bases, which are not seen in late-period architecture.

推荐级别：★★★

宁海桥

No.136
Ninghai Bridge
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：元—清
地址：涵江区白塘镇镇前村或莆田县黄石镇桥兜村
类型：桥梁
特征标签 Highlights
古石桥遗迹跨度与结构形式元元统二年龟山寺僧越浦募捐建架在海上的石梁桥通长225.7米宽5.8米14墩分水15门
中文 Chinese

开车出了工地林立的莆田市，向木兰溪入海口进发，大约半个小时，就能看到鼎鼎大名的宁海桥。大桥位于涵江区镇前村与莆田县黄石镇桥兜村之间，是真正架在海上的石梁桥，在国内也没有几座。有些遗憾的是古桥实际上是藏在新桥桥面下边的。

那是1983年的工程，虽是无奈之举，也不知机动车的振动对老结构有多大影响，所幸桥墩、石梁、望柱等构件保存完整，或许也是一条保留古桥的新思路。元元统二年（1334年），龟山寺僧越浦始募捐建桥，历十数年落成。既然是桥梁，日日使用，后代修缮也是必然之举。

大桥南北走向，通长225.7米，宽5.8米，以巨大石梁架设桥面，架桥条石上刻有捐施者的姓名和捐资数额。桥共有14墩，分水15门，墩为两头尖的船形，墩上砌三层悬臂，以减少石梁跨度。桥面两旁设石扶栏，望柱上雕刻石狮。

桥两端各设有两尊高约3米、戴盔披甲执长剑的护桥将军石像，其中桥北两尊为明代原物。远远望去，桥北岸有吉祥寺，桥南端有观音楼。吉祥寺是当年越浦和尚筹资营建宁海桥的落脚处。斗转星移，只不知当年的海水是不是比今天的清澈些呢？和尚化缘的技巧是不是比今天的笨拙些呢？

English

Driving out of Putian City with its forest of construction sites, heading toward the estuary of the Mulan River, in about half an hour one can see the famous Ninghai Bridge.

The bridge is located between Zhenqian Village in Hanjiang District and Qiaodou Village in Huangshi Town, Putian County — a stone beam bridge truly spanning the sea, of which there are few in the country.

It is somewhat regrettable that the ancient bridge is actually hidden beneath the deck of a new bridge.

That was a 1983 project; though a last resort, and it is unknown how much the vibration of motor vehicles affects the old structure, fortunately components such as piers, stone beams, and baluster posts are well preserved — perhaps this is also a new approach to preserving ancient bridges.

In 1334 (the second year of Yuantong reign, Yuan), Monk Yuepu of Guishan Temple began fundraising to build the bridge, which took over ten years to complete.

Since it is a bridge used daily, restoration by later generations was inevitable.The bridge runs north-south, with a total length of 225.7 meters and width of 5.

8 meters, with the deck laid with giant stone beams; the stone beams for the bridge are engraved with the names and donation amounts of donors.

The bridge has 14 piers and 15 water openings; the piers are boat-shaped with pointed ends, and three layers of cantilevers are built on the piers to reduce the span of the stone beams.

Stone railings are set on both sides of the deck, with stone lions carved on the baluster posts.

At each end of the bridge there are two stone statues of bridge-protecting generals about 3 meters high, wearing helmets and armor and holding long swords; the two on the north side of the bridge are original Ming works.

From afar, on the north bank of the bridge there is Jixiang Temple, and at the south end there is Guanyin Tower.

Jixiang Temple was the place where Monk Yuepu stayed when raising funds to build Ninghai Bridge.As time passes, I only wonder whether the seawater of that day was clearer than today's?

And whether the monk's alms-begging skills were clumsier than today's?

推荐级别：★★★

黄石文庙

No.137
Temple of Confucius in Huangshi
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：莆田市莆田县黄石镇水南村
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构遗址唐创建红泉宫明代改为文庙清康熙二十四年重建
中文 Chinese

古时地方官学和文庙往往在一起，民国以来用文庙来作公立学校也是常有的做法。仿佛只要老夫子还有一口气在，乱世乱掉的教育就总还有救。可叹拿"旧道德"管束族人的乡绅们被斩草除根了，摩登的教育基本把孔夫子的游丝之气扼断了，即便成立了再多的孔子学院，也很少有人真心相信孔子的学说。时代或者真的进步了？

黄石文庙就在黄石镇中心小学内，部分建筑用作校舍。史料记载，此庙创建于唐，称红泉宫，明代改为文庙，今存建筑为清康熙二十四年（1685年）重建。

文庙坐东北朝西南，现存建筑包括大成殿、廊庑、泮池、下马碑等。大成殿是最重要的建筑，重檐歇山顶，面阔五间，前檐明间开间宽阔，明间左右缝的廊柱还浮雕盘龙，是孔庙大成殿常有的做法。

上层檐正脊和檐口两端都有非常明显的起翘，如翚斯飞；下层檐要舒缓很多，翼角还是南方典型的做法；檐下斗拱只在柱头，石柱间并无过多枋木连缀。不想再重复看到其他文庙时候的感慨了，只是因为它们还在，觉得自己几十年来念书积淀下的情感牵挂也还在。

English

In ancient times, local government schools and Confucian temples were often together; since the Republic of China, using Confucian temples as public schools has also been a common practice.

As if as long as the Old Master still had a breath left, the education disrupted in troubled times would always have hope.

It is lamentable that the local gentry who used "old morality" to discipline their clans were eradicated root and branch, and modern education has basically cut off Confucius's gossamer-thin influence; even if more Confucius Institutes are established, few people truly believe in Confucius's teachings.

Has the era truly progressed?Huangshi Confucian Temple is inside Huangshi Town Central Primary School, with some buildings used as schoolhouses.

Historical records show that this temple was founded in the Tang, called Hongquan Palace, and converted to a Confucian temple in the Ming; the existing buildings were rebuilt in 1685 (the 24th year of Kangxi reign, Qing).

The Confucian temple faces southwest from the northeast; the existing buildings include the Dacheng Hall, side corridors, Pan Pond, and Dismount-from-Horse Stele.

The Dacheng Hall is the most important building, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide; the central bay of the front eave is wide, and the corridor columns on the left and right sides of the central bay also have coiled dragons in relief — a common practice in Confucian temple Dacheng Halls.

Both the main ridge and the ends of the eave of the upper eave have very obvious upward curves, "like a pheasant in flight"; the lower eave is much more gentle, and the wing corners are still a typical southern method; the bracket sets under the eaves are only at the column tops, with no excessive timber lintels connecting between the stone columns.

I don't want to repeat the lament I had when seeing other Confucian temples; it is just because they are still there, I feel that the emotional attachment I have accumulated from decades of studying is still there.

推荐级别：★★

湄洲妈祖庙

No.138
Mazu Temple of Meizhou
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋—清—近代
地址：莆田市湄洲镇湄洲岛宫下村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局早期石作遗迹晚期木结构妈祖信仰祖庙宋初灵惠夫人明永乐初郑和奉旨建正殿
中文 Chinese

信仰之于出生入死的人，那就是能够出生入死的理由；妈祖信仰之于出海的渔民和岸上翘首以盼的家人，那就是相互眺望的寄托。湄洲妈祖庙被列为"国保"，在某种程度上是对活着的妈祖信仰的尊重。

要拜谒湄洲妈祖庙，要先从文甲码头乘轮渡到湄洲岛。20分钟的旅途仿佛是远行的前奏，心绪早已不在是不是要看古建筑上了。今天妈祖庙留下来的建筑事实上经过了"文革"的严重破坏和1978年的大规模重修。

追溯始建历史，则一直到宋朝，起初庙宇供奉的或许不是妈祖，还是《潜说友临安志》里提到的"灵惠夫人"。渔民代代繁衍，重修历代不辍，至清乾隆后，得以基本定型为今天的妈祖庙制度——以正殿为主体，尚存正殿、寝殿、圣父母祠三座院落。

正殿系明永乐初（1403年）郑和奉旨建造，原本是朝天阁，清康熙二十二年（1683年）重修并改为正殿。

重檐歇山顶，面阔三间、进深三间，抬梁式结构，前檐廊下有一对透雕龙柱。

寝殿最早由明洪武七年（1374年）重建于北宋妈祖纪念祠旧址上，明、清及民国年间均有重修。

由门殿、主殿和两庑组成，今尚存古老的天井地面。

圣父母祠始建于宋初，现存的是清初重修的结果，正堂面阔三间、进深一间，悬山顶穿斗式木构架，专家称天井也是宋代的遗迹。

English

For people who risk life and death, faith is the reason they can risk life and death; for fishermen who go to sea and their families waiting anxiously on shore, Mazu faith is the sustenance of mutual gazing.

Meizhou Mazu Temple being listed as a "National Key Cultural Heritage Site" is, to some extent, respect for the living Mazu faith.

To visit Meizhou Mazu Temple, one must first take a ferry from Wenjia Wharf to Meizhou Island.

The 20-minute journey seems like a prelude to a long journey, and one's mind is no longer on whether to see ancient architecture.

The buildings remaining at Mazu Temple today have in fact undergone severe destruction during the Cultural Revolution and large-scale restoration in 1978.

Tracing back the founding history, it goes all the way to the Song Dynasty; initially the temple may not have enshrined Mazu, but rather the "Lady Linghui" mentioned in Qian Shuoyou's "Lin'an Annals.

" As fishermen multiplied generation after generation, restorations continued through successive dynasties; after the Qing Qianlong reign, it was basically finalized as today's Mazu Temple system — with the main hall as the主体, three courtyards still surviving: the main hall, the sleeping hall, and the Holy Parents Shrine.

The main hall was built by Zheng He by imperial order in the early Yongle reign of the Ming (1403), originally as Chaotian Pavilion; in 1683 (the 22nd year of Kangxi reign, Qing), it was restored and converted to the main hall.

It has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, three bays wide and three deep, with beam-lifting structure, and a pair of openwork-carved dragon columns under the front eave corridor.

The sleeping hall was first rebuilt in 1374 (the seventh year of Hongwu reign, Ming) on the old site of the Northern Song Mazu Memorial Shrine, with restorations in the Ming, Qing, and Republican periods.

It consists of a gate hall, main hall, and two side wings; the ancient skylight ground still survives today.

The Holy Parents Shrine was first built in the early Song; what exists now is the result of early Qing restoration, with the main hall three bays wide and one deep, with an overhanging gable roof and column-and-tie timber frame; experts say the skylight is also a Song Dynasty relic.

推荐级别：★★

平海天后宫

No.139
Temple of the Queen of Heaven in Pinghai
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田市秀屿区平海镇平海村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局早期石作遗迹晚期木结构北宋咸平二年始建清康熙二十二年施琅奏请重建百柱宫108根杉木柱
中文 Chinese

不管是天后，还是天妃，还是妈祖，都是在海上法力无边的。《元史》上说："南海女神灵惠夫人……护海运有奇应，加封天妃神号……"官方自有官方的角度和口气。平海天后宫的历史则与另一位历史名人有关——施琅。

清康熙二十二年（1683年），清政府收复台湾。为了抚恤沿海民众，施琅奏请朝廷重建此宫。至于此宫始建于北宋咸平二年（999年）的痕迹，则只有寻找石构件中的蛛丝马迹了。

此宫的布局是很隆重的，沿中轴线依次有照壁、外大埕、师泉井、山门、内埕及东西廊、瞻拜亭前祭台、瞻拜亭、正殿等。据说全宫加在一起用了108根杉木柱，所以又俗称"百柱宫"。外埕上山门外有一口师泉井，是施琅踏破铁鞋终在眼下觅得的水源，满潮时，此淡水井距大海不过一百来米。

此处《师泉井记》和《平海天后宫重修碑记》记载了此宫的来龙去脉，是重要史料证据。天后宫的正殿面阔五间，进深五间，采用重檐歇山顶，为抬梁、穿斗混合木构。

至于近年来重修的屋面和彩绘，应当是国家级的专家监管下的产物。到底新的有什么工艺上的超凡之处，能否向我们介绍一下？或者是保留上下一代沧桑的做法有什么技术上的困难？还是之前的做法过于简单破败，与大庙的身份不相称？抑或是民情激昂，非要一身新装和油彩来掩盖皱纹和老年斑？

English

Whether called the Queen of Heaven, the Heavenly Consort, or Mazu, all are boundlessly powerful at sea.

The "History of Yuan" says: "The South Sea Goddess Lady Linghui...had miraculous responses in protecting sea transport, and was conferred the title of Heavenly Consort...

" Officials have their own perspectives and tone.The history of Pinghai Tianhou Palace is related to another historical figure — Shi Lang.

In 1683 (the 22nd year of Kangxi reign, Qing), the Qing government recovered Taiwan.

To console the coastal people, Shi Lang petitioned the court to rebuild this palace.

As for traces of its original founding in 999 (the second year of Xianping reign, Northern Song), one can only search for clues in the stone components.

The layout of this palace is very grand; along the central axis there are依次 the screen wall, outer great courtyard, Shiquan Well, mountain gate, inner courtyard and east-west corridors, sacrificial platform in front of the worship pavilion, worship pavilion, and main hall.

It is said that the entire palace together used 108 fir columns, hence it is also commonly called the "Hundred-Column Palace.

" Outside the mountain gate in the outer courtyard there is a Shiquan Well, the water source that Shi Lang finally found after searching everywhere; at high tide, this freshwater well is only about a hundred meters from the sea.

The "Record of Shiquan Well" and "Stele Record of the Restoration of Pinghai Tianhou Palace" here record the history of this palace and are important historical evidence.

The main hall of Tianhou Palace is five bays wide and five deep, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, using a mixed beam-lifting and column-and-tie timber structure.

As for the roof and paintings restored in recent years, they should be products under the supervision of national-level experts.

What extraordinary craftsmanship does the new version have, could you introduce it to us?Or is there some technical difficulty in preserving the weathered appearance of the previous generation?

Or was the previous method too simple and dilapidated, incompatible with the status of a great temple?

Or is it that public sentiment is so passionate that it insists on a new outfit and paint to cover wrinkles and age spots?

推荐级别：★★

莆禧城墙

No.140
City Wall of Puxi
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田市莆田县山亭乡莆禧村西南
类型：城市设施·城墙
特征标签 Highlights
城市格局气氛忠门半岛南端湄洲岛隔海相望防御海上倭寇福建明代三大抗倭古城之一明洪武二十年建成
中文 Chinese

位于忠门半岛南端与湄洲岛隔海相望的，用来保护渔民一家老小的，有一座莆禧古城。从地利的角度来看，古城不是防御来自陆地上的进攻，而是防御来自海上的威胁。不错，敌人会乘船而来，敌人是倭寇。与惠安崇武古城、霞浦大京城齐名，莆禧古城为福建省现存明代三大抗倭古城之一。

从明洪武二十年（1387年）起，城墙就已经建成，到了嘉靖年间，这里成为戚继光的军队与倭寇作战的重要据点，并曾在此取得过战...

English

Located at the southern tip of the Zhongmen Peninsula, facing Meizhou Island across the sea, there is an ancient Puxi city built to protect fishermen and their families.

From a geographical advantage perspective, the ancient city was not defending against attacks from land, but against threats from the sea.

Indeed, the enemy would come by boat — the enemy was the Japanese pirates (wokou).

Ranking alongside the ancient Chongwu city in Hui'an and Dajing city in Xiapu, the ancient Puxi city is one of the three surviving Ming Dynasty anti-Japanese-pirate ancient cities in Fujian Province.

From 1387 (the 20th year of Hongwu reign, Ming), the city wall had already been built; by the Jiajing reign, this place became an important stronghold for Qi Jiguang's army fighting the Japanese pirates, and battles were won here.

..

贤良港天后祖祠

No.141
Ancestral Hall of the Queen of Heaven in Xianliang Port
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田市山亭乡港里村东北500米
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局早期石作遗迹晚期木结构妈祖出生地林默螺港生人宋雍熙四年升仙羽化
中文 Chinese

到了文甲不去码头，搭一辆摩托车，就能去看看贤良港的天后祖祠。唤作"祖祠"，是因为人们说这里是海上女神妈祖的出生地。妈祖的本名叫作林默，是螺港生人，螺港就是贤良港的古称。潜说友《临安志》里说，林默的父亲是五代闽王统军兵马使林愿，她排行第六，能乘席渡海，云游岛屿，人呼龙女。

到了宋雍熙四年（987年），妈祖"升仙羽化"了。尔后，乡人开始修祠祭祀。今天的祖祠建于明初，新成的北京太和殿遭雷劈的那年，永乐十九年（1421年）祠毁。清康熙二十三年（1684年）重建。

近年又有修葺扩建。于是我们看到的是牌坊、山门、拜亭、正殿、父母祠等一串建筑，以及祠内的梁启超等名人撰写的楹联，还有重修碑记、历朝褒封徽号碑刻和"奉旨春秋谕祭"木牌等珍贵文物资料。

English

Arriving at Wenjia without going to the wharf, taking a motorcycle, one can go see the Tianhou Ancestral Hall at Xianliang Port.

It is called "Ancestral Hall" because people say this is the birthplace of the sea goddess Mazu.

Mazu's original name was Lin Mo, born in Luogang — Luogang is the ancient name of Xianliang Port.

Qian Shuoyou's "Lin'an Annals" says that Lin Mo's father was Lin Yuan, the military commander of the Min King in the Five Dynasties; she was the sixth child, could cross the sea riding a mat, wander among islands, and was called the Dragon Maiden.

In 987 (the fourth year of Yongxi reign, Song), Mazu "ascended as an immortal." Thereafter, villagers began to build a shrine for worship.

Today's ancestral hall was built in the early Ming; in the year the newly completed Beijing Hall of Supreme Harmony was struck by lightning — 1421 (the 19th year of Yongle reign) — the shrine was destroyed.

It was rebuilt in 1684 (the 23rd year of Kangxi reign, Qing).In recent years it has again been repaired and expanded.

Thus what we see is a string of buildings including the paifang, mountain gate, worship pavilion, main hall, and Parents' Shrine, as well as couplets written by famous people such as Liang Qichao inside the hall, and precious cultural relics such as restoration stele records, stele carvings of imperial honorary titles through successive dynasties, and the wooden plaque of "Imperially Ordered Spring and Autumn Sacrificial Offerings.

"

推荐级别：★★

永兴岩寺

No.142
Yongxing Stone Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：元
地址：莆田市莆田县大洋乡院埔村东北500米
类型：宗教建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局石作仿木作遗迹瑞云山丹崖峭壁刘克庄董其昌邓石如书法石窟寺依天然石穴而造三个并排连拱券顶门洞
中文 Chinese

瑞云山永兴岩景区，是绿色渲染的丹崖峭壁。我们今天看到的景色曾经迷住了南朝大词人刘克庄、明朝的名臣大书法家董其昌、清朝陕甘总督荣英昌、清代大书法家邓石如等。巨石之上，满是绝妙的书法，说的是大山对自己的矜夸。永兴岩石窟寺建在壁立千仞的绝壁之下，依天然石穴而造，远远望去，是山水画中不可少的一笔。

洞坐南朝北，建造也是紧贴岩壁，用规整的条石砌成三个并排大小不一的连拱券顶门洞，划分为三间，面积420平方米，门券中各筑一殿，从左到右依次为永兴祖殿、观音殿、五海龙王殿。三殿之间有壁门相通。柱、梁、枋、斗拱等构件均为花岗石。

石柱大多呈梭形，下端有明显的卷杀，覆盆式莲花柱础，柱高4米。柱头铺作一斗三升式，斗有欹，斗底有皿板痕迹。补间铺作一朵，石梁两端多有卷杀。

寺内尚存宋、元石刻对联，元、明、清重修碑刻，多尊及元代石雕神像。

寺是宋绍兴年间（1131—1162年）始建的，在元贞三年（1297年）重建，至正二年（1342年）又重修，到了清代才筑外墙加以保护，成了我们看到的立面效果。

所以说殿内仿木石构是原汁原味的元朝手法。

English

The Yongxing Rock scenic area of Ruiyun Mountain is a red cliff precipice rendered in green.

The scenery we see today once fascinated the great Southern Song ci poet Liu Kezhuang, the Ming dynasty famous official and great calligrapher Dong Qichang, the Qing dynasty Shaan-Gan Governor Rong Yingchang, and the Qing dynasty great calligrapher Deng Shiru, among others.

On the giant rocks, there is exquisite calligraphy everywhere, speaking of the mountain's own boastfulness.

Yongxing Rock Cave Temple was built beneath a thousand-ren precipice, constructed according to a natural stone cave; from afar, it is an indispensable stroke in a landscape painting.

The cave faces north from the south, and its construction also clings tightly to the rock wall, using neatly dressed stone blocks to build three side-by-side connected arch-vaulted doorways of varying sizes, divided into three bays with an area of 420 square meters; each doorway contains a hall, from left to right依次 the Yongxing Ancestral Hall, Guanyin Hall, and Five-Sea Dragon King Hall.

The three halls are connected by wall doors.Components such as columns, beams, lintels, and bracket sets are all granite.

Most stone columns are spindle-shaped, with obvious entasis (juansha) at the lower ends, and inverted-basin lotus column bases, with columns 4 meters high.

The column-top bracket sets are of the one-bracket-three-arm (yidou sansheng) type, with the bracket block having a sloped side and traces of a base plate at the bottom.

There is one intermediate bracket set per bay, and both ends of the stone beams mostly have entasis.

The temple still preserves Song and Yuan stone-carved couplets, Yuan, Ming, and Qing restoration stele carvings, and multiple Yuan Dynasty stone-carved deity statues.

The temple was first built during the Shaoxing reign of the Song (1131–1162), rebuilt in 1297 (the third year of Yuanzhen reign, Yuan), and restored again in 1342 (the second year of Zhizheng reign); only in the Qing was an outer wall built for protection, resulting in the facade effect we see.

Therefore, the imitation-timber stone structure inside the halls is authentic Yuan Dynasty technique.

推荐级别：★★★★

镇海堤

No.143
Zhenhai Dam
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田县黄石镇木兰溪下游
类型：海防堤坝设施
特征标签 Highlights
古堤坝凭吊原名东甲堤唐元和元年闽浙观察使裴次元创建3.4公里福建省第一大堤明洪武年间石堤被拆
中文 Chinese

镇海堤，原名东甲堤，在木兰溪下游两岸。最早在唐元和元年（806年）由闽浙观察使裴次元创建。当时的做法是加建石堤。

在莆田南洋围垦东北角，有最易被风潮冲毁的土堤需要加固，这一做就是3.4公里，自黄石镇东甲村至遮浪村，至今仍是福建省第一大堤。后来经过历代兴废，明洪武年间石堤被拆，此后仅余土堤，屡修屡毁，清雍正、道光年间两次重修石堤。

解放后，1952年整修，1961年加高。今天到镇海堤，与其说是做什么学术观察，不如说是纯粹的放松。堤坝远处泥泞难行，索性站在石条铺就的堤面上感受人工的渺小和伟大。天边积云滚滚，存在是最大的生计。忘却了本来的计划，周边还有坐落在赤屿的明代镇海塔和朱慧虚先生墓。

English

Zhenhai Dam, originally named Dongjia Dam, is on both banks of the lower reaches of the Mulan River.

It was first built in 806 (the first year of Yuanhe reign, Tang) by Pei Ciyuan, the Surveillance Commissioner of Fujian and Zhejiang.

The method at that time was to add a stone dam.

At the northeast corner of the Putian Nanyang reclamation area, there was an earthen dam most easily destroyed by wind and tide that needed reinforcement; this work stretched 3.

4 kilometers, from Dongjia Village to Zhelang Village in Huangshi Town, and it remains the largest dam in Fujian Province to this day.

Later, through the rise and fall of successive dynasties, the stone dam was dismantled during the Hongwu reign of the Ming; thereafter only the earthen dam remained, repeatedly repaired and repeatedly destroyed; during the Yongzheng and Daoguang reigns of the Qing, the stone dam was restored twice.

After liberation, it was renovated in 1952 and raised in 1961.Visiting Zhenhai Dam today is less an academic observation than pure relaxation.

The far end of the dam is muddy and difficult to walk on, so one might as well stand on the dam surface paved with stone strips to feel the smallness and greatness of human effort.

Clouds roll at the horizon, and existence is the greatest livelihood.Forgetting the original plan, nearby there are also the Ming Dynasty Zhenhai Tower and the tomb of Mr.

Zhu Huixu located on Chiyu.

推荐级别：★★

东门石坊

No.144
Dongmen Stone Archway
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：莆田市仙游县城东镇东门村东150米
类型：民居·礼制建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石仿木结构石雕装饰清代石牌坊高16米宽8米三开间重檐三滴水浮雕圆雕透雕
中文 Chinese

东门石坊是清代的石牌坊。石构仿木，高16米，宽8米，三开间，重檐三滴水。遍饰人物、瑞兽等，雕刻手法包括浮雕、圆雕、透雕，雕工细腻，是福建地方石雕艺术之典型代表。

雕刻玲珑，棱角平直，却少了岁月的痕迹。牌坊上书"乐善好施"四字，其下有铭文牌："诰赠奉直大夫候选州同陈天高遗命子 诰授奉直大夫候选州同加二级涵辉捐助金石书院经费事特旨扁奖赐帑金建坊"，年代是"道光五年（1825年）桂月毂旦"。用语远不古奥，也没有值得回味之处，但所做却是实实在在的教育事业。

English

Dongmen Stone Archway is a Qing Dynasty stone paifang.

Stone structure imitating timber, 16 meters high and 8 meters wide, with three bays and double eaves with three water-drips.

It is decorated throughout with figures and auspicious beasts, with carving techniques including relief, round carving, and openwork carving; the carving is exquisite and is a typical representative of Fujian local stone carving art.

The carving is delicate with straight edges and corners, but lacks the traces of time.

The archway bears the four characters "Leshang Haoshi" (Delighting in Goodness and Being Generous), below which there is an inscription plaque: "By imperial decree, posthumously granted Fengzhi Dafu and candidate Zhou Tong Chen Tiangao's dying command to his son; by imperial decree, granted Fengzhi Dafu and candidate Zhou Tong plus second rank Han Hui donated funds for the Jinshi Academy; by special imperial decree, awarded a plaque and granted treasury gold to build the archway," dated "An auspicious day in the eighth month of the fifth year of Daoguang (1825).

" The language is far from archaic and has nothing worth savoring, but what was done was a tangible educational endeavor.

推荐级别：★★★

龙华双塔

No.145
Double Pagodas in Longhua
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：莆田市仙游县龙华镇灯塔村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石塔形制比例尺度风景环境北宋大观政和年间郭勇为母寿建石砌仿木结构五层楼阁式八角形平面通高44.8米
中文 Chinese

给母亲做寿，孝子总会拿出令人惊喜的礼物。北宋大观、政和年间（1107—1118年）郭勇为母七十和八十寿诞，先后建了两座塔，一东一西，位于仙游县龙华镇的龙华寺前，合称龙华双塔。双塔皆坐北朝南，石砌仿木结构，五层楼阁式，八角形平面，通高44.8米。

底层由石柱、鹅卵石及不规则石块砌筑。以上各层，东西两塔材料构造有异。双塔每层开四门，内设四龛，位置逐层互换；各层有石阶可直达顶层。塔檐层层叠涩出挑，塔顶装相轮塔刹。塔身表面虽朴实无华，塔内佛像、须弥宝座、台阶等处有大量的石雕，内容丰富，工艺精湛。

明嘉靖年间（1522—1566年）塔座曾经被倭寇烧损，至今能看到双塔底层有显著烟熏而成的黑色。清康熙五十八年（1719年），双塔得到了重修。20世纪五六十年代又有重新整修的举措。

English

For a mother's birthday, a filial son will always拿出 surprising gifts.

During the Daguan and Zhenghe reigns of the Northern Song (1107–1118), Guo Yong built two pagodas successively for his mother's 70th and 80th birthdays, one east and one west, located in front of Longhua Temple in Longhua Town, Xianyou County, collectively called the Longhua Double Pagodas.

Both pagodas face south from the north, with stone masonry imitating timber structure, five-story multi-story style, octagonal plan, and a total height of 44.8 meters.

The bottom layer is built of stone columns, cobblestones, and irregular stone blocks.Above each layer, the east and west pagodas differ in materials and construction.

Each layer of both pagodas has four doors and four niches inside, with positions alternating layer by layer; each layer has stone steps leading directly to the top.

The pagoda eaves project layer by layer with corbelling (diese), and the top is fitted with a相轮 finial.

Although the pagoda body surface is plain and unadorned, there are大量 stone carvings at the Buddha statues, xumi thrones, and steps inside the pagoda, with rich content and exquisite craftsmanship.

During the Jiajing reign of the Ming (1522–1566), the pagoda bases were once burned and damaged by Japanese pirates; to this day, significant smoke-blackened areas can be seen at the bottom layers of both pagodas.

In 1719 (the 58th year of Kangxi reign, Qing), both pagodas were restored.In the 1950s and 1960s, there were further renovation measures.

推荐级别：★★★★

龙纪寺

No.146
Longji Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田市仙游县盖尾乡昌山村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木构六角亭德化白瓷五百罗汉始创于汉佛教最早痕迹清末重修清光绪二十五年上帝殿木构二层楼阁式
中文 Chinese

龙纪寺始创于汉，那是佛教在中国最早的痕迹之一。不过历代兴废之后——或许历代人都怀揣着类似当代人"再塑金身"的心态，或许反之——今天保存下来的就主要是清末重修的结果了。

直奔主题，寺内最有代表性的建筑为上帝殿，又称六角亭，建于清光绪二十五年（1899年），那是在西方现代建筑流派已然蠢蠢欲动的年代建造的一座木构二层楼阁式建筑。此殿上层歇山顶，下层为六角形出檐，故名。更精确地聚焦主题，就是五百罗汉瓷雕。入得六角亭内，周围壁柜祀供着五百罗汉。

细观之则为清代德化白瓷雕塑，神态各异，栩栩如生。虽说每一件罗汉单独拿出来都堪称珍贵文物，但是只有在这里，在人们本来为他们准备好的环境中，用人们认为最得体的工艺制造出来，才是他们真正的价值所在。

English

Longji Temple was first founded in the Han Dynasty, one of the earliest traces of Buddhism in China.

However, after successive rises and falls — perhaps people of every generation harbored a mentality similar to contemporary people's "re-gilding the golden body," or perhaps the opposite — what survives today is mainly the result of late Qing restoration.

Going straight to the point, the most representative building in the temple is the Shangdi Hall, also called the Hexagonal Pavilion, built in 1899 (the 25th year of Guangxu reign, Qing), a two-story timber pavilion-style building constructed in an era when Western modern architectural movements were already stirring.

This hall has a hip-and-gable roof on the upper level and hexagonal projecting eaves on the lower level, hence its name.

More precisely focusing on the theme, it is the five hundred arhat porcelain carvings.Entering the hexagonal pavilion, the surrounding wall cabinets enshrine five hundred arhats.

Examining closely, they are Qing Dynasty Dehua white porcelain sculptures, each with a different expression, lifelike.

Although each arhat taken alone can be called a precious cultural relic, only here, in the environment originally prepared for them, manufactured with the craftsmanship people considered most appropriate, is their true value found.

推荐级别：★★

三会寺

No.147
Sanhui Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田市仙游县大济镇三会村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木结构隋唐始创明嘉靖年间重修天王殿大雄宝殿大雄宝殿明代风格单檐歇山式面阔五间进深三间
中文 Chinese

仙游聚集了规模化的传统手工业制造者，侧面说明了当地传统工艺的生机。龙山下的三会寺也是这个文化传统的见证者。寺始创于隋唐时期，历代多有兴废，今存建筑为明嘉靖年间重修，从现状面貌来看，晚近应有修缮。三会寺主要建筑包括天王殿和大雄宝殿。

其中最具历史价值者为大雄宝殿。大殿主体结构尚保留有明代风格特征，单檐歇山式，面阔五间，进深三间，梁架简洁，斗拱有力。

殿内藻井毗连，藻井内保存了大量清代彩画，内容丰富，颇具特色。寺内现存文物甚多，其中有北宋崇宁三年（1104年）的石槽盆。

钟楼上立有一口大钟，为元代大德九年（1305年）所铸。

English

Xianyou has gathered large-scale traditional handicraft manufacturers, which indirectly illustrates the vitality of local traditional crafts.

Sanhui Temple at the foot of Long Mountain is also a witness to this cultural tradition.

The temple was first founded during the Sui-Tang period, with many rises and falls through successive dynasties; the existing buildings were restored during the Jiajing reign of the Ming, and judging from the current appearance, there should have been recent repairs.

The main buildings of Sanhui Temple include the Heavenly King Hall and the Mahavira Hall.Among them, the most historically valuable is the Mahavira Hall.

The main structure of the hall still retains Ming Dynasty stylistic features, with a single-eave hip-and-gable style, five bays wide and three deep, with a simple beam frame and powerful bracket sets.

The caisson ceilings inside the hall are adjacent, and a large number of Qing Dynasty painted decorations are preserved within the caissons, with rich content and distinctive features.

There are many existing cultural relics in the temple, including a stone trough basin from 1104 (the third year of Chongning reign, Northern Song).

A large bell stands in the bell tower, cast in 1305 (the ninth year of Dade reign, Yuan).

推荐级别：★★★

天中万寿塔

No.148
Wanshou Pagoda in Tianzhong
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：五代
地址：莆田市仙游县枫亭镇塔斗山
类型：宗教建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石塔形制比例尺度风景环境五代末始创石构实心四方形五层高7.4米边长5.1米
中文 Chinese

到了枫亭镇才发现铁路已经把塔斗山和导航路线分开，需要步行或骑摩托车才能寻访到天中万寿塔。盘旋登山，路经新庙，崎岖再上，终于一睹真颜。天中万寿塔始创于五代末，坐北向南，塔为石构实心，四方形五层，高7.4米，边长5.1米，以山作基，砌石而起，直插云霄。

塔表面几乎布满浮雕，其造型之奇特、艺术之洗练、刻工之精湛，均堪称一绝。第一层置于瓣莲花须弥座上，四转角各雕一尊力神，略作半蹲，用头着力顶住上层塔座，塔身四面则各雕双龙相戏图，其形态各不相同。其中尤以南面一幅浮雕为精彩，图面为双龙尾巴互相钩连，同时又双双回头对视。第二层底部又重垫一道须弥座并有八个座脚，塔身四转角只置圆鼓形立柱，每面则各雕四幅折枝花卉。

第三层每面各凿成三个拱门形浅龛，龛中各雕一尊佛像；四转角作浮雕身着古代武士服的立体人像。奇特还是第四层，塔身各面中间各有一尊浮雕头戴古印度宝冠、两边著璎珞、佩身耳铛的女菩萨，其名号一时弄不明白；四转角则各雕鸟嘴人形、长翅膀的迦楼罗立像为角柱。按迦楼罗系梵语音译，即金翅鸟，佛教指天龙八部之一，以龙为食。由此可见，建此塔亦含有借佛教法力镇压海上孽龙兴风作浪之意。

这种宝箧印经塔自五代时即流行于我国南方，但多为小型的鎏金供养塔，此塔为地面建造的体型最大的该型佛塔实例。回望天中万寿塔静静矗立在山顶，俯瞰山下的海湾。塔不但年代久远，造型精美，而且充满异域风情，就连塔上人物的造型也不例外。

这也许代表着一个中国对外交流空前繁荣的时期，而那时的这一带沿海正是对外交流的口岸，这座塔的建筑风格使我们认识到一个完全不同的中国。

English

Arriving at Fengting Town, I discovered that the railway had already separated Tadou Mountain from the navigation route; one needs to walk or ride a motorcycle to visit Tianzhong Wanshou Pagoda.

Winding up the mountain, passing a new temple, climbing ruggedly further, I finally saw its true face.

Tianzhong Wanshou Pagoda was first built at the end of the Five Dynasties, facing south from the north; it is a solid stone structure, square with five layers, 7.4 meters high and 5.

1 meters on each side, using the mountain as its foundation, rising from stacked stones straight into the clouds.

The pagoda surface is almost entirely covered with relief carvings; its peculiar modeling, refined artistry, and exquisite carving are all unparalleled.

The first layer rests on a petal-lotus xumi pedestal, with a strength deity carved at each of the four corners, slightly half-crouching, using their heads to forcefully support the upper pagoda base; on the four sides of the pagoda body, each is carved with a double-dragon play scene, each with a different form.

Among them, the relief on the south side is especially精彩, depicting two dragons whose tails are hooked together while both turn their heads to look at each other.

At the bottom of the second layer, another xumi pedestal is laid with eight pedestal feet; the four corners of the pagoda body only have round drum-shaped columns, and each side is carved with four sprays of cut flowers.

On each side of the third layer, three arched shallow niches are chiseled, each with a Buddha statue carved inside; the four corners are made into three-dimensional figures in relief wearing ancient warrior costumes.

Most peculiar is the fourth layer: in the middle of each side of the pagoda body there is a relief of a female bodhisattva wearing an ancient Indian jeweled crown, with necklaces on both sides and earrings; her name could not be figured out for the moment; at the four corners, each is carved with a bird-beaked human-shaped, long-winged Garuda standing figure as a corner column.

Garuda is a Sanskrit transliteration, meaning the golden-winged bird, one of the Eight Legions of Buddhism in Buddhist terms, which feeds on dragons.

Thus it can be seen that building this pagoda also contained the meaning of using Buddhist power to suppress the evil dragons at sea stirring up storms.

This type of Baoyin Jing Pagoda (precious casket seal sutra pagoda) was popular in southern China since the Five Dynasties, but most were small gilded offering pagodas; this pagoda is the largest ground-built example of this type of Buddhist pagoda.

Looking back, Tianzhong Wanshou Pagoda stands quietly on the mountain top, overlooking the bay below.

The pagoda is not only ancient in date and exquisite in form, but also full of exotic flavor, even the figures on the pagoda are no exception.

This perhaps represents a period of unprecedented prosperity in China's foreign exchanges, and at that time this coastal area was exactly a port for foreign exchanges; the architectural style of this pagoda makes us recognize a completely different China.

推荐级别：★★★★★

文庙

No.149
Temple of Confucius
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：莆田市仙游县鲤城街道城内街公园路69号
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构砖石做法唐开元二十六年清源县学宋宣和七年废儒学沦为军器制造所南宋淳熙重修正殿改称大成殿
中文 Chinese

文庙就是孔子庙，仙游文庙最早的历史可追溯到唐开元二十六年（738年），《鲤城镇志》记载清源县署奉命在县城西始设儒学，名清源县学。

宋宣和七年（1125年），朝廷废除儒学，县庙学一度沦为地方军器制造所。南宋淳熙时（1174—1189年），文庙重修时正殿改称大成殿。

两旁扩建明伦、忠告、笃志等六个斋所，作为当时士子读书之处。宁宗嘉定年间（1208—1224年）文庙扩建大成门和乡贤祠等。

元至正二十年（1360年），文庙损毁于战乱，后来县伊任兴虽有修整，但难复旧观。明洪武元年（1368年），知县周从善，改尊道堂为明伦堂。

洪武二十六年（1393年），知县顾思敬于两廊后劈射圃，教谕谭子敬于明伦堂后建文昌阁。明永乐年间，依制改孔子庙为文庙。清康熙年间，尊孔子为"至圣先师"，续称文庙。

宣德八年（1434年），县令王彝修葺文庙比较完整，大成殿恢复原貌。正德九年（1514年），知县范珪改射圃为名宦祠和修建乡贤祠。

清雍正、乾隆两朝，邑伸徐万安兄弟和知县陈兴祚，将大成殿和大成门的四对木柱换上龙雕大石柱，并对文庙进行一次全面的艺术整修，至此文庙的规模达到极盛。

一口气历数了千年的修葺、扩建，可惜今天，曾有的棂星门、文昌宫、尊经阁、明伦堂，以及各朝代名贤祠和亭、台、阁、榭、池、桥等古建筑，已都荡然无存了。剩下的是戟门、两庑、大成殿、崇勋祠、文昌阁等古建筑，占地4100多平方米，庙内有宋代石鼓及清代的四对蟠龙浮雕石柱，却也气势不凡。

今天的文庙是大家的。当然首先是孩子的，让我们看到些希望。儒学几经兴废终成正统，新生代认识古久文字之前就来蟠龙石雕前沾沾龙气，或者真能得到神灵的庇护，今后好好地修身齐家，或者能得不过有出息到治国就可以打住，不要再平天下了。我们这个天下近代以来被各路英雄以不同的方式平了多次，已经有点面目全非了。其次这里也是老人的。

他们占据了内院，别有一番清幽，廊下自发组织的乐队在演奏唐代流传下来的雅乐，有弹有唱，其音袅...

English

The Confucian Temple is the Temple of Confucius; the earliest history of Xianyou Confucian Temple can be traced back to 738 (the 26th year of Kaiyuan reign, Tang).

The "Licheng Town Annals" record that the Qingyuan County government, by order, first established a Confucian school west of the county seat, named Qingyuan County School.

In 1125 (the seventh year of Xuanhe reign, Song), the court abolished Confucian schools, and the county temple school once became a local military weapon manufacturing workshop.

During the Chunxi reign of the Southern Song (1174–1189), when the Confucian Temple was restored, the main hall was renamed the Dacheng Hall.

On both sides, six study halls such as Minglun, Zhonggao, and Duzhi were expanded as places for scholars to study at that time.

During the Jiading reign of Emperor Ningzong (1208–1224), the Confucian Temple expanded the Dacheng Gate and the local worthies shrine.

In 1360 (the 20th year of Zhizheng reign, Yuan), the Confucian Temple was damaged in wartime chaos; later County Magistrate Ren Xing made repairs, but it was difficult to restore its former appearance.

In 1368 (the first year of Hongwu reign, Ming), County Magistrate Zhou Congshan changed the Zundao Hall to the Minglun Hall.

In 1393 (the 26th year of Hongwu reign), County Magistrate Gu Sijing opened an archery range behind the two corridors, and Instructor Tan Zijing built the Wenchang Pavilion behind the Minglun Hall.

During the Yongle reign of the Ming, according to regulations, the Temple of Confucius was changed to the Confucian Temple.

During the Kangxi reign of the Qing, Confucius was honored as the "Supreme Sage and First Teacher," and it continued to be called the Confucian Temple.

In 1434 (the eighth year of Xuande reign), County Magistrate Wang Yi restored the Confucian Temple relatively completely, and the Dacheng Hall recovered its original appearance.

In 1514 (the ninth year of Zhengde reign), County Magistrate Fan Gui changed the archery range into the famous officials shrine and built the local worthies shrine.

During the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns of the Qing, local gentry Xu Wan'an brothers and County Magistrate Chen Xingzuo replaced the four pairs of wooden columns of the Dacheng Hall and Dacheng Gate with large dragon-carved stone columns, and carried out a comprehensive artistic renovation of the Confucian Temple; by then the scale of the Confucian Temple reached its peak.

Having recounted a thousand years of repairs and expansions in one breath, it is regrettable that today, the former Lingxing Gate, Wenchang Palace, Zunjing Pavilion, Minglun Hall, as well as the famous worthies shrines and pavilions, terraces, towers, open pavilions, ponds, and bridges of various dynasties, have all vanished without a trace.

What remains are ancient buildings such as the Halberd Gate, two side corridors, Dacheng Hall, Chongxun Shrine, and Wenchang Pavilion, covering over 4,100 square meters; inside the temple there are Song Dynasty stone drums and four pairs of Qing Dynasty coiled-dragon relief stone columns, which are nonetheless imposing.

Today's Confucian Temple belongs to everyone.Of course, first of all it belongs to the children, giving us some hope.

Confucianism, after several rises and falls, finally became orthodoxy; the new generation, before recognizing ancient characters, comes to the coiled-dragon stone carvings to absorb some dragon qi, or perhaps truly receives divine protection, and in the future will properly cultivate themselves and regulate their families, or perhaps achieve enough to govern the state and then stop, no longer trying to pacify the world.

Our world, since modern times, has been pacified multiple times by various heroes in different ways, and has become somewhat unrecognizable.Secondly, this place also belongs to the elderly.

They occupy the inner courtyard, with a special tranquility; a spontaneously organized band under the corridor is playing elegant music passed down from the Tang Dynasty, with both playing and singing, its sound lingering.

..

推荐级别：★★★

无尘塔

No.150
Wuchen Pagoda
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：北宋
地址：莆田市仙游县凤山乡凤顶村西南1.5公里
类型：宗教建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石塔形制比例尺度风景环境唐咸通六年始建历代僧人圆寂静化之处北宋初重修
中文 Chinese

寻访无尘塔归来心中会感到担忧，实在是因为周边附属文物都很珍贵，包括宋代的一座石舍利墓塔和一对石经幢，还有一些原本是塔上或者是月台的构架，也就那么散落着，平静地躺在地上。无尘塔始建于唐咸通六年（865年）。

原为历代僧人圆寂静化之处，现存石塔为北宋初重修。塔坐北朝南，仿木楼阁式，石构，八角形平面，三层。塔顶为八角攒尖式，顶部塔刹残存覆钵和仰莲。塔底层周边设有月台，南面残存祭台石。塔身一层南北辟门，东西设窗，二、三层四面均辟门洞，并设平座勾栏，可供登临。

平座下为八角外檐，每层塔外檐下出三层弧线轮廓的半混叠涩，角部做出斗拱，出二昂。石塔每层角部均为瓜楞形石柱，柱顶端有明显卷杀。塔外东南、西南壁各浮雕护塔武士一尊。塔内壁设有石砌踏道以通上层。顶部用四层花岗石叠涩出挑并形成塔内顶部的藻井。

这样的杰出作品要是在北京，应当被供在博物馆里了吧……

English

Returning from visiting Wuchen Pagoda, one feels worried in the heart, truly because the surrounding附属 cultural relics are all precious, including a Song Dynasty stone relic tomb pagoda and a pair of stone pillars (jingchuang), as well as some frameworks originally from the pagoda or the moon platform, just scattered like that, lying peacefully on the ground.

Wuchen Pagoda was first built in 865 (the sixth year of Xiantong reign, Tang).

It was originally the place where monks of successive dynasties achieved nirvana and passed away; the existing stone pagoda was restored in the early Northern Song.

The pagoda faces south from the north, in imitation-timber multi-story style, stone structure, octagonal plan, with three layers.

The pagoda top is an octagonal pyramidal style, with the top finial retaining the inverted bowl and upward lotus.

Around the bottom layer of the pagoda there is a moon platform, and on the south side remnants of sacrificial platform stones remain.

The first layer of the pagoda body has doors on the north and south and windows on the east and west; the second and third layers have door openings on all four sides, with flat platforms and railings (pingzuo goulan) for climbing.

Below the flat platform are octagonal outer eaves; under each layer's outer eaves, three layers of arc-contoured semi-circular corbelling (banhun diese) project, with bracket sets made at the corners, projecting two ang (downward-curving bracket arms).

Each corner of the stone pagoda is a melon-ridged stone column, with obvious entasis (juansha) at the top of the column.

On the southeast and southwest walls outside the pagoda, each has a relief of a pagoda-protecting warrior.The inner wall of the pagoda has a stone-built stairway to the upper layer.

The top uses four layers of granite corbelling to project out and form the caisson ceiling at the top inside the pagoda.

Such an outstanding work, if it were in Beijing, should be enshrined in a museum, right...

推荐级别：★★★★★

三明市 Sanming City
