安良堡

No.172
Anliang Fort
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：三明市大田县桃源镇东坂村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
利用地形的设计防御设施结构和装饰大田土堡群特色强烈真正堡垒防御为主居住为辅距离平时民居聚集点50至150米方便村民危险时躲入
中文 Chinese

大田的土堡群特色是很强烈的，是真正的堡垒，防御为主，居住为辅，仅距离平时的民居聚集点在50至150米，方便村民在出现危险时躲入堡内。在这里，山区生活的艰辛和艰辛生活中的情趣一同表现得淋漓尽致。

现存年代最早的土堡是明洪武初年，最晚的是民国三十七年。面积最大的好几千平方米，最小的十几平方米，楼层最高的7层、最低的2层。

这个安良堡和下文中的琵琶堡、芳联堡、泰安堡及广崇堂都已列入全国重点文物保护单位，是大田土堡的代表作品。安良堡，坐西北向东南，依山而建，前方后弧，规模不大，气势却是无法掩盖的强大。安良堡的气势来自于前后的14米高差，和它因山起筑、层叠而上的阶状"跑马道"。

至于门前护濠、高台阶、门洞、内门、前厅、后厅三层建筑、廊庑则满足最基本的居住生活功能。据记载安良堡始建于明末，清中早期匪寇破之，清嘉庆十一年（1806年）重建，历经战事百余起无损。这样的山地环境建堡，构造设计和施工难度都很大，对于施工质量的要求也很高。

况且，设计和施工的检验员将是实实在在的抵抗流寇的战斗。

English

The earthen fort cluster of Datian has very strong characteristics — they are true fortresses, with defense as the primary function and residence as secondary, located only 50 to 150 meters from the usual residential gathering points, making it convenient for villagers to take shelter inside when danger arises.

Here, the hardships of mountain life and the情趣 within hard life are both expressed to the fullest.

The earliest surviving earthen fort dates to the early Hongwu reign of the Ming, and the latest to the 37th year of the Republic.

The largest covers several thousand square meters, the smallest just over ten square meters; the tallest has 7 stories, the lowest 2.

This Anliang Fort, along with Pipa Fort, Fanglian Fort, Taian Fort, and Guangchong Hall mentioned below, have all been listed as National Key Cultural Heritage Sites, and are representative works of Datian earthen forts.

Anliang Fort faces southeast from the northwest, built against the mountain, with a square front and curved rear; it is not large in scale, but its imposing aura cannot be concealed.

Anliang Fort's aura comes from the 14-meter height difference between front and rear, and its stepped "horse-running road" (paomadao) built up the mountain in layers.

As for the moat in front of the gate, high steps, gate opening, inner gate, front hall, rear hall three-story building, and corridors — these satisfy the most basic residential living functions.

According to records, Anliang Fort was first built in the late Ming, breached by bandits in the early-to-mid Qing, and rebuilt in the 11th year of Jiaqing reign (1806), surviving over a hundred battles without damage.

Building a fort in such a mountain environment involves great difficulty in structural design and construction, with high requirements for construction quality.

Moreover, the inspectors of design and construction would be the actual battles against roaming bandits.

推荐级别：★★★★

芳联堡

No.173
Fanglian Fort
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：三明市大田县均溪镇许思坑村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
防御设施排水系统结构和装饰没有依赖山体进行防御建在舒缓地段上坐北向南好朝向注重堡内生活品质
中文 Chinese

芳联堡没有依赖山体进行防御，与其他地区的土堡类似，建在舒缓的地段上，选得坐北向南的好朝向，也非常注重堡内的生活品质。此堡前方后圆，规模也属于较大者，建筑面积达到3000平方米。防御设施的主体是三合土堡墙，环堡跑马道对外布置射孔；堡门也为双重，角落专门设置了角楼。

安全的方位设计确保芳联从清嘉庆十一年（1806年）始建一直就没有大修过。不过这里给人印象最为深刻的反而是堡内生活设施设计和装饰设计，那是一种无法掩饰的对生活的热爱。堡内两进三堂加后楼，后院左右都有水井，建筑周边都有良好的排水设施。

还有就是厅堂的斗拱和木雕，门窗的花格和彩绘，檐头的瓦作和泥塑，柱础和门枕上的石雕，在没有战争的年代一定是吸引村民流连于此的理由。

English

Fanglian Fort did not rely on the mountain for defense; similar to earthen forts in other regions, it was built on gently sloping terrain, chosen with a good south-facing orientation, and also paid great attention to the quality of life inside the fort.

This fort has a square front and round rear, and is relatively large in scale, with a building area of 3,000 square meters.

The main body of defensive facilities is the sanhetu (triple-mixed earth) fort wall, with shooting holes arranged outward along the encircling horse-running road; the fort gate is also double, with corner towers specially set at the corners.

The safe orientation design ensured that Fanglian, from its first construction in the 11th year of Jiaqing reign (1806), has never undergone major repairs.

However, what leaves the deepest impression here is instead the design of living facilities and decorative design inside the fort — an undisguised love of life.

Inside the fort there are two courtyards, three halls, plus a rear building; in the rear courtyard there are wells on both left and right, and good drainage facilities around the buildings.

There are also the dougong (bracket sets) and wood carvings in the halls, the lattice patterns and painted decorations on doors and windows, the tile work and clay sculptures on the eaves, and the stone carvings on the column bases (zhuchu) and door pillows — in times without war, these must have been the reasons attracting villagers to linger here.

推荐级别：★★★

琵琶堡

No.174
Chinese Lute-shaped Fort
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：三明市大田县建设镇建国村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
土堡造型设计造型与环境的结合存心要一个琵琶形平面土堡还是顺应地形自然而然始建明洪武七年1374年明末重修清康熙咸丰年间修葺不知道哪一代风水先生或是村子主人动的这番灵机大山中一座孤傲的山冈上
中文 Chinese

是存心要一个琵琶形平面的土堡吗？还是顺应地形的呼声，自然而然地得到了这样的方案？琵琶堡始建明洪武七年（1374年），明末重修，清康熙、咸丰年间修葺。

真不知道是哪一代的风水先生或是村子主人动的这番灵机。土堡在大山中的一座孤傲的山冈上，若按堡内正房的朝向，应该是坐北朝南。从地面上只领略到建筑与地形随意而恰当的结合，自由的曲面夯土墙，还有不经意间"抹"在墙上的深灰色瓦顶。好一座中国古代的朗香教堂！

琵琶堡规模不大，占地面积3500平方米，建筑面积近2000平方米。防卫起见门就显得更小，门洞前还辟一小方池。堡内跑马道一周，中轴线上建有三圣祠、前楼、观音阁等。在更高的山顶上俯瞰土堡，整体布局一览无余，吉祥完美的琵琶造型，令人感慨老天爷的暗示和古人的聪慧。

堡外梯田层层，仿佛仙人画下的等高线；农人劳作不辍，怕是早已熟识了祖宗的高明，甚至遗忘了子孙膜拜的责任吧？

English

Was it intentional to have an earthen fort with a pipa (Chinese lute)-shaped plan?Or was this scheme naturally arrived at by following the call of the terrain?

Pipa Fort was first built in the 7th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1374), rebuilt in the late Ming, and repaired during the Kangxi and Xianfeng reigns of the Qing.

One really does not know which generation's fengshui master or village owner had this inspiration.

The earthen fort sits on a solitary hillock in the great mountains; according to the orientation of the main house inside, it should face south.

From the ground, one only appreciates the casual yet appropriate combination of architecture and terrain, the free curved rammed-earth walls, and the dark gray tile roof casually "smeared" onto the walls.

What a Chinese ancient Ronchamp Chapel!Pipa Fort is not large in scale, covering 3,500 square meters with a building area of nearly 2,000 square meters.

For defense, the gate appears even smaller, and a small square pond is opened in front of the gate opening.

Inside the fort, the horse-running road encircles once; on the central axis are built the Three Sages Shrine, front building, Guanyin Pavilion, and others.

Overlooking the earthen fort from a higher mountain top, the overall layout is fully visible — the auspicious and perfect pipa shape, making one感慨 at the hints of heaven and the wisdom of the ancients.

Outside the fort, terraced fields layer upon layer, as if contour lines drawn by immortals; farmers toil without cease, perhaps already familiar with the brilliance of their ancestors, even forgetting the responsibility of descendants to worship them?

推荐级别：★★★★★

泰安堡·广崇堂

No.175
Taian Fort and Guangchong Hall
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：三明市大田县太华镇小华村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
土堡和堂厝的关系防御设施排水系统结构和装饰泰安堡和广崇堂同在小华村泰安堡建设得早清乾隆年间就有了
中文 Chinese

泰安堡和广崇堂同在小华村。泰安堡建设得早，清乾隆年间就有了，清中期被匪寇破坏，清咸丰丁巳年（1857年）重建。此堡三层，依缓坡而建，于是略显得更加高大一些。主要建筑的主朝向是西北，方形圆角，规模不大，建筑面积1000多平方米。

和其他土堡一样，门洞窄小，堡墙厚实，跑马道联络，四角更建碉式角楼。堡内空旷，仅余大坪、水井，再无厅堂之设备。广崇堂始建于清末至民国初年，从防御性而言或者可以说是泰安堡的附属建筑，但是设计方针与泰安堡形成鲜明对比。

此堂两层，朝向西南，建筑面积约1000平方米，虽然也外墙厚实防御森严，但是厅堂敞亮，房屋隔间丰富，木雕、石雕、彩绘把建筑装饰人情味十足。

English

Taian Fort and Guangchong Hall are both in Xiaohua Village.

Taian Fort was built early, already existing during the Qianlong reign of the Qing; it was destroyed by bandits in the mid-Qing and rebuilt in the Dingsi year of Xianfeng reign (1857).

This fort is three stories, built on a gentle slope, thus appearing slightly taller.

The main orientation of the primary building is northwest, square with rounded corners, not large in scale, with a building area of over 1,000 square meters.

Like other earthen forts, the gate opening is narrow, the fort wall is thick, the horse-running roads connect, and watchtower-style corner towers are built at all four corners.

Inside the fort is open and empty, with only a large flat area and a well, with no hall facilities remaining.

Guangchong Hall was first built from the late Qing to the early Republican period; in terms of defensiveness, it could perhaps be called an附属 building of Taian Fort, but its design philosophy forms a stark contrast with Taian Fort.

This hall is two stories, facing southwest, with a building area of about 1,000 square meters; although it also has thick exterior walls and strict defense, the halls are bright and open, the room partitions are rich, and wood carvings, stone carvings, and painted decorations make the architectural decoration full of human warmth.

推荐级别：★★★

龙岩市 Longyan

31 处

赤水天后宫

No.176
Chishui Tianhou Palace
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：龙岩市龙门镇赤水村东北
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木结构规模和形式登临唯一在龙岩市郊区选择的一点从龙岩市区到龙门镇山田相间乡村环境距离目的村落还有个把公里就看到安定从容俯瞰四野高阁
中文 Chinese

赤水天后宫是我们唯一在龙岩市郊区选择的一点。从龙岩市区到龙门镇，走回了山田相间的乡村环境，做好了在村落中寻找寺庙的准备。完全没有想到的是，距离目的村落还有个把公里的地方，就看到了一座安定从容、俯瞰四野的高阁。震撼之余，甚至没有猜到它就是天后宫。

赤水天后宫始建于清乾隆三十五年（1770年）。

据现存宫内的碑文记载，只是因为宫的规模太宏大了，费用不敷，只好"观成有待"；后来"风雨所侵"、"众虑其圮"，于是凑集银两一百七十两七钱有奇，"通体修理，保前功于勿坠"；工程历时一年有余，在乾隆五十年（1786年）修理完成，终于"焕然可观"。

要说天后宫的平面规模并不大，坐北朝南，一进院子，大门后有戏台，两侧回廊，正宫是一座前带抱厦的大阁。而就是这座正宫，四层屋檐，歇山顶，内部可以看出四层楼板的痕迹，现存三层；两侧的扶楼也是四层檐而比正楼矮一层。黛瓦白墙、素木精石之间，古朴气氛尤存。看庙主人大声欢迎着我们，看门的"小黑"也就止住了警惕的咆哮。

不是祭祀的日子，这里没有看到游客的香火，只闻到主人炊烟。炊烟和肃穆建筑形成对比，反而让人领略到宗教的本意。想起沿海热闹的天后宫，这里的品位正对了我们的胃口。

English

Chishui Tianhou Palace is the only site we selected in the suburbs of Longyan.

From Longyan city to Longmen Town, we returned to a rural environment of interspersed fields and mountains, preparing to search for the temple in the village.

Completely unexpected, while still about a kilometer from the target village, we saw a tall pavilion, calm and composed, overlooking the surrounding fields.

Amazed, we did not even guess it was Tianhou Palace.Chishui Tianhou Palace was first built in the 35th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1770).

According to the surviving stele inscription inside the palace, simply because the palace's scale was too grand, the funds were insufficient, so it had to "await completion"; later, "invaded by wind and rain" and "all worried about its collapse," they gathered 170 taels and 7 mace of silver, "repairing it entirely to preserve the previous achievement from falling"; the project took over a year, and was completed in the 50th year of Qianlong reign (1786), finally "becoming splendidly visible.

" The plan of Tianhou Palace is not large, facing south, with one courtyard; behind the main gate is a stage, with corridors on both sides, and the main palace is a large pavilion with a front portico (baosha).

It is this main palace, with four layers of eaves and a hip-and-gable roof (xieshan ding), that shows traces of four floor slabs inside, with three stories surviving; the side auxiliary buildings also have four layers of eaves but are one story shorter than the main building.

Between the black tiles, white walls, plain wood, and fine stone, an ancient atmosphere persists.The temple keeper loudly welcomed us, and the watchdog "Xiao Hei" stopped its alert barking.

Not a sacrificial day, there was no tourist incense here, only the smell of the keeper's cooking smoke.

The contrast between cooking smoke and the solemn building instead allows one to appreciate the true meaning of religion.

Thinking of the bustling Tianhou Palaces along the coast, the taste here is exactly to our liking.

推荐级别：★★★

虎符祖殿

No.177
Hufu Ancestral Hall
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳平市新桥镇南丰村赖山林中
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木结构装饰石作宁洋县志载虎符岩在赖家山有真君殿每岁七月间岩平永大四邑远来祷辄应纪念唐代张吴萧三真人智斗山魅得道成仙小庙
中文 Chinese

《宁洋县志》载："虎符岩在赖家山，有真君殿，每岁七月间，岩、平、永、大四邑远来祷，辄应。"这是纪念唐代张、吴、萧三"真人"智斗"山魅"得道成仙的小庙，虎符殿的名气远大于它的规模。这里是村边山上车辆难行的密林，千年的古树荫翳和忘忧泉水的甘甜能够扫除一切寻找虎符殿路途的艰辛。一切都是机缘吧。正午到达南丰村赖山脚，巧遇行走在路上的年届六十的赖大姐。

她的家距离上山的道路最近。早五分钟她还在劳作，晚五分钟她会照常午休。"没有我，你们找不到的。"后来方知此言不虚。路面已经全部是碎石。冲动的驱使下，我们咬牙前行。"我的儿子不敢开车上来的。"其实若非大姐坐在车上，我们也是早早掉头了。大约6公里步行速度的颠簸，再加上1里路的步行，到了灵验不怕庙宇深的虎符祖殿。

这是一座三间小殿，歇山顶，穿斗抬梁混合式木结构。宋代始建，明嘉靖十六年（1537年）重建，根据捐款木牌的记载，清嘉庆间或有修缮之举。

殿内斗拱细腻、月梁舒展、藻井精致、覆盆式柱础则古朴无华。

殿中有铁钟二口，系明弘治三年（1490年）和万历廿四年（1596年）所铸，"虎符祖殿"牌匾也是落款隆庆五年（1571年）。庙前泉水不绝，庙后复建廊桥一座。桥内凉风习习，正是恢复体力的好地方。

English

The "Ningyang County Gazetteer" records: "Hufu Rock is at Lai Family Mountain, with a Zhenjun Hall; every year in the seventh month, people from the four counties of Yan, Ping, Yong, and Da come from afar to pray, and their prayers are always answered.

" This is a small temple commemorating the three "Perfected Ones" (Zhenren) Zhang, Wu, and Xiao of the Tang Dynasty, who outwitted the "mountain demon" and attained immortality; the fame of Hufu Hall far exceeds its scale.

Here is a dense forest on the mountain beside the village where vehicles cannot pass; the shade of thousand-year-old ancient trees and the sweetness of Wangyou Spring water can sweep away all the hardships of the journey to find Hufu Hall.

Everything is fate, perhaps.Arriving at the foot of Lai Mountain in Nanfeng Village at noon, we happened to meet Sister Lai, nearly sixty years old, walking on the road.

Her home is closest to the path up the mountain.Five minutes earlier she was still working, five minutes later she would be taking her usual nap."Without me, you wouldn't find it.

" Later we realized this was no exaggeration.The road surface was already entirely gravel.Driven by impulse, we gritted our teeth and pressed on."My son doesn't dare drive up here.

" In fact, if Sister Lai hadn't been sitting in the car, we would have turned back long ago.

After about 6 kilometers of bumping at walking speed, plus another li of walking, we arrived at Hufu Ancestral Hall — efficacious and unafraid of being deep in the mountains.

This is a three-bay small hall, with a hip-and-gable roof, and a mixed chuan-dou (column-and-tie) and tai-liang (post-and-lintel) timber structure.

First built in the Song Dynasty, rebuilt in the 16th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1537), and according to the donation wooden plaque, there may have been repairs during the Jiaqing reign of the Qing.

Inside the hall, the dougong (bracket sets) are delicate, the moon beams (yueliang) are舒展, the caisson ceiling (zaojing) is exquisite, and the inverted-bowl column bases (fupen zhuchu) are simple and unadorned.

There are two iron bells in the hall, cast in the third year of Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1490) and the 24th year of Wanli reign (1596); the "Hufu Ancestral Hall" plaque is also dated the fifth year of Longqing reign (1571).

In front of the temple spring water flows without cease, and behind the temple a covered bridge has been rebuilt.

The cool breeze inside the bridge makes it a perfect place to recover one's strength.

推荐级别：★★★

华唐阁

No.178
Huatang Pavilion
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：漳平市新桥镇义宅村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木结构小木作壁画彩画痕迹漳平以北山中古村密布木耳种植对老屋风貌影响不大木耳带来收入促使一些人把老屋换作新砖房
中文 Chinese

漳平以北的山中古村密布，木耳种植对老屋风貌影响不大，却是木耳带来的收入促使一些人把老屋换作新砖房。好在也有人延续着传统，总体景观还在。穿行村间道路已经不似过去艰辛了，只是最好选择柏油路面的线路，否则行车便成为不可能完成的任务。华唐阁所在的义宅村很好找，入村询问便可顺利到达。这是一座两层的殿阁，背靠山岩，面向东方正襟危坐。

华唐阁又名观音阁，明成化年间（1465—1487年）始建，倡建的名字叫作陈云隐，后代屡有重修。

这两层的楼阁基本是一座二层的五开间正楼；前面带一层抱厦五间，屋顶廊庑一样地与正楼咬接、转折；两侧再各加挟屋一座，靠北一侧挟屋做亭式处理，是室外石阶登临上层的入口；正楼顶上更加歇山屋顶，只一间，斗拱支撑，檐下悬"华唐阁"匾额。最为难得的是，楼中一些古老工艺和痕迹尚存，非常耐人寻味。

其一，正楼和抱厦屋檐之下，有"板引檐"，构造设计合理精细，与大木作结合紧密，是难得一见的做法；其二，楼上正厅之内藻井做法大方精美，绝非一般堆砌之作，配合雕刻人物、瑞草图案的斗拱，一堂装饰，一堂庄重；其三，侧墙装修、侧厅顶棚之上保留人物山水图、异兽图案，是研究装饰和涂层装饰的珍贵样本。

须得提醒一下不愿走回头路的行者，出村一段路程石土交加，左山右田，摩托车行进无碍，汽车却多有不便。感叹新砖楼和柏油路，褒贬之间，我们是不是太自私了，尤其是在民生和传统的夹缝中找到出路之前，在当世的欲望和对子孙的责任的天平上认清轻重之前……

English

Ancient villages are densely distributed in the mountains north of Zhangping; wood ear (mushroom) cultivation has little impact on the appearance of old houses, but the income from wood ears has prompted some people to replace old houses with new brick houses.

Fortunately, some people continue the tradition, and the overall landscape remains.

Traveling through village roads is no longer as hard as in the past, but it is best to choose asphalt routes, otherwise driving becomes an impossible task.

Yizhai Village, where Huatang Pavilion is located, is easy to find — just ask upon entering the village and you can arrive smoothly.

This is a two-story hall-pavilion, backed against mountain rock, facing east with dignified composure.

Huatang Pavilion, also known as Guanyin Pavilion, was first built during the Chenghua reign of the Ming (1465–1487); the name of the initiator was Chen Yunyin, and descendants repeatedly repaired it.

This two-story pavilion is basically a two-story five-bay main building; in front is a one-story portico (baosha) of five bays, whose roof and corridors connect and turn with the main building; on both sides an additional wing (xiewu) is added each, with the north-side wing treated in pavilion style, serving as the entrance via outdoor stone steps to the upper floor; on top of the main building is an additional hip-and-gable roof, only one bay, supported by dougong, with the "Huatang Pavilion" plaque hanging under the eaves.

Most rare is that some ancient craftsmanship and traces remain in the building, very thought-provoking.

First, under the eaves of the main building and portico, there is a "board-led eaves" (ban yinyan), with合理 and refined structural design, tightly integrated with the major timberwork — a rarely seen construction method.

Second, the caisson ceiling (zaojing) in the upper main hall is generously and exquisitely made, by no means a commonplace堆砌,配合 dougong carved with figures and auspicious grass patterns — one hall of decoration, one hall of solemnity.

Third, on the side wall finishes and above the side hall ceilings, figures, landscape paintings, and exotic beast patterns are preserved, a precious sample for studying decoration and coating decoration.

It must be reminded to travelers unwilling to retrace their steps: for a stretch after leaving the village, the road is mixed stone and earth, with mountains on the left and fields on the right; motorcycles pass without hindrance, but cars have much inconvenience.

Sighing at new brick buildings and asphalt roads, between praise and blame, are we being too selfish — especially before finding a way out in the夹缝 between people's livelihood and tradition, before recognizing the balance on the scale between worldly desires and responsibility to descendants.

..

推荐级别：★★★★

麟山塔

No.179
Linshan Pagoda
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：龙岩漳平市双洋镇麒麟山
类型：礼制建筑·砖结构
特征标签 Highlights
砖塔形式与结构壁画彩画古宁洋县文武庙先农坛妈祖庙俱全古桥民众多麒麟山上还有麟山塔麟山塔俗称白塔始建于明万历三十年1602年
中文 Chinese

古宁洋县文、武庙、先农坛、妈祖庙俱全，古桥民众多，麒麟山上还有麟山塔。

麟山塔俗称白塔，始建于明万历三十年（1602年），清康熙十八年（1679年）重建，光绪元年（1875年）重修。双洋镇上老屋保存状况不是很好，颇令人担心而惋惜。旧县城的痕迹还是依稀可寻的。

走过青云桥沿着石阶上山。在闽西山中日最后的暑意，尤其在一早一晚，已经所剩无几，这是百公里之外沿海地区所深深嫉妒的。麟山塔虽不甚高大，但在麟山公园围墙和大门等建筑的衬托下依然气势十足。

塔是仿楼阁式的砖体结构，内部空心，平面八角，共计七层，顶层做重檐处理；总高22米，底层宽7.2米，向上逐层内收。塔的每层两面开券门，位置变换设置，另六面外设佛龛；底层开拱券塔门，内设木质楼板及扶梯；塔内墙面有彩绘壁画、墨书题记等历史遗存。

只要到了双洋，人们就会告诉你徐霞客也到过这里。崇祯元年（1628年）和崇祯三年（1630年），他两次乘舟顺流而下游览考察，并在宁洋溪的记述中做出了"程俞迫则流俞急"的科学论断。人们还会告诉你朱德将军也到过这里。那时他率领红四军二、三纵队2000余人至此，今天还保留着红军布告、标语等痕迹。

祝愿双洋受到国家文物部门的重视，祝愿双洋首先得到当地民众的重视。

English

The ancient Ningyang County had complete civil and military temples, Xiannong Altar, and Mazu Temple, with many ancient bridges and residents; on Qilin Mountain there is also Linshan Pagoda.

Linshan Pagoda, commonly known as White Pagoda, was first built in the 30th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1602), rebuilt in the 18th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1679), and repaired in the first year of Guangxu reign (1875).

The preservation of old houses in Shuangyang Town is not very good, quite worrying and regrettable.Traces of the old county seat can still be faintly found.

Crossing Qingyun Bridge and going up the mountain along stone steps.

In the western Fujian mountains, the last summer heat, especially in the early morning and evening, has almost disappeared — something deeply envied by coastal areas a hundred kilometers away.

Although Linshan Pagoda is not very tall, it still has full imposing aura against the backdrop of buildings such as the Linshan Park walls and main gate.

The pagoda is a pavilion-style brick structure, hollow inside, with an octagonal plan, totaling seven stories, with the top story treated with double eaves; total height 22 meters, bottom width 7.

2 meters, tapering inward story by story upward.

Each story has arched doors on two sides, with positions alternating, and Buddhist niches on the other six sides; the bottom story has an arched pagoda gate, with wooden floor slabs and stairs inside; the interior walls have historical remains such as painted murals and ink inscriptions.

As long as you arrive in Shuangyang, people will tell you that Xu Xiake also came here.

In the first year of Chongzhen reign (1628) and the third year of Chongzhen reign (1630), he twice traveled downstream by boat for sightseeing and investigation, and in his account of Ningyang Stream made the scientific assertion that "the more constrained the course, the more rapid the flow.

" People will also tell you that General Zhu De also came here.

At that time he led over 2,000 people of the 2nd and 3rd Columns of the Red Fourth Army here, and today traces such as Red Army notices and slogans remain.

May Shuangyang receive the attention of national cultural heritage authorities, and may Shuangyang first receive the attention of local people.

推荐级别：★★★

土堡平面布局装饰易坪村许氏族谱记载泰安堡由许国榜于清乾隆五十七年1792年创建当时土匪盗贼猖獗置地收租致富的许国榜决定建堡守民

由于土楼的防盗设施齐全，楼墙坚固，武装了石块、土枪、土炮等武器，土匪次次无功而返。如同大田的泰安堡一样，灵地泰安堡也保卫了一村的安泰。泰安堡东西宽37.3米，南北长37.3米，平面前方后圆，坐北朝南；围堡二层，后座楼三层，堡内建...

English

According to the "Genealogy of the Xu Clan" of Yiping Village, Taian Fort was founded by Xu Guobang in the 57th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1792).

At that time bandits and robbers were rampant; Xu Guobang, who had become wealthy by acquiring land and collecting rent, decided to build a fort to protect the people.

Starting from the 33rd year of Qianlong reign (1768), it took fifteen years to finally complete the building.

It is said that later whenever bandit trouble arose, the whole village would hide in the fort to avoid disaster.

Because the earthen building's anti-theft facilities were complete, the building walls were solid, and armed with weapons such as stones, earth guns, and earth cannons, the bandits returned empty-handed every time.

Like Taian Fort in Datian, Lingdi Taian Fort also protected the peace of a whole village.Taian Fort is 37.3 meters wide east-west and 37.

3 meters long north-south, with a square front and round rear plan, facing south; the encircling fort is two stories, the rear building is three stories, and inside the fort is built...

文明塔

No.181
Wenming Pagoda
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：宋—明
地址：龙岩市适中镇仁和村
类型：礼制建筑·土体结构
特征标签 Highlights
土塔结构与材料造型尺度装饰同济大学路秉杰先生考察文明塔土塔在我国十分罕见适中文明塔可能是中国第一土塔
中文 Chinese

最早是听说同济大学路秉杰先生曾经考察文明塔，并指出，土塔在我国十分罕见，适中文明塔可能是中国第一土塔。我们怎能错过呢？还没有到达仁和村，远远地望见村南的山巅，文明塔安静屹立在那里。还需要多远的攀登呢？

据说适中镇形如一艘船，船头向着闽南大海，为拴住这艘大舟，须在高山之巅建塔；还传说朱熹当年在适中讲学，教化百姓要"文明作魁"，于是古塔取名文明，书楼取名魁楼，塔和楼远远地在一条子午线上。谋划如何登山，必须求助当地乡人。

遇到二位林先生，好客爽朗，拍着胸脯说要开自己的"高底盘车"载我们上去。"2016年或许路就修好了，到时候来的人会更多的。"言语间，他们对未来还是充满信心的。前几日的大雨冲坏了本来就沟壑纵横的碎石路，20分钟的颠簸，老林一直在兴致勃勃地谈论当地的风情，也说起此路还联系着大山另一侧的村庄。

路边新近搭好的放羊人的吊脚楼和一段段刚刚填平的小台地说明聪明的乡民正为今后的开发积极筹备着。车停在了一处略为宽广的平地上，拜访古塔还需要爬五分钟的山路。哦，它就在那里了！文明塔又称长塔或白叶塔，当地百姓常用它最短的名字。

塔建于宋代，八角形平面，空心筒体结构，楼阁式。

原有十三层，经明代和1958年两次雷电袭击后塔顶已毁，现存八层半；一层至七层土体，以上明代砌砖补修所成；塔通高23.26米，周长25.73米，底层内直径4.95米，底部墙厚1.64米；每层券窗四洞，交错布置，券门上方正中原有石刻"文明塔"，今或已异地保护。

下部塔身采用当地的版筑技术，就地取材，以灰、沙、土为原料夯筑而成。现状来看模板加工精细、夯艺高超，塔身表面至今光滑；塔身外部每层均留二层架木孔洞，尚无法解释是脚手架还是木檐所依；塔内原有的木制楼面、承重木、楞木和楼梯均无存，仅留夯土之上的孔洞。

English

I first heard that Mr.

Lu Bingjie of Tongji University had investigated Wenming Pagoda and pointed out that earthen pagodas are very rare in China, and that Shizhong Wenming Pagoda may be China's first earthen pagoda.

How could we miss it?Before reaching Renhe Village, from afar we saw on the mountain peak south of the village, Wenming Pagoda standing quietly.How much further climbing was needed?

It is said that Shizhong Town is shaped like a ship, with its bow facing the southern Fujian sea; to moor this great vessel, a pagoda must be built on the high mountain peak.

It is also传说 that Zhu Xi once lectured in Shizhong, teaching the people to be "civilized and outstanding," so the ancient pagoda was named Wenming (Civilization), and the study building was named Kuilou (Outstanding Building), with the pagoda and building far apart on the same meridian line.

Planning how to climb the mountain required seeking help from local villagers.We met two Mr.

Lins, hospitable and straightforward, patting their chests saying they would drive us up in their own "high-chassis car." "Maybe the road will be repaired by 2016, and more people will come then.

" In their words, they were still full of confidence in the future.

The heavy rain a few days earlier had damaged the already gully-crisscrossed gravel road; during 20 minutes of bumping, Old Lin was enthusiastically talking about local customs, also mentioning that this road connects to villages on the other side of the mountain.

Newly built stilt houses for shepherds by the roadside and sections of just-filled small terraces showed that the clever villagers were actively preparing for future development.

The car stopped at a slightly wider flat area; visiting the ancient pagoda still required a five-minute climb up the mountain path.Oh, there it was!

Wenming Pagoda, also called Chang Pagoda or Baiye Pagoda, local people commonly use its shortest name.

The pagoda was built in the Song Dynasty, with an octagonal plan, hollow cylinder structure, and pavilion style.

It originally had thirteen stories; after two lightning strikes in the Ming Dynasty and in 1958, the top was destroyed, and now eight and a half stories remain; the first to seventh stories are earthen, above which are Ming Dynasty brick repairs; the pagoda is 23.

26 meters high, 25.73 meters in circumference, with an inner diameter of 4.95 meters at the bottom and a bottom wall thickness of 1.

64 meters; each story has four arched windows, alternately arranged; above the arched gate in the center there was originally a stone carving "Wenming Pagoda," now perhaps relocated for protection.

The lower part of the pagoda body uses local rammed-earth (banzhu) technology, using local materials of lime, sand, and earth.

The current condition shows fine template processing and superb ramming technique, with the pagoda body surface still smooth to this day; each story on the exterior of the pagoda body leaves two layers of wooden frame holes, which cannot yet be explained as either scaffolding or supports for wooden eaves; the original wooden floors, load-bearing timbers, joists, and stairs inside the pagoda are all gone, leaving only holes in the rammed earth.

推荐级别：★★★★★

初溪土楼群

No.182
Earthen Building Cluster in Chuxi
级别：省级文物保护单位，集庆楼为全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清

特征标签 Highlights
土楼类型土楼结构形式装饰永定县多土楼很大程度上反映在永定这个名字上期冀永远安定的地方往往因为历史上的动乱永定地处闽西粤东交界八山一水一分田
中文 Chinese

永定县多土楼，很大程度上反映在永定这个名字上。期冀"永远安定"的地方往往因为历史上的动乱。永定地处闽西、粤东交界，"八山一水一分田"。明成化十四年（1478年）才从上杭县分置永定县。

初溪土楼群随着申报世界文化遗产的成功，名声大噪，保护和利用也已相当成熟了。站在今人建成的观景平台上，从层层梯田望去，溪流两岸舒缓平坦，视野中大大小小、方方圆圆的土楼散布开来，人烟稠密，望日作息。

这里大小土楼有50多座，代表性的十余座被选入了世界文化遗产名录...

English

Yongding County has many earthen buildings (tulou), which to a large extent is reflected in the name Yongding itself.

Places that hope for "eternal peace" are often so because of historical turmoil.

Yongding is located at the border of western Fujian and eastern Guangdong, described as "eight mountains, one water, one field.

" It was only in the 14th year of Chenghua reign of the Ming (1478) that Yongding County was separated from Shanghang County.

With the success of its application for World Cultural Heritage status, the Chuxi Earthen Building Cluster has become famous, and its protection and utilization are already quite mature.

Standing on the observation platform built by modern people, looking out from the layered terraced fields, both banks of the stream are gently sloping and flat, and in the field of vision earthen buildings of all sizes, square and round, are scattered about, with dense population living by the sun's schedule.

There are over 50 earthen buildings here, large and small, with more than ten representative ones selected for the World Cultural Heritage list...

推荐级别：★★★★

抚溪土楼群

No.183
Earthen Building Cluster in Fuxi
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳平市永定县抚市镇抚溪河南岸
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
土楼/土堡类型土楼结构形式抚溪河南岸有一大片土楼计有106座绵延3公里绝对是密度最高的土楼区含混称呼土楼土堡是因为专家把这里的土楼称为府第式方楼并没有特别贴切的界定或者说永隆昌楼的形制介于常规意义上的土楼和土堡之间具体方法就是在传统宅第的平面上树立起大型楼阁
中文 Chinese

抚溪河南岸，有一大片土楼计有106座，绵延3公里，绝对是密度最高的土楼区。

之所以含混地称呼"土楼"、"土堡"，是因为专家把这里的土楼称为府第式方楼，并没有特别贴切的界定，或者说永隆昌楼的形制介于常规意义上的土楼和土堡之间——具体的方法就是在传统宅第的平面上树立起大型楼阁。

这里最为突出的是永隆昌楼和永豪楼；而土楼土堡之外，这里还有天后宫、古渡口码头遗址、断墙遗址等古迹。永隆昌楼，是利用附属建筑将两座独立楼阁组合在一起形成土楼的，一座"老楼"位于中心，叫"福盛楼"；另一座"新楼"作为后楼，叫"福善楼"。

当地居民黄姓，"永隆昌"原是烟业商号楼主黄万斗、黄万才、黄万鹏三兄弟为纪念他们的父亲黄永昌，取得此名。此楼临近小溪，利用沙滩地，挖基、填方、筑堤，自清咸丰元年至清同治十三年（1851—1874年）终于完成。

建筑群由外大门、门埕、内院、高六层的老楼、老楼后门、中院坪、高五层的新楼、后院坪等组成，纵向两侧还有两层、三层不等的横楼，占地面积达到23300平方米。"大世界基尼斯"将永隆昌楼评为最高的土楼。永豪楼又名五福楼，也被冠以"府第式方楼"之名。

《黄氏族谱》记载："十三世黄宽斋，子五，于道光十一年（1831年）辛卯岁二月初八日在抚溪桥村大洋塅上坝建造五福楼，主楼高六层，坐南朝北，并右片烟棚一所，统计四百余间。道光十八年戊戌岁（1838年）十一月十五日丑时进宅入火，越10余载始臻完备。门首砌堤，左至园埧，右至榕树头下，基础巩固，厥工颇巨。

"此楼事实上是坐西南朝东北，由外大门、门埕、内大门、门厅、中厅、正楼、后楼等组成。主楼高四层；左右两侧横楼高四层，各建四个单元，大门雨坪两侧建有高二层砖木结构的文馆和武馆。说起土楼生活，永豪楼的这个楹联说得最为深刻：上联"礼门通义路"，下联"智水近仁山"，横批"德为邻"。不然诺大的一个家族可怎么共处呢？

English

On the south bank of the Fuxi River, there is a large cluster of 106 earthen buildings stretching 3 kilometers — absolutely the highest-density earthen building area.

The reason for vaguely calling them "earthen buildings" (tulou) and "earthen forts" (tubao) is that experts call the earthen buildings here "mansion-style square buildings," without a particularly precise definition; or rather, the form of Yonglongchang Building lies between conventional earthen buildings and earthen forts — the specific method is to erect large pavilions on the plan of a traditional residence.

The most prominent here are Yonglongchang Building and Yonghao Building; besides earthen buildings and forts, there are also Tianhou Palace, ancient ferry dock ruins, broken wall ruins, and other historic sites.

Yonglongchang Building was formed by using附属 buildings to combine two independent pavilions into one earthen building; one "old building" is in the center, called "Fusheng Building"; the other "new building" serves as the rear building, called "Fushan Building.

" Local residents are surnamed Huang; "Yonglongchang" was originally a tobacco business name, and the building owners Huang Wandou, Huang Wancai, and Huang Wanpeng, three brothers, took this name to commemorate their father Huang Yongchang.

This building is near a small stream, using beach land, with foundation digging, filling, and embankment building; from the first year of Xianfeng reign to the 13th year of Tongzhi reign of the Qing (1851–1874), it was finally completed.

The building complex consists of an outer main gate, gate courtyard, inner courtyard, six-story old building, old building rear gate, middle courtyard, five-story new building, rear courtyard, etc.

, with two- and three-story side buildings of varying heights on both longitudinal sides, covering 23,300 square meters.

"Great World Guinness" rated Yonglongchang Building as the tallest earthen building.Yonghao Building, also known as Wufu Building, is also called a "mansion-style square building.

" The "Genealogy of the Huang Clan" records: "The 13th generation Huang Kuanzhai, with five sons, on the eighth day of the second month of the Xinmao year, the 11th year of Daoguang reign (1831), built Wufu Building at Shangba, Dayangduan, Fuqiaoqiao Village; the main building is six stories high, facing south, with a tobacco shed on the right side, totaling over 400 rooms.

On the fifteenth day of the eleventh month of the Wuxu year, the 18th year of Daoguang reign (1838), at the chou hour, the house was entered and lit; after more than 10 years it was finally complete.

An embankment was built at the gate, extending left to the garden dam and right to under the banyan tree head; the foundation is solid, and the work was quite massive.

" This building in fact faces northeast from southwest, consisting of an outer main gate, gate courtyard, inner main gate, entrance hall, middle hall, main building, rear building, etc.

The main building is four stories high; the side buildings on both left and right are four stories high, each with four units; on both sides of the gate rain courtyard are built two-story brick-wood civil and military halls.

Speaking of life in earthen buildings, this couplet of Yonghao Building says it most profoundly: upper scroll "The gate of ritual connects the road of righteousness," lower scroll "Wise water is near benevolent mountain," horizontal scroll "Virtue as neighbor.

" Otherwise, how could such a large clan live together?

推荐级别：★★★

高北土楼群

No.184
Earthen Building Cluster in Gaobei
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳平市永定县高头乡高北村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
土楼类型土楼结构形式明代遗迹和其他土楼地区一样高北的居民也是客家人当地江姓世代农耕辅植烟茶人满则侨高头溪自西而东流过高北村溪岸土楼农田交错狭长延展2公里
中文 Chinese

和其他土楼地区一样，高北的居民也是客家人。当地江姓，世代农耕，辅植烟茶，人满则侨；高头溪自西而东流过高北村，溪岸土楼农田交错，狭长延展2公里。高北的代表土楼主要有五云楼、世泽楼、承启楼、侨福楼等。

五云楼建于明隆庆年间（1567—1572年），是这里最古老的建筑。

楼是长方形的，高4层，面阔25.8米，9开间，进深24.3米，底层外墙厚1.3米。全楼设一个大门，公用楼梯4道，门外以矮墙围合天井并形成一个院落，外大门正对楼门。

内部采用通廊式，中心院落建一厅堂，水井二眼。楼内墙体做法、木结构、石雕古朴，或多明代遗存。还必须详细介绍的是体量巨大的圆形土楼承启楼。全楼由四圈环形建筑组成，内通廊式交通组织。

外环为主楼，高4层，直径73米；第二环高2层，砖木结构，每层40间；第三环单层，砖木结构，32开间；内环为厅堂，单层，供族人议事、婚丧喜庆等活动之用。

各环建筑外高内低、逐环递减；该楼环与环之间以鹅卵石砌天井相隔，以石砌廊道或小道相连。

据江氏族谱记载，该楼始建于明崇祯年间（1628—1644年），先有的是外环，而后依次建造第二环、第三环和第四环，清康熙四十八年（1709年）最终落成，形成今天的面貌。

此楼堪称环数最多、规模最大的客家圆形土楼，鼎盛时期居住800余人，现仍居住300余人，被誉为"圆楼王"。

English

Like other earthen building regions, the residents of Gaobei are also Hakka people.

The local surname is Jiang, farming for generations, with supplementary cultivation of tobacco and tea; when population is full they emigrate overseas.

Gaotou Stream flows from west to east through Gaobei Village, with earthen buildings and farmland interlaced along the stream banks, stretching narrowly for 2 kilometers.

The representative earthen buildings of Gaobei mainly include Wuyun Building, Shize Building, Chengqi Building, Qiaofu Building, etc.

Wuyun Building was built during the Longqing reign of the Ming (1567–1572), and is the oldest building here.The building is rectangular, 4 stories high, 25.

8 meters wide with 9 bays, 24.3 meters deep, with a bottom exterior wall thickness of 1.3 meters.

The whole building has one main gate and 4 common staircases; outside the gate, a low wall encloses a courtyard and forms a compound, with the outer main gate directly facing the building gate.

The interior uses a corridor-style layout, with a hall built in the central courtyard and two wells.

The wall construction, timber structure, and stone carvings inside the building are simple and ancient, perhaps mostly Ming Dynasty remains.

What must be introduced in detail is the massive round earthen building Chengqi Building.

The whole building consists of four rings of annular architecture, with interior corridor-style traffic organization.

The outer ring is the main building, 4 stories high, 73 meters in diameter; the second ring is 2 stories high, brick-wood structure, 40 rooms per floor; the third ring is single-story, brick-wood structure, 32 bays; the inner ring is a hall, single-story, for clan meetings, weddings, funerals, and celebrations.

Each ring of buildings is higher outside and lower inside, decreasing ring by ring; between the rings, courtyards are paved with cobblestones, connected by stone-paved corridors or paths.

According to the Jiang clan genealogy, this building was first built during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1628–1644), with the outer ring built first, then the second, third, and fourth rings in sequence, finally completed in the 48th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1709), forming its present appearance.

This building can be called the Hakka round earthen building with the most rings and largest scale; at its peak it housed over 800 people, and still houses over 300 people today, known as the "King of Round Buildings.

"

推荐级别：★★★★

Earthen Building Cluster in Hongkeng
级别：省级文物保护单位，振成楼、福裕楼、奎聚楼为全国重点文物保护单位
