特征标签 Highlights
土楼类型土楼结构形式土楼历史和设计者洪坑土楼群的主人姓林土楼一建就是几百年较大的明代土楼有峰盛楼永源楼等十余座较大的清代土楼有福裕楼奎聚楼阳临楼中柱楼等三十余座
中文 Chinese

洪坑土楼群的主人姓林，土楼一建就是几百年。

这里较大的明代土楼有峰盛楼、永源楼等十余座；较大的清代土楼有福裕楼、奎聚楼、阳临楼、中柱楼等三十余座，另有天后宫、日新学堂、林氏宗祠、关帝庙等公共建筑。

这些土楼中奎聚楼、福裕楼、振成楼、如升楼列入全国重点文物保护单位，可以说是洪坑土楼的代表。奎聚楼建成于清道光十四年（1834年），是有清晰正、厢配置的方形大楼。

土楼依山而建，气势恢宏；楼的内部也是高低错落，主次井然。值得注意的是，奎聚楼的设计人是翰林学士巫宜福，与楼主林奎扬是结拜兄弟。福裕楼也是晚清作品，由楼主林仲山、林仁山、林德山三兄弟的朋友汀州知府张星炳设计。三人还捐巨资兴办了当地的"日新学堂"，也是由张星炳的设计作品。

此楼为方形，形制与奎聚楼相类，在主楼的中轴线上有前低后高两座横屋，主次分明。楼前有三个大门，在主楼和横屋之间有小门相隔，外观连成一体、内则分为三大单元。振成楼是圆形土楼，被誉为土楼王子。

楼由双环组成，外环夯土墙连带木结构高4层，直径57.2米，内部通廊联络；楼房呈辐射状8等分，底层...

English

The owners of the Hongkeng Earthen Building Cluster are surnamed Lin, and earthen buildings have been built here for hundreds of years.

The larger Ming Dynasty earthen buildings here include Fengsheng Building, Yongyuan Building, and over ten others; the larger Qing Dynasty earthen buildings include Fuyu Building, Kuiju Building, Yanglin Building, Zhongzhu Building, and over thirty others, plus public buildings such as Tianhou Palace, Rixin School, Lin Clan Ancestral Hall, and Guandi Temple.

Among these earthen buildings, Kuiju Building, Fuyu Building, Zhencheng Building, and Rusheng Building are listed as National Key Cultural Heritage Sites, and can be said to be representatives of Hongkeng earthen buildings.

Kuiju Building was completed in the 14th year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1834), and is a large square building with clear main and wing configuration.

The earthen building was built against the mountain, with imposing momentum; the interior is also高低错落, with primary and secondary well-ordered.

Notably, the designer of Kuiju Building was Hanlin academician Wu Yifu, who was a sworn brother of the building owner Lin Kuiyang.

Fuyu Building is also a late Qing work, designed by Zhang Xingbing, prefect of Tingzhou, a friend of the three building owners Lin Zhongshan, Lin Renshan, and Lin Deshan.

The three also donated large sums to found the local "Rixin School," also a design work by Zhang Xingbing.

This building is square, similar in form to Kuiju Building, with two horizontal buildings on the main building's central axis, lower in front and higher in back, with clear primary and secondary.

There are three main gates in front of the building, with small gates separating the main building and horizontal buildings; externally they appear as one connected body, internally divided into three major units.

Zhencheng Building is a round earthen building, known as the Prince of Earthen Buildings.

The building consists of double rings; the outer ring of rammed earth wall with timber structure is 4 stories high, 57.

2 meters in diameter, with interior corridor connections; the building is radially divided into 8 equal parts, with the bottom floor...

推荐级别：★★★★

南溪土楼群

No.186
Earthen Building Cluster in Nanxi
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳平市永定县湖坑镇南江村、南中村、新南村和下南溪村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
土楼类型土楼结构形式永定县湖坑镇丘陵山区中除了洪坑土楼群之外沿着南溪的实佳南江南中新南和下南溪等村落也保留有土楼被称为南溪土楼群衍香楼和振福楼是必须说到的圆形外观的衍香楼在新南村南溪与奥杳溪交汇于此
中文 Chinese

永定县湖坑镇的丘陵山区中，除了有洪坑土楼群之外，沿着南溪的实佳、南江、南中、新南和下南溪等村落，也保留有土楼，被称为南溪土楼群。衍香楼和振福楼是必须说到的。圆形外观的衍香楼在新南村，南溪与奥杳溪交汇于此。

土楼背依青山，楼后溪畔还藏有一后花园，是旧时读书、练武的地方。该主姓苏，于清道光二十二年（1842年）建楼。

主楼高4层，直径40米，土木结构，内部通廊联络；外墙自下而上逐层递减，一、二层不开窗，底层墙厚1.5米，四层厚0.7米；每层34间，首层设厨房、餐厅；二层设粮仓，三、四层为卧室。二层以上每层的廊檐下设木构小储藏室。

祖堂位于楼中心位置，单层砖木结构，方形平面；主楼与祖堂之间以天井相隔，以廊道小门贯通，地板均以三合土铺面。全楼设一个大门、4道楼梯。楼外不远处还保留两座古桥，与土楼相映成趣。

振福楼也是圆楼，在西片村，由烟业富翁的苏振太于民国二年（1913年）兴建。与洪坑的振成楼一样，或可称为姊妹楼，振福楼是我国近代西方建筑艺术大规模渗入之后的作品。

和二层不开窗，底层为厨房、餐厅，二层为粮仓，三、四层为卧室；内环二层，砖木结构，连着作议事厅、宴客厅、戏台之用的西洋式中心大厅，其中二楼走廊栏杆更是铸铁所成。此楼由洪坑林氏21世林鸿超兄弟等人于民国元年（1912年）建造，因此可以看到很多中西合璧的特点。

而楼的设计人是福裕楼楼主林仁山之子林逊之，他曾经做过中央议员，振成楼内对联几乎全是林逊之的大作。林家人才鼎盛，逊之胞弟林亮之留学日本早稻田大学，获法学博士学位，回国后先后担任闽侯、惠安、宁化县县长。如升楼与福裕楼隔洪川溪相望，是迄今所计最小的圆土楼。

此楼为林家在清光绪年间（1875—1908年）所建，单环，土木结构，高三层；直径23米，16间，内部通廊联络。底层为厨房、餐厅；二层设粮仓；三层为卧室。全楼只设一门，楼内天井中有一口水井。

English

In the hilly mountainous area of Hukeng Town, Yongding County, besides the Hongkeng Earthen Building Cluster, along the Nanxi River in villages such as Shijia, Nanjiang, Nanzhong, Xinnan, and Xiananxi, earthen buildings are also preserved, known as the Nanxi Earthen Building Cluster.

Yanxiang Building and Zhenfu Building must be mentioned.The round-appearance Yanxiang Building is in Xinnan Village, where the Nanxi and Aoyao streams meet.

The earthen building leans against green mountains, and behind the building by the stream there is also a hidden rear garden, a place for reading and martial arts practice in old times.

The owner's surname is Su, and the building was built in the 22nd year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1842).

The main building is 4 stories high, 40 meters in diameter, of earth-wood structure, with interior corridor connections; the exterior wall tapers from bottom to top, with no windows on the first and second stories, bottom wall thickness 1.

5 meters, fourth story wall thickness 0.7 meters; 34 rooms per story, with kitchens and dining rooms on the first story; granaries on the second story; bedrooms on the third and fourth stories.

Above the second story, under the corridor eaves of each story, small wooden storage rooms are set.

The ancestral hall is located at the center of the building, single-story brick-wood structure, square plan; between the main building and ancestral hall separated by courtyards, connected by corridor small doors, floors all paved with sanhetu (triple-mixed earth).

The whole building has one main gate and 4 staircases.Not far outside the building, two ancient bridges are also preserved, forming a charming contrast with the earthen building.

Zhenfu Building is also a round building, in Xipian Village, built by tobacco wealthy man Su Zhentai in the second year of the Republic (1913).

Like Zhencheng Building in Hongkeng, it could be called a sister building; Zhenfu Building is a work after the large-scale infiltration of modern Western architectural art into China.

With no windows on the second story, the first story has kitchens and dining rooms, the second story granaries, and the third and fourth stories bedrooms; the inner ring is two stories, brick-wood structure, connected to a Western-style central hall used as a meeting hall, banquet hall, and stage, among which the second-floor corridor railings are even made of cast iron.

This building was built by Hongkeng Lin clan 21st generation Lin Hongchao brothers and others in the first year of the Republic (1912), so many Chinese-Western combined features can be seen.

The building's designer was Lin Xunzhi, son of Fuyu Building owner Lin Renshan, who once served as a central parliament member; almost all the couplets inside Zhencheng Building are Lin Xunzhi's works.

The Lin family was full of talent; Lin Xunzhi's younger brother Lin Liangzhi studied at Waseda University in Japan, earned a doctorate in law, and after returning to China served successively as county magistrate of Minhou, Hui'an, and Ninghua.

Rusheng Building faces Fuyu Building across the Hongchuan Stream, and is the smallest round earthen building counted to date.

This building was built by the Lin family during the Guangxu reign of the Qing (1875–1908), single ring, earth-wood structure, three stories high; 23 meters in diameter, 16 rooms, interior corridor connections.

The first story has kitchens and dining rooms; the second story has granaries; the third story has bedrooms.

The whole building has only one gate, and there is a well in the courtyard inside the building.

推荐级别：★★★

西陂天后宫

No.187
Temple of the Queen of Heaven in Xibei
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：龙岩市永定县高陂乡西陂村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
塔的结构形式塔心柱登临离开了海边的台风天后宫就可以向天空的方向伸展了西陂天后宫被当地人唤作文塔塔旁就是静静流淌的永定河一高耸一蜿蜒相映成趣
中文 Chinese

或许是离开了海边的台风，天后宫就可以向天空的方向伸展了。西陂天后宫，被当地人唤作"文塔"，塔旁就是静静流淌的永定河，一高耸一蜿蜒，相映成趣。

此宫始建于明嘉靖二十一年（1542年），清康熙元年（1662年）落成，此后也屡经修缮，好在原始建筑做法和特征尤存。

西陂天后宫的主体建筑是天后宫塔，疑为当时利用已成建筑为之或更换了使用功能；塔前有大门、倒座戏台和大厅堂；塔后还有登云馆大厅和天井。

主塔七层，高达40余米；塔基石砌，下层土墙厚1米余；底层为主殿，供奉妈祖，当心有四根大圆木柱，支撑塔体，一周围房；二、三层周围有走廊；四、五层由四方体转为八方体；六、七层中间塔心柱，辐辏为架，板木为墙；最上层施是葫芦形瓷缸顶。

此外，天后宫的壁画、雕塑、石刻、彩绘等装饰也非常丰富，保留诸多可以深入研究的装饰工艺细节。西陂建筑结构及其艺术成就，是国内的天后宫中所罕见的。它的造型，从山水风光、花卉鸟兽以至神话传说、人物典故，无不栩栩如生，堪称一绝。

同时，戏台屏风上彩画的仕女图，古朴风流，与戏台规制均为难得的研究戏曲史的重要实物资料。

English

Perhaps having left the coastal typhoons, Tianhou Palace can extend toward the sky.

Xibei Tianhou Palace is called "Wen Pagoda" (Literature Pagoda) by locals; beside the pagoda is the quietly flowing Yongding River, one towering and one winding, forming a charming contrast.

This palace was first built in the 21st year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1542), completed in the first year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1662), and has since been repeatedly repaired; fortunately, the original architectural methods and features still survive.

The main building of Xibei Tianhou Palace is the Tianhou Palace Pagoda, suspected to have been built using an existing structure at the time or to have had its function changed; in front of the pagoda are a main gate, an opposite-stage theater, and a large hall; behind the pagoda there is also the Dengyun Hall large hall and courtyard.

The main pagoda has seven stories, over 40 meters high; the pagoda base is stone-built, with the lower earthen wall over 1 meter thick; the bottom story is the main hall, enshrining Mazu, with four large round timber columns at the center supporting the pagoda body, surrounded by rooms; the second and third stories have corridors around; the fourth and fifth stories transform from square to octagonal; the sixth and seventh stories have a central pagoda core column, with radiating frames and plank-wood walls; the topmost story is crowned with a gourd-shaped porcelain jar top.

In addition, the decorations of Tianhou Palace such as murals, sculptures, stone carvings, and painted decorations are also very rich, preserving many decorative craft details worthy of in-depth study.

The architectural structure and artistic achievements of Xibei are rare among Tianhou Palaces in China.

Its modeling, from landscapes, flowers, birds, and beasts to myths, legends, and historical anecdotes, is all vivid and lifelike, truly exceptional.

At the same time, the painted maidens on the theater stage screen, simple and elegant, together with the theater stage regulations, are rare important physical materials for studying the history of Chinese opera.

推荐级别：★★★

岩太土楼群

No.188
Earthen Building Cluster in Yantai
级别：无
年代：宋—当代
地址：漳平市永定县陈东乡岩太村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
环境早期土楼痕迹在永定海拔750米以上的山已经非常高了那里的山丘林木梯田多了一个伴侣云雾在此耕作的农人生计虽艰被唤一声仙人也算是对清僻生活的最大慰藉陈东乡岩太村的环境就是这样的
中文 Chinese

在永定，海拔750米以上的山已经非常高了。那里的山丘林木、梯田多了一个伴侣——云雾。在此耕作的农人生计虽艰，被唤一声"仙人"，也算是对清僻生活的最大慰藉了吧。陈东乡岩太村的环境就是这样的，而这里林氏村民们居住的房屋则是26座造型各异的土楼。

这些土楼大大小小，有方有圆，其中还有永定县直径最大的一座土圆楼——福盛楼，直径达到81.6米，虽然稍逊南靖书洋顺裕楼86米的规模，也真难以想象里边到底生活着多少人。事实上福盛楼是"文革"时建设的，至今不过四十多年的光景。

不禁感叹，偏远之地才能躲过汹涌的现代化浪潮，而当地人们的头脑和社会生活还能在这种新的欲望和旧的风气对撞之间坚持多久呢？土楼生活其实依旧年轻，福盛楼的四层布置和传统土楼没有差别：一层是厨房和餐厅，二层是仓库，三层四层是卧室。只不过由于生活的需要，楼内加建改造较多，"新"楼之中已少了近旁"老"楼中常有的生活情趣和味道。

游客在这里最大的要务，一是寻访当地人常说的早期土楼的痕迹，或许真可以追溯到宋朝；二是张开双臂拥抱这里的风景，让这里的空气深入每一个毛孔。农人的要务呢？请您自己也用平静的心体味一下家乡的好处吧……

English

In Yongding, mountains above 750 meters elevation are already very high.There, the hills, forests, and terraced fields have an extra companion — clouds and mist.

Although farmers working here have a hard livelihood, being called "immortals" is perhaps the greatest comfort for their secluded life.

The environment of Yantai Village in Chendong Township is just like this, and the houses where the Lin clan villagers live here are 26 earthen buildings of various shapes.

These earthen buildings, large and small, square and round, include the largest-diameter round earthen building in Yongding County — Fusheng Building, with a diameter of 81.

6 meters; although slightly inferior to the 86-meter scale of Shunyu Building in Shuyang, Nanjing, it is truly hard to imagine how many people live inside.

In fact, Fusheng Building was built during the Cultural Revolution, only about forty years ago.

One cannot help but sigh that only remote places can escape the surging wave of modernization, and how long can the local people's minds and social life persist between the collision of new desires and old customs?

Life in earthen buildings is actually still young; the four-story layout of Fusheng Building is no different from traditional earthen buildings: the first story has kitchens and dining rooms, the second story warehouses, and the third and fourth stories bedrooms.

It's just that due to the needs of life, there are many additions and renovations inside the building, and the "new" building has lost the life charm and flavor often found in the nearby "old" buildings.

The most important tasks for tourists here are: first, to search for traces of early earthen buildings that locals often mention, perhaps truly traceable to the Song Dynasty; second, to open their arms and embrace the scenery here, letting the air penetrate every pore.

And the farmers' tasks?Please yourself use a calm heart to appreciate the benefits of your hometown...

推荐级别：★★★★★

中川胡氏家庙

No.189
Hu's Family Temple in Zhongchuan
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：龙岩市永定县下洋镇中川村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
祠堂环境石雕功名柱用过万金油但不一定知道来自永定下洋镇中川村的胡文虎当得了富甲一方的豪绅但不一定能够在中川胡氏家庙前立一根旗杆中川胡氏家庙又名安定堂是明万历十二年1584年客家胡姓夫妇移民来此百年之后族人兴建的
中文 Chinese

用过万金油，但不一定知道来自永定下洋镇中川村的胡文虎；当得了富甲一方的豪绅，但不一定能够在中川胡氏家庙前立一根旗杆。中川胡氏家庙又名安定堂，是明万历十二年（1584年）客家胡姓夫妇移民来此百年之后族人兴建的。家庙坐西朝东，前有一方池塘，后为一片密林。

宗祠围墙前面和两侧是宽广的草坪，族人举行大型祭祀活动时便会聚集在这里。家庙前草坪上则密密地树立着15支石旗杆（2支因地震倒塌）、21支木旗杆，那是胡家历代功名显赫者所立的功名柱。石杆之上蟠龙生动，字体清晰，雕刻精美大方。

家庙大门开在不高的前围墙上，面向北；转折进入后面向前厅，仅一进院落，歇山顶，抬梁穿斗混合式结构。庙内壁画众多，木雕精美；所有牌位列列两厢；正堂之上悬挂"安定堂"匾额。此外，宗祠之后还有白塔相伴，是胡文虎的女儿捐建，近代修建的。

English

You may have used Tiger Balm, but you may not know it comes from Hu Wenhu of Zhongchuan Village, Xiayang Town, Yongding; you may become a wealthy local magnate, but you may not be able to erect a flagpole in front of the Hu Family Temple in Zhongchuan.

The Hu Family Temple in Zhongchuan, also known as Anding Hall, was built by clan members a hundred years after a Hakka Hu couple immigrated here in the 12th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1584).

The family temple faces east from the west, with a square pond in front and a dense forest behind.

In front of and on both sides of the ancestral hall's enclosure wall are broad lawns, where clan members gather when holding large sacrificial activities.

On the lawn in front of the family temple, 15 stone flagpoles (2 collapsed due to earthquakes) and 21 wooden flagpoles are densely erected — these are the merit pillars (gongming zhu) erected by prominent Hu clan members through the generations.

On the stone poles, coiling dragons are vivid, characters clear, and carvings exquisite and generous.

The main gate of the family temple opens on the low front enclosure wall, facing north; turning in leads to the front hall, with only one courtyard, hip-and-gable roof, and a mixed post-and-lintel and column-and-tie structure.

Inside the temple there are many murals and exquisite wood carvings; all ancestral tablets are lined up on both sides; above the main hall hangs the "Anding Hall" plaque.

In addition, behind the ancestral hall there is also a white pagoda, donated and built by Hu Wenhu's daughter in modern times.

推荐级别：★★★

古田会议旧址

No.190
Site of Gutian Conference
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清—近代
地址：龙岩市上杭县古田镇赖坊村
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
凭吊听说过古田会议吧那是中国共产党成长发展历史上的关键时刻从建筑的角度瞻仰一下古田会议旧址是能给人以不一样的体会会议的旧址原是廖氏宗祠建于清道光年间1848年民国六年1917年修葺后改为小学校舍祠堂背负青山面对大片荷塘
中文 Chinese

听说过古田会议吧，那是中国共产党成长发展历史上的关键时刻；从建筑的角度瞻仰一下古田会议旧址是能给人以不一样的体会。会议的旧址原是廖氏宗祠，建于清道光年间（1848年），民国六年（1917年）修葺后改为小学校舍。

祠堂背负青山，面对大片荷塘，院落规模不是很大，但比较注重细节，清幽而气度不凡；祠堂的正厅装饰考究，梁架上的雕饰比较精致，而全部涂以红色应该是后来出于保护所为，与本地常见的素颜的原木风格不同，已经不是我们经常见到的大厝中厚重的风格。

祠堂旁边的一口井名曰"龙井"，门外面对莲花池，而"古田"的发音在中国的某些地方话中类似于"福田"，这些名称联想起来颇有意趣，也许在预示着什么。当年开会的桌椅还原物保存，很多党员代表和红军将领曾经在这里济济一堂，而毛泽东也曾经在这里发表演说。与我们脑海中的伟人形象不同，他们那时多是虎虎有生气的中青年人。村头有小型廊桥一座，常见的古桥要素一应俱全，名为"红军桥"。

荷花池畔贩卖"仙草"饮品的大姐、捡拾饮料瓶的老人和小孙女在廊桥中休息。刹那间云起了，回眼望红军桥已在远处。

English

You've heard of the Gutian Conference, right?

It was a key moment in the growth and development history of the Communist Party of China; paying respects to the Gutian Conference site from an architectural perspective can give one a different kind of experience.

The conference site was originally the Liao Clan Ancestral Hall, built during the Daoguang reign of the Qing (1848), and after renovation in the sixth year of the Republic (1917), it was converted into a primary school building.

The ancestral hall leans against green mountains and faces a large lotus pond; the courtyard scale is not very large, but it pays attention to details, being quiet and elegant with extraordinary bearing; the main hall of the ancestral hall is exquisitely decorated, with relatively refined carvings on the beam frames, and the all-over red paint should have been applied later for protection — different from the common plain natural wood style locally, it is no longer the heavy style often seen in large mansions.

A well next to the ancestral hall is called "Dragon Well"; outside the gate faces a lotus pond, and the pronunciation of "Gutian" in some Chinese dialects is similar to "Futian" (Blessed Field); these names associated together are quite interesting, perhaps foreshadowing something.

The tables and chairs used at the conference that year are preserved as original objects; many party representatives and Red Army generals once gathered here, and Mao Zedong also delivered speeches here.

Different from the great man image in our minds, they were mostly vigorous young and middle-aged people at that time.

At the village entrance there is a small covered bridge, with all common ancient bridge elements complete, named "Red Army Bridge.

" The elder sister selling "xiancao" (grass jelly) drinks by the lotus pond, the old man picking up beverage bottles, and the little granddaughter rest in the covered bridge.

In an instant clouds rose, and looking back, the Red Army Bridge was already in the distance.

推荐级别：★★★

李氏大宗祠

No.191
Grand Ancestral Temple Complex for Li's Clan
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清—近代
地址：龙岩市上杭县稔田镇官田村
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
围龙屋形式木、石作结构与装饰上杭稔田的山中古来人口和生计或许常常难以共荣八闽六姓始祖李邱游陈刘黄发祥于此地而外侨谋生者众天公不美或是动荡年代里人心因而不定因而近代这里成为了红色的土地和游氏宗祠程门立雪堂刘氏宗祠黄氏宗祠等一样
中文 Chinese

上杭稔田的山中，古来人口和生计或许常常难以共荣。八闽六姓始祖——李、邱、游、陈、刘、黄——发祥于此地，而外侨谋生者众；天公不美或是动荡年代里，人心因而不定，因而近代这里成为了红色的土地。

和游氏宗祠程门立雪堂、刘氏宗祠、黄氏宗祠等一样，稔田的李氏大宗祠是八闽六姓宗祠中影响广大的。

此祠堂也称"惇叙堂"，建成于道光十九年（1839年），本为李氏后裔集资合建，建好后便按捐款数额分配房屋，现在房门上仍标有某公之房间的文字。清宣统三年（1911年），集资1000银元，由上杭庐丰安乡李永久主持维修。

祠堂坐落在一片稻田中，远远望去，四面都有山峦，东边紧靠309省道，相传为"蜘蛛结网"之风水宝地。建筑群坐北朝南，砖木结构，成"回"字形，前方后圆，前低后高，沿南北中轴线前后三重院落，两侧有客厅、侧天井和横屋。祠堂前有一方形池塘，门前有宽广石墁大坪，坪中央有用五色鹅卵石铺砌成阴阳八卦图。

大门为牌坊式石门楼，斗拱仿木，因石材材性，并不刻意追求木作细节，左右各另有二旁门。前院左右连廊，连接中堂，中堂悬山屋顶，满施龙凤花卉彩画，内置十扇七抹内屏门，上部隔心板镌刻明代天顺年间上杭儒学教谕季远撰写的行书《李火德公传》。

内院惇叙堂面阔三间，抬梁减柱，梁架遍施雕刻、彩绘，丁头拱雕刻生动，后壁设神龛，火灰飞腾，颇令人担忧这一院木构。再北为后院及弧形围屋，两间一栋，各设木楼梯，供李氏后裔祭祖时住宿。

English

In the mountains of Rentian, Shanghang, since ancient times population and livelihood perhaps often could not prosper together.

The six surname ancestors of Bamin (Fujian) — Li, Qiu, You, Chen, Liu, Huang — originated here, and many emigrated abroad to make a living; when heaven was unkind or in turbulent times, people's hearts were thus unsettled, and therefore in modern times this became a red land.

Like the You Clan Ancestral Hall Chengmen Lixue Hall, Liu Clan Ancestral Hall, Huang Clan Ancestral Hall, etc.

, the Li Grand Ancestral Hall in Rentian is the most influential among the six surname ancestral halls of Bamin.

This ancestral hall is also called "Dunxu Hall," completed in the 19th year of Daoguang reign (1839), originally built with funds raised collectively by Li clan descendants, and after completion houses were allocated according to donation amounts; today the room doors still bear inscriptions of a certain gentleman's room.

In the third year of Xuantong reign of the Qing (1911), 1,000 silver dollars were raised, and Li Yongjiu of Lufeng'an Township, Shanghang, presided over the repairs.

The ancestral hall sits in a stretch of rice fields; looking from afar, there are mountains on all sides, and to the east it abuts Provincial Highway 309,相传 to be a fengshui treasure land of "spider weaving web.

" The building complex faces south, of brick-wood structure, forming a "回" (Hui) shape, square in front and round behind, low in front and high behind, with three courtyards front to back along the north-south central axis, and living rooms, side courtyards, and horizontal houses on both sides.

In front of the ancestral hall there is a square pond, and in front of the gate there is a broad stone-paved large flat area, with a yin-yang eight-trigram pattern paved with five-colored cobblestones in the center.

The main gate is a paifang-style stone gate tower, with dougong imitating wood; due to the material properties of stone, it does not deliberately pursue woodwork details, and there are two side gates on each side.

The front courtyard has connecting corridors on left and right, connecting to the middle hall; the middle hall has a gable roof (xuanshan ding), fully decorated with dragon-phoenix flower paintings, with ten seven-panel inner screen doors inside, and the upper partition panels are engraved with the running-script "Biography of Li Huode Gong" written by Ji Yuan, Confucian instructor of Shanghang during the Tianshun reign of the Ming.

The inner courtyard Dunxu Hall is three bays wide, with post-and-lintel reduced columns, beam frames fully decorated with carvings and paintings, and vividly carved dingtou brackets (dingtou gong); the rear wall has a shrine, with incense ash flying, quite worrying for this courtyard of wooden structures.

Further north is the rear courtyard and arc-shaped enclosed houses, two rooms per building, each with wooden stairs, for Li clan descendants to stay in during ancestor worship.

推荐级别：★★★

文昌阁

No.192
Wenchang Pavilion
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：龙岩市上杭县蛟洋村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
阁之塔式结构登临龙岩地区保存完好的文昌阁有好几处上杭县蛟洋村境内就矗立着这样一座蛟洋说是村子不过一点也不偏僻比较繁华文昌阁就在道旁外观雄伟而不失灵动与西陂天后宫有异曲同工之妙
中文 Chinese

龙岩地区保存完好的文昌阁有好几处，上杭县蛟洋村境内就矗立着这样一座。蛟洋说是村子，不过一点也不偏僻，比较繁华，文昌阁就在道旁，外观雄伟而不失灵动，与西陂天后宫有异曲同工之妙。上杭文昌阁建于清代乾隆十九年（1754年），外观六层，一层至三层为方形，上为八角形，顶冠红色葫芦，檐角饰凤尾反翘。

内为三层，底层作厅堂，二层为方形神殿，四周设有回廊，顶层八面开窗成阁，厅、堂、殿、阁组成一体，风格独特。木构，通高32米。此处的文昌阁有一与众不同之处——这里曾经是中共闽西一大的会址。参观需要在门口登记，然后有管理人员打开一扇小门，有长长的狭窄楼梯可以通往二层，这里就是当时的主会场了。

会场的摆设简约质朴，使人感觉与当年战斗的历史那么近。试着坐在椅子上体会一下当初的感觉，仿佛导师就在讲台上，是位穿着深蓝色的朴素的中山装，梳着略长的中分头发的中年人，那目光、那谈吐，使人们对中国的未来充满信心。文昌阁内部的装潢其实是非常经典的，用料厚重，到处弥漫着杉木的清香。

和几十公里外连城县境内的文昌阁一样，这里也有妈祖庙，妈祖庙旁边是一条河，河上有一座古桥，桥身是新做的。桥的旁边是宽敞的古道，突出的石板上面打有拴船的圆孔。这里原先应是一处码头，水路交汇，货物集散。

文昌阁的巨大身躯掩映在绿树之间，古老中国的建筑，曾经作为传播着西方先进思想的场所。不过那种天下大同、慈悲为怀、人与人之间谦让自律、看淡物质享受共同追求精神修为的思想境界，似乎不是西方人的发明，而是早就作为理想根植于中国人的心中了。

English

There are several well-preserved Wenchang Pavilions in the Longyan area, and one stands in Jiaoyang Village, Shanghang County.

Jiaoyang is called a village, but it is not remote at all, being quite prosperous; Wenchang Pavilion is right by the road, with a majestic yet lively appearance, sharing the same wonderful effect as Xibei Tianhou Palace.

Shanghang Wenchang Pavilion was built in the 19th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1754), with six stories externally; the first to third stories are square, above which is octagonal, crowned with a red gourd, and the eave corners are decorated with phoenix-tail upturned tips.

Internally it has three stories: the bottom story serves as a hall, the second story is a square divine hall with corridors around, and the top story has windows on eight sides forming a pavilion; hall, chamber, palace, and pavilion form an integrated whole with a unique style.

Timber structure, total height 32 meters.

This Wenchang Pavilion has one distinctive feature — it was once the venue of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China in Western Fujian.

Visiting requires registration at the entrance, then a manager opens a small door, and a long narrow staircase leads to the second story, which was the main meeting venue at that time.

The meeting place furnishings are simple and unadorned, making one feel so close to the fighting history of those years.

Try sitting on a chair to experience the feeling of that time, as if the mentor were right on the podium — a middle-aged man wearing a plain dark blue Zhongshan suit, with slightly long center-parted hair, whose gaze and speech filled people with confidence in China's future.

The interior decoration of Wenchang Pavilion is actually very classic, with heavy materials, and the fragrance of Chinese fir pervades everywhere.

Like the Wenchang Pavilion in Liancheng County dozens of kilometers away, there is also a Mazu Temple here; next to the Mazu Temple is a river, with an ancient bridge over it, the bridge body being newly made.

Beside the bridge is a spacious ancient road, with protruding stone slabs having round holes for tying boats.

This place should originally have been a dock, where waterways converged and goods were collected and distributed.

The massive body of Wenchang Pavilion is hidden among green trees — an ancient Chinese building that once served as a venue for spreading advanced Western ideas.

However, that ideological realm of universal harmony, compassion, mutual humility and self-discipline among people, looking down on material enjoyment and jointly pursuing spiritual cultivation, does not seem to be a Western invention, but was already rooted as an ideal in the hearts of Chinese people long ago.

推荐级别：★★★

文庙

No.193
Temple of Confucius
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：龙岩市上杭县城解放路东段
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木结构乾隆上杭县志载上杭文庙始建于宋嘉定十六年1223年后毁于明嘉靖二十七年1548年在原地重建从现存实物来看保存有大量闽西常见的清代建筑元素尚须深入研究方能洞悉其历史沿革从门前的下马碑开始就算进入了文庙的领地
中文 Chinese

乾隆《上杭县志》载，上杭文庙始建于宋嘉定十六年（1223年），后毁，于明嘉靖二十七年（1548年）在原地重建。

从现存实物来看，保存有大量闽西常见的清代建筑元素，尚须深入研究方能洞悉其历史沿革。从门前的"下马碑"开始，就算进入了文庙的领地。

这里遵循了文庙一般规制：棂星门是中轴线上的第一座建筑，造型简洁古朴而石雕密布，是典型的地方风格；进而是泮池，拱桥其上，素石为栏；泮桥之内，便是戟门了，单檐悬山屋顶，面阔五间，朴素谦逊；左右名宦祠、乡贤祠；入得戟门，面对大成殿，殿前建东、西两庑；大成殿重檐歇山屋顶，面阔五间，上层檐显三间，檐下斗拱密闭，下层施丁头拱，上层施单翘三昂九踩斗拱，逐层出斜拱，颇具装饰效果；殿内结构简明，彩绘和雕刻点缀得当，整体风格素雅庄重；大殿之后，有明伦堂、崇圣殿；中心院落之外还有尊经阁、教谕署、紫阳书院、周公书院、入圣第一门及四斋五祠等多座附属建筑。

徜徉庙中，并无游人，只在侧门之内，有一群长者在排练演奏，拉的曲子都是客家老曲。你我退食之后，可有如此心境？

English

According to the Qianlong-era "Shanghang County Gazetteer," Shanghang Confucian Temple was first built in the 16th year of Jiading reign of the Song (1223), later destroyed, and rebuilt on the original site in the 27th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1548).

From the existing physical remains, a large number of Qing Dynasty architectural elements common in western Fujian are preserved, and in-depth research is still needed to fully understand its historical evolution.

Starting from the "Dismount Stele" in front of the gate, one has entered the territory of the Confucian Temple.

Here the general regulations of Confucian temples are followed: the Lingxing Gate is the first building on the central axis, with a simple and ancient shape and dense stone carvings, a typical local style; next is the Pan Pond, with an arch bridge over it and plain stone railings; inside the Pan Bridge is the Halberd Gate (Ji Men), with a single-eave gable roof, five bays wide, simple and humble; on the left and right are the Official Fame Shrine and Local Worthies Shrine; entering the Halberd Gate, one faces the Dacheng Hall, with east and west side galleries in front of the hall; the Dacheng Hall has a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, five bays wide, with the upper eave showing three bays, dense dougong under the eaves, dingtou brackets on the lower level, and single-qiao three-ang nine-step dougong on the upper level, with diagonal brackets emerging layer by layer, quite decorative; the interior structure is concise, with paintings and carvings appropriately embellished, and the overall style is elegant and solemn; behind the main hall are the Minglun Hall and Chongsheng Hall; beyond the central courtyard there are also many附属 buildings such as the Zunjing Pavilion, Instructor's Office, Ziyang Academy, Zhougong Academy, First Gate to Sainthood, and four studios and five shrines.

Wandering in the temple, there are no tourists; only inside the side gate, a group of elders are rehearsing and playing, all the tunes they play being old Hakka melodies.

After you and I finish our meals, can we have such a state of mind?

推荐级别：★★★

均庆寺

No.194
Junqing Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：龙岩市武平县岩前镇灵岩村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
大殿和木亭的木结构石洞登临嘉泰三年1203年十月周必大写过一篇定光庵记说的是莅汀官员创修定光庵的经过算是比较早的关于定光佛的记载定光佛俗姓郑名自严十七岁出家
中文 Chinese

嘉泰三年（1203年）十月周必大写过一篇《定光庵记》，说的是莅汀官员创修定光庵的经过，算是比较早的关于定光佛的记载。定光佛俗姓郑，名自严，十七岁出家，主要在赣闽两地游学和修行，得道后主要在武平县南安岩和汀州城弘法，"攘凶产祥"，庇佑汀州无水旱疾疫，百姓敬信，官员呵护。

闽西发源，一直到台湾，甚至广布东南亚，定光佛信仰成为联系一方乡亲的纽带。岩前镇在205国道边上。岩前的声名不是依靠国道而盛，却是源于镇中心一座名叫"狮岩"的小石山。狮岩本无奇，奇缘自佑之。

综合周必大《定光庵记》和《临汀志》的记载，定光佛生于五代闽国龙启二年（934年），卒于北宋真宗大中祥符八年（1015年）武平南安旧岩，即岩前的均庆寺。于是这里成为著名的定光佛的根本道场。

寺院建于北宋乾德二年（964年）。元代刘将孙在汀州为官时作《汀州路南安岩均庆禅寺修造记》："大德癸卯（1303年），有旨诵经。环一郡六邑，惟南岩均庆禅寺定光古佛道场有新藏。于是府公莅焉。贝叶新翻，列函严整，宝轮炫耀，栋宇高深。

龙蛇通灵，护持显赫……"，但那时古迹在今天已经难觅踪影了。今天的寺院又叫"均庆院"，南宋绍定三年（1230年）也曾得名"定光院"，是一座重檐三滴水的大殿，结构简明，仅上层檐施七踩如意斗拱。

大殿左右的钟鼓楼都是新建的。不过，古殿中并没有供奉什么定光佛像，它后面的巨大石山才是真正的主角。从均庆院旁边的小路上山，是石山的洞口，芜杂的神仙、菩萨、金刚像之外，中间的是一座木亭，亭内三尊定光古佛像。木亭形式颇古朴，怎乃无法登临琢磨，更无法取样分析，只能等待今后的机缘了。

English

In the tenth month of the third year of Jiatai reign (1203), Zhou Bida wrote an "Account of Dingguang Nunnery," describing the process of officials stationed in Tingzhou founding and repairing Dingguang Nunnery, which is considered a relatively early record about Dingguang Buddha.

Dingguang Buddha's secular surname was Zheng, given name Ziyan; he became a monk at age seventeen, mainly studying and practicing in Jiangxi and Fujian, and after attaining enlightenment mainly propagated the Dharma at Nan'an Rock in Wuping County and in Tingzhou city, "dispelling misfortune and producing auspiciousness," protecting Tingzhou from floods, droughts, and plagues, revered by the people and protected by officials.

Originating in western Fujian, extending to Taiwan, and even spreading widely in Southeast Asia, the Dingguang Buddha faith became a bond connecting local folks.

Yanqian Town is beside National Highway 205.Yanqian's fame did not prosper依靠 the highway, but originated from a small stone mountain in the town center called "Lion Rock" (Shi Yan).

Lion Rock itself is nothing extraordinary, but a strange destiny protects it.

Combining the records in Zhou Bida's "Account of Dingguang Nunnery" and "Lin Ting Zhi," Dingguang Buddha was born in the second year of Longqi reign of the Min Kingdom in the Five Dynasties (934), and died in the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu reign of Emperor Zhenzong of the Northern Song (1015) at the old Nan'an Rock in Wuping, i.

e., Junqing Temple in Yanqian.Thus this place became the famous fundamental道场 of Dingguang Buddha.

The temple was built in the second year of Qiande reign of the Northern Song (964).

In the Yuan Dynasty, Liu Jiangsun, while serving as an official in Tingzhou, wrote "Account of the Repair of Junqing Chan Temple at Nan'an Rock, Tingzhou Route": "In the Gui-mao year of Dade reign (1303), there was an imperial decree to recite sutras.

Around one prefecture and six counties, only the Nan'an Rock Junqing Chan Temple, the道场 of the ancient Dingguang Buddha, had a new scripture repository.Then the prefect arrived.

Newly translated palm-leaf scriptures, neatly arranged in cases, precious wheels shining, buildings tall and deep.Dragons and snakes communicate with spirits, protection and support are illustrious...

" but those ancient sites are hard to find traces of today.

Today's temple is also called "Junqing Courtyard," and in the third year of Shaoding reign of the Southern Song (1230) it was also named "Dingguang Courtyard"; it is a main hall with double eaves and three water-drops, with a concise structure, only the upper eave having seven-step ruyi dougong.

The bell and drum towers on both sides of the main hall are all newly built.

However, the ancient hall does not enshrine any Dingguang Buddha statue; the huge stone mountain behind it is the real protagonist.

Going up the mountain from the small path beside Junqing Courtyard, one reaches the cave entrance of the stone mountain; besides miscellaneous statues of immortals, bodhisattvas, and vajra warriors, in the center is a wooden pavilion, with three ancient Dingguang Buddha statues inside.

The wooden pavilion is quite ancient in form, but unfortunately one cannot climb up to examine it closely, nor can one take samples for analysis — one can only wait for future opportunities.

推荐级别：★★★

梁野山白云禅寺

No.195
White Cloud Zen Temple at Liangye Mountain
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：元
地址：龙岩市武平县梁野山风景区内中堡镇坑头村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石结构做法梁野山叫作梁野仙山自有它的道理山里的风景其实在闽西北并不少见但是这里有水有纵横奔流的瀑布天籁之声动静之景多了一种感官的享受山中峰岩奇异更有沟壑洞穴季节合适的话花草自来亲人有微风还有泉水洗去寻访古建筑路途中的一切疲惫
中文 Chinese

梁野山叫作"梁野仙山"，自有它的道理。山里的风景其实在闽西北并不少见，但是这里有水，有纵横奔流的瀑布，天籁之声，动静之景，多了一种感官的享受。山中峰岩奇异，更有沟壑洞穴，季节合适的话，花草自来亲人。有微风，还有泉水，洗去寻访古建筑路途中的一切疲惫。白云禅寺所在的坑头村，还在野猪凹和杉树窝的里边，从名字就可以想见它的深邃。

这样的地方成为定光佛的道场，也说明定光崇拜的深入民心。白云寺原建于景区内的仙人洞口，后毁，今天的寺院始建于宋代，清康熙六十一年（1722年）重建，坐落在山中的一块平地，前面静卧着一汪清水。

寺院是面朝西北的，外观看来整体都是用石块砌筑的，建筑内部，墙体、梁、柱也均石构。规模不大，只有一进院子。大门连着前殿，内有天井，然后就是大殿，两侧横屋。前殿面阔三间。

大殿也是面阔三间，进深较大，殿内立了八根元代大石柱，是罕见的元代仿木石构遗存。白云禅寺附近，还有一座清康熙十四年（1675年）建的普通舍利塔，塔中安放有临济宗祖师的舍利。

English

Liangye Mountain is called "Liangye Immortal Mountain," and it has its own reasons.

The scenery in the mountains is actually not rare in northwestern Fujian, but here there is water, with crisscrossing rushing waterfalls, the sounds of nature, and scenes of both movement and stillness, adding a kind of sensory enjoyment.

The peaks and rocks in the mountains are strange, and there are even gullies and caves; when the season is right, flowers and plants naturally come close to people.

There are gentle breezes and also spring water, washing away all fatigue on the journey to visit ancient buildings.

Kengtou Village, where White Cloud Zen Temple is located, is still inside Yezhu'ao (Wild Boar Hollow) and Shanshuwo (Fir Tree Nest), and from the names one can imagine its depth.

Such a place becoming the道场 of Dingguang Buddha also说明 how deeply rooted the Dingguang worship is in people's hearts.

White Cloud Temple was originally built at the Immortal Cave entrance in the scenic area, later destroyed; today's temple was first built in the Song Dynasty and rebuilt in the 61st year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1722), sitting on a flat ground in the mountains, with a pool of clear water quietly lying in front.

The temple faces northwest; externally it appears to be entirely built of stone blocks, and inside the building, the walls, beams, and columns are also all stone structures.

It is not large in scale, with only one courtyard.The main gate connects to the front hall, with a courtyard inside, then the main hall, with horizontal houses on both sides.

The front hall is three bays wide.

The main hall is also three bays wide, with a relatively large depth; inside the hall stand eight large stone columns from the Yuan Dynasty, a rare surviving example of Yuan Dynasty stone structure imitating wood.

Near White Cloud Zen Temple, there is also an ordinary stupa (reliquary tower) built in the 14th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1675), in which the relics of the Linji sect patriarch are enshrined.

推荐级别：★★★

客家宗祠群

No.196
Hakka Ancestral Temple Complexes
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：龙岩市长汀县汀州镇
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
祠堂群木结构和砖石装饰做法唐初开始长汀便成为从中州辗转迁徙而来的客家先民躲避战乱和灾荒的落脚点开基创业的同时对故乡的怀念和对祖先的眷恋便以宗祠的形式兴建了起来这一建就是千百年这一建就是一条条的宗祠街一片片的宗祠群长汀客家宗祠群在长汀的汀州镇
中文 Chinese

唐初开始，长汀便成为从中州辗转迁徙而来的客家先民躲避战乱和灾荒的落脚点。开基创业的同时，对故乡的怀念和对祖先的眷恋便以宗祠的形式兴建了起来。这一建就是千百年，这一建就是一条条的宗祠街，一片片的宗祠群。

长汀客家宗祠群在长汀的汀州镇，有连成片的新新巷家祠群，还有分散在城里的林氏家庙、赖氏家庙、邱公祠、刘氏家庙等。新新巷家祠群在南大街历史街区，横跨新新巷及中心巷，总占地面积近3000余平方米，包括曾宅、郑氏家庙、罗氏家庙、傅氏家庙、赖氏宗祠等五座家祠家庙，均为清代所建。

建筑采用砖木混合结构，平面与府第无异，一般是由前坪、门楼、门厅、天井、正厅、横屋、后花台、后排房等建筑组成。在分散的几座家祠中，刘氏家庙在城内东门街劳动巷七号，北靠卧龙山，面对宝珠南屏山，地理位置绝佳。祠堂称为"王衙"，是因为初祀三国时蜀汉昭烈帝刘备次子鲁王刘永公及入闽始祖刘祥公。

始建于北宋淳化三年（992年），后经过历代修缮鼎新。祠堂为各地客家刘姓集资建造，称"刘氏总祠"。主要建筑包括门楼、边门、照壁，院内上中下三大厅，还有后楼、化胎祠、福德祠、朱子阁、桃园结义亭，以及左右横屋。

家庙正堂，单檐歇山顶式，面阔三间，抬梁式结构，屋顶琉璃瓦面。

English

From the early Tang Dynasty, Changting became a foothold for Hakka ancestors who migrated from the Central Plains to avoid wars and famines.

While establishing their foundations, the nostalgia for their hometown and attachment to their ancestors was expressed through the construction of ancestral halls.

This construction lasted for thousands of years, creating street after street of ancestral halls and cluster after cluster of ancestral hall complexes.

The Changting Hakka Ancestral Temple Complexes are in Tingzhou Town, Changting, with the contiguous Xinxin Lane ancestral hall cluster, as well as scattered Lin Clan Family Temple, Lai Clan Family Temple, Qiu Gong Shrine, Liu Clan Family Temple, etc.

in the city.

The Xinxin Lane ancestral hall cluster is in the South Street historical district, spanning Xinxin Lane and Central Lane, with a total area of nearly 3,000 square meters, including five family temples and ancestral halls: Zeng Residence, Zheng Clan Family Temple, Luo Clan Family Temple, Fu Clan Family Temple, and Lai Clan Ancestral Hall, all built in the Qing Dynasty.

The buildings use a brick-wood mixed structure, with plans no different from mansions, generally consisting of front flat area, gate tower, entrance hall, courtyard, main hall, horizontal houses, rear flower terrace, and rear row of rooms.

Among the scattered family temples, the Liu Clan Family Temple is at No.

7 Laodong Lane, Dongmen Street in the city, backed by Wolong Mountain and facing Baozhu Nanping Mountain, with an excellent geographical location.

The ancestral hall is called "Wang Ya" (Royal Mansion) because it originally enshrined Liu Yong, the second son of Liu Bei (Emperor Zhaolie of Shu Han in the Three Kingdoms period), and Liu Xiang, the first ancestor of the Liu clan who entered Fujian.

It was first built in the third year of Chunhua reign of the Northern Song (992), and later repaired and renovated through successive dynasties.

The ancestral hall was built with funds raised by Hakka Liu clan members from various places, called the "Liu Clan General Ancestral Hall.

" The main buildings include the gate tower, side gate, and screen wall; inside the courtyard are three large halls upper, middle, and lower; there are also the rear building, Huatai Shrine, Fude Shrine, Zhuzi Pavilion, Taoyuan Jieyi Pavilion, and left and right horizontal houses.

The main hall of the family temple has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, three bays wide, post-and-lintel structure, with glazed tile roof.

推荐级别：★★★

汀州城墙

No.197
City Wall of Tingzhou
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：明—清—现代
地址：龙岩市长汀县汀州镇
类型：城防设施
特征标签 Highlights
古城复原部分和原始遗迹城楼围城伴随着中国人好几千年但今天能与围城相伴生活的却已经不多了近年来努力将古城申报世界文化遗产的意义也便在于此汀州城墙历史悠久最早是唐大历四年769年汀州刺史陈剑将州治从东坊口大丘头迁移到现在的位置
中文 Chinese

"围城"伴随着中国人好几千年，但今天能与围城相伴生活的却已经不多了。近年来努力将古城申报世界文化遗产的意义也便在于此吧。汀州城墙历史悠久。最早是唐大历四年（769年），汀州刺史陈剑将州治从东坊口大丘头迁移到现在的位置。

宋治平三年（1066年），郡守刘均扩大规模，城墙周长增加到了"五里二百五十四步"，基宽3丈，高1.8丈，城壕深1.5丈。明洪武四年（1371年）重修，包以砖石。

明弘治十一年（1499年），增建门楼。崇祯九年（1635年）筑门且将城墙增高加厚。清顺治以后，还有几次重修。至1924年，城墙大部分被拆毁，余者十之二三。

鼎盛时期，汀州古城墙总长达到5公里，一周设有12个城门。算上近来修复的，现在保存完好的城墙近3000米，将朝天门、五通门、惠吉门、宝珠门联结在一起。汀州城墙的特点在山水。所谓"枕山临溪为城"，山中有城，城中有水。城墙从卧龙山顶金沙寺延伸下来，城墙垛口点点相连，恰似一串佛珠，被人们称为"佛挂珠"。

城墙塑造生活，城门、城楼塑造形象。长汀城墙现存城楼有朝天门城、三元阁（明崇祯以前称广储门）、五通门、惠吉门、宝珠门，这里的城墙垛口等都是新近恢复的，城门楼都是明清时期的建筑。

其中朝天门楼在位于东大街，清代重建，城台和城门都是砖筑，城楼楼阁式双层砖木结构，面阔三间，进深二间，重檐歇山顶。

三元阁城楼在和平路，花岗石砌基，青砖城台，城楼二层，青砖墙身，原为"四檐三层"，现存建筑上层大木结构五间，进深四间，下层则面阔三大间，檐下丁头拱挑檐，柱下保留早期八角覆盆式石柱础。

宝珠门楼下南大街穿过，是明朝汀州的正南门，双重城门，中间有天窗，城门两廊设养马槽，门楼两层，砖石为墙，内木结构为骨架，重檐歇山顶。

English

"Encircling cities" have accompanied Chinese people for thousands of years, but today not many still live alongside encircling city walls.

The significance of recent efforts to apply for the ancient city to become a World Cultural Heritage lies precisely in this.The Tingzhou City Wall has a long history.

The earliest was in the fourth year of Dali reign of the Tang (769), when Chen Jian, prefect of Tingzhou, moved the prefectural seat from Dongfangkou Daqiutou to its current location.

In the third year of Zhiping reign of the Song (1066), Prefect Liu Jun expanded the scale, increasing the city wall circumference to "five li and two hundred fifty-four paces," with a base width of 3 zhang, height of 1.

8 zhang, and moat depth of 1.5 zhang.In the fourth year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1371), it was repaired and wrapped with brick and stone.

In the 11th year of Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1499), gate towers were added.In the ninth year of Chongzhen reign (1635), gates were built and the city wall was raised and thickened.

After the Shunzhi reign of the Qing, there were several more repairs.By 1924, most of the city wall had been demolished, with only two or three tenths remaining.

At its peak, the total length of the Tingzhou ancient city wall reached 5 kilometers, with 12 city gates around the circumference.

Including recently restored sections, the well-preserved city wall now is nearly 3,000 meters, connecting Chaotian Gate, Wutong Gate, Huiji Gate, and Baozhu Gate.

The characteristic of the Tingzhou City Wall lies in its landscape.The so-called "city leaning on mountains and facing streams" means there is a city within the mountains and water within the city.

The city wall extends down from Jinsha Temple at the top of Wolong Mountain, with the crenellations connected point by point, just like a string of Buddhist beads, called by people "Buddha Hanging Beads.

" The city wall shapes life, while the gates and gate towers shape the image.

The existing gate towers of the Changting city wall include Chaotian Gate Tower, Sanyuan Pavilion (called Guangchu Gate before Chongzhen reign of the Ming), Wutong Gate, Huiji Gate, and Baozhu Gate; the crenellations here are all recently restored, and the gate towers are all Ming-Qing period buildings.

Among them, Chaotian Gate Tower is on East Street, rebuilt in the Qing, with both the gate platform and gate built of brick; the gate tower is a pavilion-style double-story brick-wood structure, three bays wide, two bays deep, with double-eave hip-and-gable roof.

Sanyuan Pavilion Gate Tower is on Heping Road, with granite base and blue-brick gate platform; the gate tower is two stories with blue-brick walls, originally "four eaves and three stories"; the existing building's upper story has five bays of major timber structure, four bays deep, while the lower story is three major bays wide, with dingtou brackets under the eaves supporting the eaves, and early octagonal inverted-bowl stone column bases preserved under the columns.

Baozhu Gate Tower, with South Street passing through underneath, was the main south gate of Tingzhou in the Ming Dynasty, with double gates and a skylight in between; horse troughs are set in both corridors of the gate; the gate tower is two stories, with brick-stone walls and internal timber structure as the skeleton, with double-eave hip-and-gable roof.

推荐级别：★★★

汀州府城隍庙

No.198
Temple of City God in Tingzhou Prefecture
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：龙岩市长汀县城关汀州镇兆征路
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局大殿木结构有汀州城一定就要供奉好城隍祭祀城隍神的例规形成于南北朝唐宋渐盛宋代已列为国家祀典这样算来汀州城隍庙或许也可追溯到1200多年前的唐大历年间但是从建筑的特征来看现存庙宇应当是清代的作品
中文 Chinese

有汀州城，一定就要供奉好城隍。祭祀城隍神的例规形成于南北朝，唐宋渐盛，宋代已列为国家祀典。这样算来，汀州城隍庙或许也可追溯到1200多年前的唐大历年间。

但是从建筑的特征来看，现存庙宇应当是清代的作品，建筑开间所反映出的基址规模和特征则古意颇浓。汀州城隍庙尺度不小但是规模不大，只两进院子，由石牌楼、前殿、正殿、后殿、东宫及两厢等建筑组成。前院空旷，或者历史上还有其他建筑。

据说，这是福建省现存规模最大的城隍庙，颇令人感到诧异。如此多的城、堡，如此繁忙的战争和商旅，竟没有制度更严谨些的城隍庙吗？此现象或许说明城隍信仰在当地不是特别兴旺，也许早已被繁多的宗教、礼制祭祀冲淡了。

满目文庙、宗祠、妈祖庙、定光寺的地方，留给城隍这样宽敞的一席之地便足资敬重了。石牌楼是福建地方一贯的高水准——造型端庄，雕刻细腻，线脚合理，整体上繁简得当。大院东西两廊60米长，内有复原的十殿阎君壁画。

主殿三间，明间尤为宽阔，采用移柱结构，悬单檐歇山顶，而明间之上更施一歇山顶小楼，造型独特。大殿柱头科斗拱装饰丰富，楼檐下如意斗拱弥补。

大殿的石雕龙柱、石刻对联依旧。值得一提的是大殿内"九命荷荣封衮冕辉煌位伯子男之上，全汀昭世守金汤巩固神显山川社稷之间"的对联在浩劫年代得以被有心人用泥巴封住，今天真迹才得以复见天日。

English

Where there is a Tingzhou city, there must certainly be a well-enshrined City God.

The ritual of sacrificing to the City God deity formed during the Northern and Southern Dynasties, gradually flourished in the Tang and Song, and was listed as a state sacrifice in the Song Dynasty.

Counting this way, the Tingzhou City God Temple may perhaps be traced back to the Dali reign of the Tang over 1,200 years ago.

However, judging from the architectural features, the existing temple should be a Qing Dynasty work, while the scale and characteristics of the foundation site reflected by the building bays are quite rich in ancient meaning.

The Tingzhou City God Temple is not small in dimensions but not large in scale, with only two courtyards, consisting of a stone paifang, front hall, main hall, rear hall, east palace, and two side wings.

The front courtyard is open and empty, perhaps there were other buildings historically.

It is said that this is the largest existing City God Temple in Fujian Province, which is quite surprising.

With so many cities and forts, such busy wars and commerce, was there not a City God Temple with more rigorous institutions?

This phenomenon perhaps说明 that the City God faith was not particularly prosperous locally, perhaps早已 diluted by the numerous religious and ritual sacrifices.

In a place filled with Confucian temples, ancestral halls, Mazu temples, and Dingguang temples, leaving such a spacious place for the City God is sufficient to show respect.

The stone paifang maintains Fujian's consistently high standard — dignified modeling, delicate carvings, reasonable moldings, and overall appropriate balance of complexity and simplicity.

The east and west corridors of the large courtyard are 60 meters long, with restored murals of the Ten Halls of Yama inside.

The main hall has three bays, with the central bay particularly wide, using a column-shifting structure, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof; above the central bay there is an additional small hip-and-gable roof building, with a unique shape.

The column-head dougong of the main hall are richly decorated, with ruyi dougong under the tower eaves making up for it.

The stone-carved dragon columns and stone-carved couplets of the main hall remain as before.

It is worth mentioning that the couplet inside the main hall — "Nine ranks bear glorious enfeoffment, ceremonial robes and crowns resplendent, ranked above earls, viscounts, and barons; all Tingzhou manifests hereditary defense, golden walls and solid moats, the deity manifests between mountains, rivers, and the state" — was sealed with mud by a caring person during the calamitous years, and today the true work has finally seen the light of day again.

推荐级别：★★★

汀州文庙

No.199
Temple of Confucius in Tingzhou
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：龙岩市长汀县城关兆征路20号
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
文庙格局大殿木结构距离城隍庙不远还有汀州文庙是汀属八县推崇儒教的场所与福建现存最大的城隍庙规模形成对比的是这座文庙显然不是福建之最但是历史上曾经拥有庞大的建筑群包括现在的长汀县政府大院的大部县人大办公楼的全部
中文 Chinese

距离城隍庙不远，还有汀州文庙，是汀属八县推崇儒教的场所。与福建现存最大的城隍庙规模形成对比的是，这座文庙显然不是福建之最，但是历史上曾经拥有庞大的建筑群，包括现在的长汀县政府大院的大部，县人大办公楼的全部。

现存的核心部分尚且包括棂星门、泮池、拱桥、仪门、门庑斋舍、文会堂、题名策，名宦乡贤祠、大成殿、崇贤祠等建筑。汀州文庙建于宋绍兴三年（1333年），其后历代都有维修之举。而最近的一次重振文庙威严的举措是1995年后重建棂星门。

棂星门虽然熬过了"文化大革命"，但是没有熬过"文化大革命"带来的愚昧，1980年遭到了拆除，原地居然盖起了四层的文化大楼，俯视文庙"遗骸"。所幸这座"伪文化"大楼短寿。今天棂星门的石料、石雕还显得光洁崭新，想来时间会给予它阅历，敬重会带给它威严吧。

进入仪门，便是文庙大成殿。这里无疑是建筑群的高潮。大殿面阔三间，进深三间，抬梁式木构架，重檐歇山顶，檐下如意斗拱交织。

整体看来开间宽广，明间更大，跨度7.35米，大额枋砍制月梁形，用材硕大，金柱直径均不小于40厘米。殿身主体前设卷棚式前廊，明间当中独立一门楼，如意斗拱和花板相间排列。

室内部分明间正中四面卷棚中出挑三层如意斗拱承托藻井，角垂花柱；次间为三扇井口天花，绘有龙凤、花草。

English

Not far from the City God Temple, there is also the Tingzhou Confucian Temple, a place for the eight counties under Tingzhou to venerate Confucianism.

In contrast to the scale of Fujian's largest existing City God Temple, this Confucian temple is obviously not the largest in Fujian, but historically it once had a massive building complex, including most of the current Changting County Government compound and the entire County People's Congress office building.

The existing core part still includes the Lingxing Gate, Pan Pond, arch bridge, Yi Gate, gate-side rooms and study halls, Wenhui Hall, inscription hall, Official Fame and Local Worthies Shrine, Dacheng Hall, and Chongxian Shrine.

The Tingzhou Confucian Temple was built in the third year of Shaoxing reign of the Song (1333), and has been repaired in successive dynasties thereafter.

The most recent measure to restore the majesty of the Confucian temple was the rebuilding of the Lingxing Gate after 1995.

Although the Lingxing Gate survived the Cultural Revolution, it did not survive the ignorance brought by the Cultural Revolution; it was demolished in 1980, and a four-story cultural building was actually built on the original site, overlooking the "remains" of the Confucian temple.

Fortunately, this "pseudo-cultural" building was short-lived.

Today the stone materials and carvings of the Lingxing Gate still appear clean and brand new; presumably time will give it experience, and respect will bring it majesty.

Entering the Yi Gate, one reaches the Dacheng Hall of the Confucian temple.This is undoubtedly the climax of the building complex.

The main hall is three bays wide and three bays deep, with a post-and-lintel timber frame, double-eave hip-and-gable roof, and interwoven ruyi dougong under the eaves.

Overall, the bays are wide, with the central bay even larger, spanning 7.

35 meters; the large eave lintel is hewn into a moon-beam shape, with massive materials, and the golden columns are all no less than 40 centimeters in diameter.

The main body of the hall has a curved-roof front porch in front, with an independent gate tower in the center of the central bay, with ruyi dougong and decorative panels arranged alternately.

In the interior, at the center of the central bay, three layers of ruyi dougong project from the four-sided curved ceiling to support the caisson, with hanging columns at the corners; the secondary bays have three panels of coffered ceiling, painted with dragons, phoenixes, flowers, and plants.

推荐级别：★★★

璧洲文昌阁

No.200
Wenchang Pavilion in Bizhou
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：龙岩连城县莒溪镇璧洲村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
建筑造型木结构位于连城县莒溪镇璧洲村口的文昌阁始建于清康熙三十一年1692年因相邻天后宫与永隆桥形成如今璧洲村三位一体景观虽历经风雨仍保存完好连城文昌阁建筑造型别具一格
中文 Chinese

位于连城县莒溪镇璧洲村口的文昌阁，始建于清康熙三十一年（1692年）。因相邻天后宫与永隆桥，形成如今璧洲村三位一体景观，虽历经风雨，仍保存完好。连城文昌阁建筑造型别具一格。第一、二层为四方形，以杉木与青砖为主要建筑材料。第二层四周有走马楼相通。

第三层至阁顶采用木质悬臂结构成八角形，融宝塔式与宫殿式于一体，塔尖嵌一大葫芦为顶。阁下楼令人炫目的斗拱结构，在客家人聚居之地这种建筑结构很多见，似乎手到擒来。阁门前建莲花池，砖石结构拱桥将池一分为二。阁底大厅神台同设"文昌帝君"与"十友公"牌位供乡民祭奉。偶遇担当文昌阁管理职责的林君，虽值班之际...

English

The Wenchang Pavilion located at the entrance of Bizhou Village, Juxi Town, Liancheng County, was first built in the 31st year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1692).

Because it is adjacent to Tianhou Palace and Yonglong Bridge, it forms today's trinity landscape of Bizhou Village; despite weathering through storms, it remains well preserved.

The architectural shape of Liancheng Wenchang Pavilion is unique.The first and second stories are square, using Chinese fir and blue brick as the main building materials.

The second story has a horse-walking gallery (zouma lou) connecting around all four sides.

From the third story to the top of the pavilion, a wooden cantilever structure forms an octagonal shape, integrating pagoda style and palace style into one, with a large gourd embedded at the spire as the top.

The dazzling dougong structure under the pavilion is very common in Hakka聚居 areas, seemingly effortlessly achieved.

A lotus pond is built in front of the pavilion gate, and a brick-stone arch bridge divides the pond into two.

In the main hall at the bottom of the pavilion, the altar simultaneously enshrines the tablets of "Wenchang Dijun" (God of Literature) and "Shiyou Gong" for villagers to worship.

I happened to meet Mr.Lin, who is responsible for managing Wenchang Pavilion, although it was during his duty shift...

民居格局结构工艺装饰做法去往培田的路上午后的阳光如此炽烈空气透亮刹那间有些恍惚怎么仿佛是拉萨城外哲蚌寺的天空村口的标志建筑是进士坊这里有一大片荷塘
中文 Chinese

去往培田的路上，午后的阳光如此炽烈，空气透亮，刹那间有些恍惚：怎么仿佛是拉萨城外哲蚌寺的天空？村口的标志建筑是进士坊，这里有一大片荷塘，又不禁想起避暑山庄的烟雨楼。或者你和我一样幸运，可以遇到进士的后人吴老带你走遍全村。吴老虽说是一普通老者，但谈吐文雅，对村中的文化古迹如数家珍，看得出家学渊源，不失大家风范。

培田古村，被誉为"福建省民居第一村"，因为这个村民仅1000多人的小村落留下一笔巨大的遗产：30幢大宅、21座祠堂、6处书院、1条千米古街、2座跨街牌坊、4处庵庙道观。

这里的人们都自称是客家人，语言和风俗都是客家文化。公祠是全村人祭祀共祖之地。老的戏台至今还在发挥功用，除了祭祀时刻演戏之外，晚上居然在这里放电影。公祠门前的石鼓固然威严，也默许贩卖小商品的大姐在那里休息。无论何种世外桃源，过去的"宗族"是一切道德实现的保障；从建筑角度来说，礼制建筑数量极多，地位极崇。这里没有人敢私搭乱建，否则的话"罚不予祭三年"。

还有一处祠堂，曾经是全村最大者，毁于1995年一场大火。其时正是村子决定"开放"的前后。站在...

English

On the way to Peitian, the afternoon sun was so blazing and the air so transparent that for a moment I felt a bit trance: how could it seem like the sky outside Drepung Monastery in Lhasa?

The landmark building at the village entrance is the Jinshi (Palace Graduate) Archway, and there is a large lotus pond here, which inevitably reminds one of the Yanyu Tower of the Imperial Summer Resort.

Or if you are as lucky as me, you may meet Old Wu, a descendant of the palace graduate, who will take you through the whole village.

Although Old Wu is an ordinary elderly man, he speaks elegantly and knows the village's cultural relics like the back of his hand, showing his family scholarly heritage without losing the demeanor of a great family.

Peitian Ancient Village is known as "the No.

1 residential village in Fujian Province," because this small village of only over 1,000 people has left a huge legacy: 30 large mansions, 21 ancestral halls, 6 academies, 1 kilometer-long ancient street, 2 cross-street archways, and 4 temples and Taoist shrines.

The people here all call themselves Hakka, and their language and customs are all Hakka culture.

The public ancestral hall is the place where the whole village sacrifices to their common ancestors.

The old stage still functions today; besides performing operas during sacrificial times, movies are actually shown here at night.

The stone drums in front of the public ancestral hall are certainly majestic, but they also默许 the elder sister selling small goods to rest there.

Whatever kind of paradise, in the past the "clan" was the guarantee for the realization of all morality; from an architectural perspective, ritual buildings are extremely numerous and hold a very high status.

No one here dares to build unauthorized structures, otherwise they would be "punished by being forbidden from sacrificing for three years.

" There is another ancestral hall, once the largest in the village, which was destroyed by a fire in 1995.That was just around the time the village decided to "open up." Standing...

万隆桥

No.202
Wanlong Bridge
级别：无
年代：清
地址：龙岩市连城县濑源乡上村
类型：桥梁·木桥
特征标签 Highlights
木桥结构六角阁楼小木作工艺初闻万隆桥是在一篇客家人办的文学刊物上只是简短的文字说明并无图片吸引我的一句话是藏于深闺难掩其秀说去就去了大山深处狭窄的村际公路上路虽然很窄但周围很少有车
中文 Chinese

初闻万隆桥是在一篇客家人办的文学刊物上，只是简短的文字说明，并无图片，吸引我的一句话是"藏于深闺，难掩其秀"。说去就去了。大山深处狭窄的村际公路上，路虽然很窄，但周围很少有车。经过一个叫"罗圣"的村庄，无意间发现一座小型廊桥，名叫"大安"。桥外有古老的水车还在运转。

桥虽不大但募捐善款的人士名单却历历在目，几笔勾勒出古老山村的淳朴民风。车行愈深，越发感到这里山区的与众不同。濑源乡是红军的发祥地，当年最早在这里成立苏维埃政权。战斗的岁月过去了，现在这里是一片和平的气息。深山中盛产竹子，到处可见竹制品晾晒在路边。在乡人的指引下沿着村头大树的小道下去，一座精美的廊桥出现在眼前，这就是万隆桥。

万隆桥也是小型廊桥，不过它的特点在于精巧别致，尤其顶部的六角形的阁楼做得神采飞扬，其工艺的精湛令人惊叹。万隆桥完全隐藏在青山秀水之中，有淙淙小溪从桥边流过，溪水清澈，水底的石头五彩斑斓，竟不知在此山野之中何来如此精美的廊桥，谁人将它建成又抛掷在此。

桥内是穿斗式木架构，地面用木板，比较陈旧，风雨板半开，廊屋内光线好，休息用的长条木板是后做的。廊屋内原有神龛，神龛上部高悬"万隆桥"匾额。廊屋内部的木工活非常精美，从外面的阁楼延伸到廊屋内部的神龛斗拱，应该是出于一人之手。站在桥内看着外面的翠竹，听着潺潺的流水，感觉十分凉爽。

耳边不断的蝉声鸟鸣，梁架上竟有小松鼠爬过，这一切让人陡然忘却远道而来一路驾车的疲惫。这样的风景如果没有万隆桥与其相伴，或者也就寻常了。突然领略到一句话，即最好的东西就在眼前，最美的时光就是当下。

English

I first heard of Wanlong Bridge in a literary magazine run by Hakka people, with only a brief text description and no pictures; the sentence that attracted me was "hidden in the deep boudoir, yet its beauty cannot be concealed.

" I went as soon as I said so.On the narrow inter-village road deep in the mountains, although the road was very narrow, there were few cars around.

Passing through a village called "Luosheng," I accidentally discovered a small covered bridge named "Da'an." Outside the bridge, an ancient waterwheel was still turning.

Although the bridge is not large, the list of people who donated funds is clearly visible, a few strokes outlining the simple and honest folk customs of the ancient mountain village.

The deeper the car went, the more I felt the uniqueness of this mountain area.Laiyuan Township is the birthplace of the Red Army, where the Soviet regime was first established in those years.

The years of battle have passed, and now there is an atmosphere of peace here.Bamboo abounds in the deep mountains, and bamboo products can be seen drying by the roadside everywhere.

Under the guidance of the villagers, going down the path by the big tree at the village head, an exquisite covered bridge appeared before my eyes — this is Wanlong Bridge.

Wanlong Bridge is also a small covered bridge, but its characteristic lies in its exquisite and unique design; especially the hexagonal pavilion at the top is made with verve, and its craftsmanship is astonishingly exquisite.

Wanlong Bridge is completely hidden among green mountains and clear waters, with a gurgling stream flowing by the bridge; the stream water is clear, and the stones at the bottom are colorful — one wonders how such an exquisite covered bridge came to be in these mountains, who built it and left it here.

Inside the bridge is a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with wooden plank flooring, relatively old, with wind-and-rain boards half open; the corridor house has good light, and the long wooden boards for resting were made later.

There was originally a shrine inside the corridor house, with the "Wanlong Bridge" plaque hanging high above the shrine.

The woodwork inside the corridor house is very exquisite; the shrine dougong extending from the outer pavilion to the interior of the corridor house should have been made by the same person.

Standing inside the bridge looking at the green bamboo outside and listening to the gurgling water, one feels very cool.

With the constant sound of cicadas and birds, a small squirrel even crawled across the beam frame — all this makes one suddenly forget the fatigue of driving all the way from afar.

Such scenery, without Wanlong Bridge to accompany it, would perhaps be ordinary.I suddenly grasped a saying: the best things are right before your eyes, and the most beautiful time is the present.

推荐级别：★★★

永隆桥

No.203
Yonglong Bridge
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：龙岩市连城县莒溪镇璧洲村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
桥体结构桥与庙的关系到永隆桥已经是夕阳时分惊艳地发现眼前的一联三组建筑宏伟的廊桥永隆桥精美的天后宫再后面是高大的文昌阁建筑不是凝固的音乐吗从这一角度看去桥身呼应身边的天后宫和文昌阁与远处的青山相对建筑与自然景色可谓相得益彰
中文 Chinese

到永隆桥已经是夕阳时分。惊艳地发现眼前的一联三组建筑：宏伟的廊桥永隆桥，精美的天后宫，再后面是高大的文昌阁。建筑不是凝固的音乐吗？从这一角度看去，桥身呼应身边的天后宫和文昌阁，与远处的青山相对，建筑与自然景色可谓相得益彰。你能够体会到"营造"二字的内涵了吗？

永隆桥建于明洪武二十年（1360年），桥长100米，宽6米，高7.5米。桥墩为三墩四孔等跨度，花岗岩砌成鳌头状，这似乎已成为当地古桥的通用做法。

桥墩上用枕木纵横铺排成倒三角形状，与另一大型廊桥云龙桥类似。廊屋内部穿斗式木架构，中间设有神龛，鹅卵石铺地，保养精细。风雨板半开，廊屋内采光好。桥头下来紧邻天后宫。

据说这里的璧洲村大多是林姓，是由莆田地区迁移过来，笃信妈祖，所以修建天后宫来祭拜。天后宫正在维修中，夕阳西下，门前的石狮子显得几分落寂。

值得注意的是石狮子的形状与我们通常所见不同，还带有宋元时期或明代早期的古朴特征。夕阳下的永隆桥显得雍容安闲，默默矗立在那里，看着还在稻田里辛勤忙碌的人们。得益于横木直排这种构造，永隆桥能够经历更多年的风雨。

从初建至今没有经历大规模重修，这也是以跨度见长而相对脆弱的木拱廊桥所不能的。希望永隆桥保佑四方，其代表的人文精神也像它的名字一样。

English

It was already sunset when I arrived at Yonglong Bridge.

I was amazed to discover a trio of buildings before me: the magnificent covered bridge Yonglong Bridge, the exquisite Tianhou Palace, and behind it the tall Wenchang Pavilion.

Isn't architecture frozen music?

From this angle, the bridge body echoes the Tianhou Palace and Wenchang Pavilion beside it, facing the green mountains in the distance — architecture and natural scenery truly complement each other.

Can you now understand the connotation of the two characters "yingzao" (construction/craft)?

Yonglong Bridge was built in the 20th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1360), with a length of 100 meters, width of 6 meters, and height of 7.5 meters.

The bridge piers are three piers with four equal-span openings, built of granite in the shape of a mythical turtle head (aotou), which seems to have become the common practice for local ancient bridges.

On the piers, sleepers are laid horizontally and vertically in an inverted triangular shape, similar to another large covered bridge, Yunlong Bridge.

Inside the corridor house is a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with a shrine in the middle, cobblestone flooring, and精细 maintenance.

The wind-and-rain boards are half open, and the corridor house has good lighting.Coming down from the bridgehead, one is immediately next to Tianhou Palace.

It is said that most people in Bizhou Village here are surnamed Lin, having migrated from the Putian area, and devoutly believe in Mazu, so they built Tianhou Palace to worship her.

Tianhou Palace is currently under repair; as the sun sets in the west, the stone lions in front of the gate appear somewhat desolate.

It is worth noting that the shape of the stone lions differs from what we usually see, still bearing the simple and ancient characteristics of the Song-Yuan period or early Ming Dynasty.

Yonglong Bridge in the sunset appears graceful and leisurely, standing silently there, watching people still busily working in the rice fields.

Thanks to this construction of horizontal timbers laid straight, Yonglong Bridge has been able to withstand many more years of wind and rain.

From its initial construction to today, it has not undergone large-scale rebuilding — something that the relatively fragile timber-arch covered bridges, known for their spans, cannot do.

May Yonglong Bridge bless all directions, and may the humanistic spirit it represents be like its name.

推荐级别：★★★★

玉龙桥

No.204
Yulong Bridge
级别：无
年代：清
地址：龙岩市连城县四堡乡马屋村
类型：桥梁·木桥
特征标签 Highlights
桥梁结构屋顶做法玉沙桥有着属于自己的一片安静的领地在一片新楼林立的村庄外古树和桥下的河水构成一片别有洞天的小环境与周围参差不齐的建筑相隔绝虽几步之遥仿佛走入另一个世界玉沙桥始建于清康熙二十三年1684年民国十年重修
中文 Chinese

玉沙桥有着属于自己的一片安静的领地。在一片新楼林立的村庄外，古树和桥下的河水构成一片别有洞天的小环境，与周围参差不齐的建筑相隔绝，虽几步之遥仿佛走入另一个世界。玉沙桥始建于清康熙二十三年（1684年），民国十年重修。

桥的外观与江坊村的会龙桥有些相似，也是并排三重庑殿顶，只不过装饰更加古朴自然。玉沙桥的跨度不大，总长30米，宽5米，桥面距水面4米，距桥顶5米，中间一桥墩，形状做成船型或称鳌头状，以减少大水对桥体的冲击。

桥屋整体穿斗式木架构，风雨板半开，既能遮风挡雨，采光又好。廊屋内设有神龛，梁架上未见太多题刻。玉沙桥内部地面以鹅卵石铺就，保养得相当精心，甚至到了毫发未损的地步。中间神龛前面用小石子铺成图案，仔细看去是一可爱的小羊，大概寓意吉祥丰收。桥身是用粗大的枕木交错铺叠而成。

桥梁的精神实质也是其最吸引人之处在于一个"公"字，因其所作之初衷乃是济世利民，为公众提供交通便利，廊桥更加以遮风挡雨，因此简约也罢，豪华也罢，都令人欢喜而起敬。是豪宅大厝建造之余，想起建桥？还是建起了桥梁积蓄了功德，才大发其家？玉沙桥边的村落四堡乡马屋村，原是当地雕版印刷基地，也是纸张和书籍的集散地。

现该村群被定为国家级保护单位，但看上去已是荒草丛生，当年的繁华热闹已经丝毫不见了。询问当地人雕版印刷和古建筑群，他们大多漠然，并无太多自豪之意，提到古建筑的保护，在人们口中也不过是"不许拆"而已。未来的主人翁，全指望您了。

English

Yusha Bridge has its own quiet territory.

Outside a village lined with new buildings, ancient trees and the river under the bridge form a small environment of its own, isolated from the surrounding uneven buildings; though only a few steps away, it feels like entering another world.

Yusha Bridge was first built in the 23rd year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1684) and rebuilt in the tenth year of the Republic.

Its appearance is somewhat similar to Huilong Bridge in Jiangfang Village, also with three parallel hip roofs (wudian ding), except that the decoration is more simple and natural.

Yusha Bridge's span is not large, with a total length of 30 meters, width of 5 meters, bridge deck 4 meters above the water, and 5 meters below the bridge top; there is one bridge pier in the middle, shaped like a boat or a mythical turtle head (aotou) to reduce the impact of floodwater on the bridge body.

The bridge house overall has a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with wind-and-rain boards half open, both sheltering from wind and rain and providing good lighting.

There is a shrine inside the corridor house, and not many inscriptions are seen on the beam frames.

The interior floor of Yusha Bridge is paved with cobblestones, maintained quite meticulously, even to the point of being undamaged.

In front of the middle shrine, small stones are laid into a pattern; looking carefully, it is a cute little sheep, probably symbolizing auspiciousness and harvest.

The bridge body is made of large sleepers laid and stacked alternately.

The spiritual essence of the bridge, and also its most attractive feature, lies in the character "gong" (public/common good), because its original purpose was to benefit the people and provide public transportation convenience; the covered bridge additionally shelters from wind and rain, so whether simple or luxurious, it is delightful and worthy of respect.

Was it after building grand mansions that one thought of building a bridge?Or was it by building bridges and accumulating merit that one became wealthy?

The village beside Yusha Bridge, Mawu Village in Sibao Township, was originally a local woodblock printing base and also a distribution center for paper and books.

Now this village group has been designated as a national-level protection unit, but it looks overgrown with weeds, and the prosperity and liveliness of those years have completely disappeared.

Asking locals about woodblock printing and the ancient building complex, they are mostly indifferent, without much sense of pride; when mentioning the protection of ancient buildings, in people's mouths it is merely "not allowed to demolish.

" The future masters, it all depends on you.

推荐级别：★★★

云龙桥

No.205
Yunlong Bridge
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：龙岩市连城县罗坊乡下罗村
类型：桥梁·木桥
特征标签 Highlights
桥梁结构廊屋和魁星阁结构下罗村前一条河和几株古树远远就可以看到云龙桥雄伟的桥体云龙桥始建于明崇祯七年1634年清乾隆三十七年1772年重修云龙桥颇可得一龙字桥长81米6墩7孔桥廊内部穿斗式木架构做工比较讲究共31间128柱
中文 Chinese

下罗村前一条河和几株古树，远远就可以看到云龙桥雄伟的桥体。云龙桥始建于明崇祯七年（1634年），清乾隆三十七年（1772年）重修。

云龙桥颇可得一"龙"字，桥长81米，6墩7孔；桥廊内部穿斗式木架构，做工比较讲究，共31间128柱，恐怕只有屏南县境内的万安桥可与其比肩。

该桥首先是桥头做工精湛，飞檐斗拱极具本地特色，牌匾上书"云龙桥"三个大字，仿佛是龙头，桥的另一端直抵山岩；再有就是桥墩有力，几个巨大的桥墩做成鳌头形状并立水中，上覆纵横铺排的枕木成倒三角形将桥身托起，巨大的桥墩和枕木就像放着鲜花的花瓶，雄浑中透出几分雅致；一个桥墩上方的桥身顶部做出庑殿顶形状的桥亭，看上去舒展典雅；又一亮点是位于桥正中的这个六角的塔状阁楼，号曰魁星楼，属于设计上的点睛之作，整个桥看上去越发灵动。

魁星楼从内部是可以上去的，开始没有注意，后来有几个女学生来玩，其中一个显然是在尽地主之谊，告诉我们几个人这个小秘密。果然别有洞天。云龙桥的周边不算冷清，很多人来这里休闲聊天，大人小孩其乐融融，牛儿也来桥头吃草，一点都不怕人的样子。

午后的阳光透过云层照在云龙桥上，云龙桥也许并不知道自己的美，只是用巨大的身躯庇护着桥内休闲的老人、谈天的少男少女、发呆的游人、嬉闹的孩子、自以为是的牛等一切众生。孩子们啊，多想书成之后送给你们，你们是珍爱家乡的种子。

English

In front of Xialuo Village, a river and a few ancient trees — from afar one can see the majestic bridge body of Yunlong Bridge.

Yunlong Bridge was first built in the seventh year of Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1634) and rebuilt in the 37th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1772).

Yunlong Bridge well deserves the character "long" (dragon): it is 81 meters long, with 6 piers and 7 openings; inside the bridge corridor is a chuan-dou (column-and-tie) timber frame, with relatively exquisite workmanship, totaling 31 bays and 128 columns — I'm afraid only Wan'an Bridge in Pingnan County can compare with it.

First of all, the bridgehead is exquisitely crafted, with flying eaves and dougong strongly characteristic of the local style; the plaque bears the three large characters "Yunlong Bridge," as if it were the dragon's head, while the other end of the bridge reaches directly to the mountain rock.

Furthermore, the piers are powerful: several huge piers made in the shape of mythical turtle heads (aotou) stand in the water, covered with sleepers laid horizontally and vertically in an inverted triangle to lift the bridge body; the huge piers and sleepers are like vases holding flowers, with a touch of elegance amid their grandeur.

Above one pier, the top of the bridge body forms a bridge pavilion in the shape of a hip roof (wudian ding), looking舒展 and elegant.

Another highlight is this hexagonal tower-like pavilion located at the center of the bridge, called Kuixing Tower (Star of Literature Tower), a finishing touch in the design that makes the whole bridge look ever more lively.

Kuixing Tower can be accessed from inside; I didn't notice it at first, but later several female students came to play, and one of them, clearly acting as a host, told us this little secret.

Indeed, there is a hidden world.

The surroundings of Yunlong Bridge are not desolate; many people come here to relax and chat, adults and children enjoying themselves together, and cows also come to graze at the bridgehead, not at all afraid of people.

The afternoon sun shines through the clouds onto Yunlong Bridge; perhaps Yunlong Bridge does not know its own beauty, but simply uses its huge body to shelter all living beings inside the bridge — relaxing elderly people, chatting young men and women, daydreaming tourists, playful children, self-important cows, and all creatures.

Children, how I wish to give this book to you after it is completed — you are the seeds that cherish your hometown.

推荐级别：★★★★

芷溪宗祠

No.206
Ancestral Temple Complex in Zhixi
级别：国家级历史文化名村，省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：连城县庙前镇芷溪、芷红村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
祠堂群祠堂格局木结构与特色装饰拜访土楼的人如果再深入一些就能够在50公里之外看到与土楼大相径庭的芷溪村古建筑这里主要居住着黄杨邱华四姓客家人黄杨两姓居多芷溪的老屋前面是灰砖的屋顶是灰瓦的结构是素木或朱漆的门楼是高耸的
中文 Chinese

拜访土楼的人如果再深入一些，就能够在50公里之外看到与土楼大相径庭的芷溪村古建筑。这里主要居住着黄、杨、邱、华四姓客家人，黄、杨两姓居多。芷溪的老屋前面是灰砖的，屋顶是灰瓦的，结构是素木或朱漆的，门楼是高耸的。而最为难得的是，这里多"祠居合一"。

明清以来，先后建了74座古宗祠、139幢古民居，代表性的有澄川公祠、集鳣堂、黄氏家庙、翠畴公祠、杨氏家庙、杨辉公祠等。探访客家人"慎终追远、敬祖睦宗"的传统，这里是不能错过的地方。只看一眼澄川公祠的门楼，就会觉得此行不虚。

澄川公祠建于清同治年间，也叫孔硕堂，门屋楼五间，门楼三间"镶嵌"在中间，石雕斗拱仿照如意斗拱，穿插雕刻花鸟、山水等装饰题材。门楼当心安"澄川公祠"匾额，两次间分别额书"流芳"、"衍庆"。集鳣堂是集中讲学的意思，也叫"渔溪公祠"，建于康熙末年。

堂的规模很大，从前坪、大门、下厅、天井、中厅、天井、上厅、天井、后厅，到左右横屋，加上花园、假山、池塘，大小房间逾百，当地人叫"九厅十八井"。这里边内外两个门楼是特色突出的，外门楼造型最隆重，石构，平面两翼前伸，作八字状，飞檐翘角，简洁大气。内门楼则细砖所成，朴素大方。

厅堂之内，则是一番朴素庄重的景象。此外，在建于清光绪十八年（1892年）的翠畴公祠、康熙三十年落成的黄氏家庙等院落之中还能体会到多种建筑形式对于同一建筑主题的不同表现。

English

Those who visit earthen buildings (tulou), if they go a bit deeper, can see the ancient buildings of Zhixi Village, which are quite different from tulou, 50 kilometers away.

This place is mainly inhabited by Hakka people of four surnames — Huang, Yang, Qiu, and Hua — with the Huang and Yang surnames being the majority.

The old houses in Zhixi have gray brick fronts, gray tile roofs, plain or red-lacquered timber structures, and towering gate towers.

Most rare is that here many are "shrine-residence combined" (ci ju he yi).

Since the Ming and Qing dynasties, 74 ancient ancestral halls and 139 ancient residences have been built successively; representative ones include Chengchuan Gong Shrine, Jizhan Hall, Huang Clan Family Temple, Cuichou Gong Shrine, Yang Clan Family Temple, Yanghui Gong Shrine, etc.

To explore the Hakka tradition of "carefully attending to the funeral rites of parents and following them when gone with due sacrifices; revering ancestors and harmonizing with the clan," this is a place not to be missed.

Just one glance at the gate tower of Chengchuan Gong Shrine will make you feel the trip was worthwhile.

Chengchuan Gong Shrine was built during the Tongzhi reign of the Qing, also called Kongshuo Hall; the gate house has five bays, with the three-bay gate tower "inlaid" in the middle; the stone-carved dougong imitate ruyi dougong, interspersed with carved decorative themes such as flowers, birds, and landscapes.

At the center of the gate tower is the "Chengchuan Gong Shrine" plaque, and the two side bays bear the inscriptions "Liufang" (Eternal Fame) and "Yanqing" (Extended Blessing) respectively.

Jizhan Hall means a place for concentrated teaching, also called "Yuxi Gong Shrine," built in the late Kangxi reign.

The hall is very large in scale: from the front flat area, main gate, lower hall, courtyard, middle hall, courtyard, upper hall, courtyard, rear hall, to the left and right horizontal houses, plus gardens, rockeries, and ponds — there are over a hundred rooms of various sizes, locally called "nine halls and eighteen courtyards.

" The two inner and outer gate towers here are particularly distinctive: the outer gate tower has the most grand造型, of stone construction, with both wings of the plan extending forward in a figure-eight shape, with flying eaves and upturned corners, simple and大气.

The inner gate tower is made of fine bricks, simple and generous.Inside the halls, there is a scene of simplicity and solemnity.

In addition, in courtyards such as Cuichou Gong Shrine built in the 18th year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1892) and Huang Clan Family Temple completed in the 30th year of Kangxi reign, one can also experience the different expressions of multiple architectural forms for the same architectural theme.

推荐级别：★★★

泉州市 Quanzhou

42 处

崇福寺·应庚塔

No.207
Chongfu Temple and Yinggeng Pagoda
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：宋—清
地址：泉州市鲤城区开元街道崇福寺路
类型：宗教建筑·石结构·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石结构和石刻手法木结构崇福寺清静整齐鹤立于周围不甚整齐的街巷崇福寺的名声在民众的心中起于妙月大师传授的南少林武功在文人的眼里是声波洛阳桥的崇福晚钟在古建筑人的课本上则要数始建于宋代的应庚塔
中文 Chinese

崇福寺清静整齐，鹤立于周围不甚整齐的街巷。崇福寺的名声，在民众的心中起于妙月大师传授的南少林武功，在文人的眼里是声波洛阳桥的"崇福晚钟"，在古建筑人的课本上则要数始建于宋代的应庚塔。

寺院的肇始也可以追溯到北宋，原为女尼修行的千佛庵，元祐六年改名为崇福寺。后废，明代崇祯年间重建，清康熙年间扩建，现存建筑多系光绪年间遗构。

不过走过兜率天宫、大雄宝殿、圆通宝殿等建筑时也可以留意一下颇具地方手法的石雕作品，还有就是各个建筑中保留使用的一些斗拱和屋架构件。

尤其是斗拱，有的尺度相当大，做法也不似晚期那般完整而琐碎，反而疏朗简约，仿佛缺少些构造或是没有完成一般，很是怀疑它们是历代修缮得以幸存下来的老家伙。最最紧要的，还是寺东的应庚塔。塔身七层，八角形平面，收分微妙不显，塔刹为宝相轮；塔身各面浮雕门窗及栏杆，平坐处隐刻出壶门；檐下做叠涩以代铺作层，转角...

English

Chongfu Temple is quiet and orderly, standing out like a crane among the somewhat unkempt surrounding streets and alleys.

The fame of Chongfu Temple, in the hearts of the people, began with the Southern Shaolin martial arts taught by Master Miaoyue; in the eyes of literati, it is the "Chongfu Evening Bell" whose sound waves reach Luoyang Bridge; in the textbooks of ancient architecture scholars, it must be the Yinggeng Pagoda first built in the Song Dynasty.

The temple's origins can also be traced back to the Northern Song, originally called Qianfo Nunnery where female nuns practiced; in the sixth year of Yuanyou reign it was renamed Chongfu Temple.

Later abandoned, it was rebuilt during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming and expanded during the Kangxi reign of the Qing; the existing buildings are mostly remains from the Guangxu reign.

However, when passing through buildings such as Tusita Heaven Palace, Mahavira Hall, and Yuantong Hall, one can also pay attention to the stone carvings with quite local techniques, as well as some dougong and roof frame components preserved and used in various buildings.

Especially the dougong, some are quite large in scale, and their construction is not as complete and fussy as in the late period, but rather sparse and simple, as if lacking some structure or unfinished — one strongly suspects they are old fellows that survived through successive repairs.

Most importantly, it is the Yinggeng Pagoda east of the temple.

The pagoda body has seven stories, with an octagonal plan, subtle and unnoticeable tapering, and the pagoda finial is a treasure wheel (baoxianglun); each face of the pagoda body has relief carvings of doors, windows, and railings, with hidden carving of pot doors (humen) at the flat seating; under the eaves, corbelling (diese) is done to replace the bracket set layer, at the corners.

..

推荐级别：★★★★

东禅寺

No.208
Dongchan Temple
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：当代
地址：泉州市东门仁风街东禅村凤山
类型：宗教建筑
特征标签 Highlights
凭吊与考证关于南少林的争论赞同者最多者有三莆田少林寺泉州少林寺和福清少林寺泉州的一座被学者和大众指认为东门外的镇国东禅寺其实东禅寺史籍未见有关于少林寺的记载仅是在清咸丰六年1856年住持幻空写下了少林古迹的匾额道光晋江县志卷六九载镇国东禅寺在仁风门外东湖畔明宣德十年重修后废僧人修其旧址十分之一
中文 Chinese

关于南少林的争论，赞同者最多者有三——莆田少林寺、泉州少林寺和福清少林寺。泉州的一座，被学者和大众指认为东门外的镇国东禅寺。其实东禅寺史籍未见有关于少林寺的记载，仅是在清咸丰六年（1856年）住持幻空写下了"少林古迹"的匾额。

道光《晋江县志·卷六九》载："镇国东禅寺在仁风门外东湖畔……明宣德十年重修，后废。僧人修其旧址十分之一。"另据清人蔡永兼《西山杂志》记载："乾隆二十八年（1763年）秋，诏焚少林寺。"原来的东禅寺规模之大远非今天的面貌可比。寺院屡有兴废的身世和南少林寺的历史也仿佛大致相符合了。

如今的东禅寺是泉州文物部门按照旧址遗留下来的唐代构件于1992年重新修建的。

至1997年，大雄宝殿、五观堂及僧舍基本完成，中国佛教协会会长赵朴初为其题"东禅少林寺"匾额；2002年进而修复了大雄宝殿正前方的天王殿。

寺内还有部分保存完整的唐代柱础、墙体，以及至今仍能打出清水的古井。寺的周围，还散有古代的大石槽、练武的石板凳、金刚池、刈狗池等，现已被建为东湖新村了。

据说2002年复建天王殿时，从地下挖掘出石制寺庙构件40多件，其中塔座1个、塔盖1个，与应庚塔相似的塔刹7个、石帽4个、柱础4块、石柱6根等，保存完整的直径达1米的榫石就有20块，反映出当时的宏大规模。还从现场发掘出大量的瓦片和瓦盖。

专家推测，这些构件极有可能是唐宋时期泉州少林寺的建筑构件。

English

Regarding the debate over Southern Shaolin, there are three most endorsed candidates — Putian Shaolin Temple, Quanzhou Shaolin Temple, and Fuqing Shaolin Temple.

The one in Quanzhou is identified by scholars and the public as Zhenguo Dongchan Temple outside the East Gate.

In fact, historical records of Dongchan Temple contain no mention of Shaolin Temple; only in the sixth year of Xianfeng reign of the Qing (1856) did the abbot Huankong write the plaque "Shaolin Ancient Site.

" The Daoguang-era "Jinjiang County Gazetteer · Volume 69" records: "Zhenguo Dongchan Temple is by East Lake outside Renfeng Gate...

rebuilt in the tenth year of Xuande reign of the Ming, later abandoned.Monks restored one-tenth of its original site.

" According to another record by Qing person Cai Yongjian in "Xishan Zazhi": "In the autumn of the 28th year of Qianlong reign (1763), an imperial edict ordered the burning of Shaolin Temple.

" The original scale of Dongchan Temple was far from comparable to today's appearance.

The temple's history of repeated rises and falls also seems to roughly match the history of Southern Shaolin Temple.

Today's Dongchan Temple was rebuilt in 1992 by the Quanzhou cultural relics department according to Tang Dynasty components left at the original site.

By 1997, the Mahavira Hall, Five Contemplations Hall, and monk quarters were basically completed; Zhao Puchu, president of the Buddhist Association of China, inscribed the plaque "Dongchan Shaolin Temple" for it; in 2002, the Hall of Heavenly Kings directly in front of the Mahavira Hall was further restored.

Inside the temple there are also some well-preserved Tang Dynasty column bases, walls, and an ancient well that can still produce clear water to this day.

Around the temple, there are also scattered ancient large stone troughs, stone benches for martial arts practice, Vajra Pool, Gougou Pool, etc., which have now been built into Donghu New Village.

It is said that when rebuilding the Hall of Heavenly Kings in 2002, over 40 stone temple components were excavated from underground, including 1 pagoda base, 1 pagoda cover, 7 pagoda finials similar to Yinggeng Pagoda, 4 stone caps, 4 column bases, 6 stone columns, etc.

; there are 20 well-preserved tenon stones with a diameter of up to 1 meter, reflecting the massive scale at that time.A large number of tiles and tile covers were also excavated from the site.

Experts speculate that these components are very likely architectural components of Quanzhou Shaolin Temple from the Tang-Song period.

推荐级别：★

府文庙

No.209
Temple of Confucius in Quanzhou Prefecture
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋—清
地址：泉州市鲤城区中山中路泮宫内
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构砖石做法在泉州市区繁华的商业区中心地段文庙得以保存了下来中国商业的破坏力没有政治强大但它的侵蚀力却是难以抗拒的临中山街入得泮宫门是一宽大露埕左右为礼门义路
中文 Chinese

在泉州市区繁华的商业区中心地段，文庙得以保存了下来。中国商业的破坏力没有政治强大，但它的侵蚀力却是难以抗拒的。临中山街入得泮宫门是一宽大露埕，左右为礼门、义路。远远地看见"泉州孔子学会"的牌子，庙内还设有"文物陈列馆"、"泉州历史名人纪念馆"、"泉州古代教育展览馆"。

联想起当地同窗请客时的好尚，很希望文庙能够真正成为引以为豪的所在，而不是只摆些乏人问津的陈列。其实泉州府文庙是大有内涵的。

庙始建于唐开元末年，北宋太平兴国初年移建孔庙于此，太平兴国七年（982年）建为州学，后又迁他处，大观三年（1109年）迁回，南宋绍兴七年（1137年）重建，经过宋、元、明、清历代修缮，规模依旧宏大，规制完整，是东南地区最大的文庙建筑群。

府文庙前有大成门三开间，两侧左有金声门，右有玉振门，门内有泮池上架元代泮桥，两旁古榕垂荫，主体建筑是大成殿，殿东西两侧有东庑和西庑。

大殿为典型的重檐庑殿式结构，面阔七间进深五间，以48根白色石柱承托木结构屋架，其中正面的八根檐柱浮雕盘龙，风格古朴。立柱之上斗拱层叠，双杪双下昂七铺作，中间三间只施两朵补间铺作，其余更仅用一朵。屋脊短小，更衬托出四坡面的舒缓。

殿前砌露台，台明嵌有仰莲、复莲、扶桑、山茶、牡丹、芙蓉等辉绿岩石浮雕。此外，府文庙内还有明伦堂、庄际昌状元祠、蔡清祠、李文节祠等建筑。

English

In the central area of the bustling commercial district of Quanzhou city, the Confucian Temple has been preserved.

The destructive power of Chinese commerce is not as great as that of politics, but its erosive force is hard to resist.

Entering the Pan Palace gate from Zhongshan Street, there is a wide open courtyard, with the Gate of Ritual (Li Men) and Gate of Righteousness (Yi Lu) on the left and right.

From afar one sees the sign of the "Quanzhou Confucius Society"; inside the temple there are also a "Cultural Relics Exhibition Hall," "Quanzhou Historical Celebrities Memorial Hall," and "Quanzhou Ancient Education Exhibition Hall.

" Recalling the preferences of local classmates when treating guests, one hopes the Confucian Temple can truly become a place to be proud of, rather than just displaying some neglected exhibits.

In fact, Quanzhou Prefecture Confucian Temple has great内涵.

The temple was first built in the late Kaiyuan reign of the Tang; in the early Taiping Xingguo reign of the Northern Song, the Confucian Temple was moved here, and in the seventh year of Taiping Xingguo (982) it was established as a prefectural school, later moved elsewhere, returned in the third year of Daguan reign (1109), rebuilt in the seventh year of Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song (1137), and经过 repairs through the Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties; its scale remains grand and its regulations complete, making it the largest Confucian temple complex in the southeast region.
