In front of the prefecture Confucian Temple is the Dacheng Gate with three bays; on both sides, to the left is the Jinsheng Gate and to the right the Yuzhen Gate; inside the gate there is a Pan Pond with a Yuan Dynasty Pan Bridge over it, with ancient banyan trees casting shade on both sides; the main building is the Dacheng Hall, with east and west side galleries on both sides of the hall.

The main hall is a typical double-eave hip roof (wudian) structure, seven bays wide and five bays deep, with 48 white stone columns supporting the timber roof frame; among them, the eight front eave columns have relief-carved coiling dragons, with an ancient style.

Above the columns, dougong are layered, with double-tiao double-xia'ang seven-step bracket sets; the middle three bays only have two intermediate bracket sets, and the rest use only one.

The roof ridge is short, further emphasizing the gentle slope of the four roof surfaces.

In front of the hall is a terrace, with the terrace edge embedded with relief carvings of upward lotus, downward lotus, hibiscus, camellia, peony, and cotton rose in diabase (huilü rock).

In addition, within the prefecture Confucian Temple there are also the Minglun Hall, Zhuang Jichang Zhuangyuan Shrine, Cai Qing Shrine, Li Wenjie Shrine, and other buildings.

推荐级别：★★★★

花桥慈济宫

No.210
Ciji Temple in Huaqiao
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：泉州市鲤城区中山南路北段西侧
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构距离泉州府文庙不远就是花桥慈济宫了慈济宫用琉璃瓦屋面在周围有些洋风的建筑群中非常容易辨认此宫又名真人庙还被当地人称为花桥坛自古以来此地就是花市旁边的八卦沟上架有石桥
中文 Chinese

距离泉州府文庙不远，就是花桥慈济宫了。慈济宫用琉璃瓦屋面，在周围有些洋风的建筑群中非常容易辨认。此宫又名真人庙，还被当地人称为"花桥坛"。自古以来，此地就是花市，旁边的八卦沟上架有石桥。这里最最出名的要数"施药局"，就是免费赠送药品、救灾治病的场所。

慈济宫祭祀的当然首推保生大帝吴夲，他在泉州悬壶于花桥亭的事迹在民间也广为传颂。据载，清光绪四年（1878年），泉州绅士及商民于花桥宫内倡设泉郡施药局，博采药源，广施民众，以弘扬吴真人业医济世、扶危济困之精神。

光绪六年（1880年）改称泉州府施药局。光绪二十三年（1897年），泉州鼠疫猖獗，花桥宫施棺舍药，恤孤扶贫，善举无算。百余年来，此传统得到了发扬延续。花桥慈济宫历史悠久，主体部分规模不大仅一进院。大门上方的"真人所居"石匾，是明代泉州书法家张瑞图所书。

室内的屋架还可以看出精细的木工手艺。功能强大之所原始痕迹便不易找寻。这是一个非常普遍的现象。祭祀文化兴旺发达的闽粤地区的众多各类祠堂庙宇，或鲜艳夺目，或古色古香，表象之下到底掩盖了多少历史痕迹，骨子里面到底还有多少原始构件，这是我们所深切关心的。

除去这些庙宇的"法力"和"能力"，千百年来多少代人留下来的调色板和构造兴替，它们在活着人的心中还可以勾起一些酸楚或是惆怅，以及进而引起的全力保护它们的愿望，这是我们希望能够得到共鸣的。

English

Not far from Quanzhou Prefecture Confucian Temple is Ciji Temple in Huaqiao.

Ciji Temple uses glazed tile roofing, making it very easy to identify among the surrounding somewhat Western-style building complex.

This temple is also called Zhenren Temple (True Man Temple), and is also called "Huaqiao Altar" by locals.

Since ancient times, this place has been a flower market, with a stone bridge over the Bagua Ditch beside it.

What it is most famous for is the "Medicine Distribution Bureau," a place that gives away medicine for free and provides disaster relief and medical treatment.

Of course, the primary deity worshipped at Ciji Temple is Baosheng Dadi (Great Emperor of Life Protection) Wu Ben, whose deeds of practicing medicine at Huaqiao Pavilion in Quanzhou are also widely told among the people.

According to records, in the fourth year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1878), Quanzhou gentry and merchants initiated the establishment of the Quanzhou Prefecture Medicine Distribution Bureau within Ciji Temple, broadly sourcing medicines and distributing them widely to the people, to promote the spirit of Wu Zhenren's medical practice to benefit the world and help the distressed and poor.

In the sixth year of Guangxu reign (1880), it was renamed Quanzhou Prefecture Medicine Distribution Bureau.

In the 23rd year of Guangxu reign (1897), when the plague was rampant in Quanzhou, Huaqiao Temple distributed coffins and medicine, cared for orphans and helped the poor, with countless good deeds.

For over a hundred years, this tradition has been carried forward and continued.Ciji Temple in Huaqiao has a long history, with the main part not large in scale, only one courtyard.

The stone plaque "Where the True Man Resides" above the main gate was written by Zhang Ruitu, a Ming Dynasty Quanzhou calligrapher.

The roof frame inside still shows fine woodworking craftsmanship.In places with powerful functions, original traces are not easy to find.This is a very common phenomenon.

Among the numerous various ancestral halls and temples in the Fujian-Guangdong region where sacrificial culture flourishes, whether brightly colored or antique, how many historical traces are concealed beneath the surface, and how many original components remain in the bones — this is what we deeply care about.

Beyond the "magic power" and "ability" of these temples, the palettes and construction changes left by countless generations over thousands of years can still evoke some bitterness or melancholy in the hearts of living people, and thereby arouse the desire to fully protect them — this is what we hope can resonate.

推荐级别：★★

旧馆驿街巷

No.211
Lane of Old Inns and Way-station
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：泉州市鲤中街道馆驿巷
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
古宅格局历史痕迹旧馆驿街巷位于泉州的历史街区内旧肃清门外是古时驿站旧址因而得名南宋的时候宝庆初年1225至1227年巷西侧就是泉州行衙所在地元代的时候驿站就是庞大帝国的神经系统当时的清源驿就驻扎在这条街巷中
中文 Chinese

旧馆驿街巷位于泉州的历史街区内。旧肃清门外，是古时驿站旧址，因而得名。南宋的时候（宝庆初年，1225—1227年）巷西侧就是泉州行衙所在地。

元代的时候，驿站就是庞大帝国的神经系统，当时的清源驿就驻扎在这条街巷中。明天启年间（1621—1627年）迁出城外。资料显示，巷中历史积淀丰富，应当是史迹众多的。

算来这里曾经有过水陆寺、天室池、南外宗正司、元代驿站、明代染织房、明嘉靖间御史汪旦和户部侍郎庄国桢府第，还有清道光间翰林龚维琳胞弟举人龚维琨、刑部主事王海文、清嘉庆间进士杨滨海故居、清末状元吴鲁的读书处、汪氏宗祠等。

不过今天已经无法按图索骥了。现在这段巷子长约200米，南北走向，尺度宜人。路东多大树。巷内多砖构平房，偶尔可见年代较早的装修。旧馆驿20号似较老宅邸，可惜大门紧闭，不向我等开放。巷南端有董杨大宗祠，始建于明天顺五年，后毁，1999年重建。

巷内多见房屋外墙砖石混砌，为福建地区特有之"出砖入石"做法。石块表面比砖面略内陷，故名之。是不是一定要像福州三坊七巷那般打造一番呢？

English

The Old Inn and Way-station Lane is located within the historical district of Quanzhou.Outside the old Suqing Gate, it was the site of an ancient way-station, hence the name.

During the Southern Song (early Baoqing reign, 1225–1227), the west side of the lane was the location of the Quanzhou Administrative Office.

During the Yuan Dynasty, way-stations were the nervous system of the vast empire, and the Qingyuan Way-station at that time was stationed in this lane.

During the Tianqi reign of the Ming (1621–1627), it was moved outside the city.Data shows that the lane has a rich historical accumulation and should have numerous historical sites.

Counting up, there were once the Shuilu Temple, Tianshi Pond, Southern Outer Clan Administration Office, Yuan Dynasty way-station, Ming Dynasty dyeing and weaving workshop, the residences of Censor Wang Dan and Vice Minister of Revenue Zhuang Guozhen during the Jiajing reign of the Ming, as well as the former residence of Gong Weikun (a juren and younger brother of Hanlin Gong Weilin during the Daoguang reign of the Qing), Wang Haiwen (Director of the Ministry of Justice), Yang Binhai (a jinshi during the Jiaqing reign of the Qing), the study place of Wu Lu (the last Zhuangyuan of the Qing), the Wang Clan Ancestral Hall, etc.

However, today it is no longer possible to locate them by the map.Now this section of lane is about 200 meters long, running north-south, with pleasant scale.

On the east side of the road there are many large trees.Inside the lane there are mostly brick bungalows, with occasionally earlier-period decorations visible.No.

20 Old Inn Lane seems to be an older mansion, but unfortunately its gate is tightly closed, not open to us.

At the south end of the lane is the Dong-Yang Grand Ancestral Hall, first built in the fifth year of Tianshun reign of the Ming, later destroyed, and rebuilt in 1999.

Inside the lane, house exterior walls are commonly seen with mixed brick and stone masonry, a practice unique to the Fujian region called "chu zhuan ru shi" (bricks protruding, stones inset).

The surface of the stones is slightly recessed compared to the brick surface, hence the name.Must it really be developed like the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys in Fuzhou?

推荐级别：★★

开元寺·双塔

No.212
Double Pagodas in Kaiyuan Temple
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋—清
地址：泉州市鲤城区西街
类型：宗教建筑·石结构·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石塔结构和仿木做法晚期木结构巨大的石塔能够安定躁动的众生吗建筑系的学生们啊你们需要先有信仰再信仰建筑开元寺是闽中名刹寺院始建于唐垂拱二年686年那时叫作莲花寺
中文 Chinese

巨大的石塔能够安定躁动的众生吗？建筑系的学生们啊，你们需要先有信仰，再信仰建筑。开元寺是闽中名刹。寺院始建于唐垂拱二年（686年），那时叫作莲花寺，开元二十六年（738年）改成了这个名字。

拿史料记载和散布的众多小型古塔对照看，今天寺院的规模和唐宋时期的差别不很大。中轴线上从影壁到带着倒座抱厦的天王殿，再到大殿、甘露戒坛和藏经阁，两翼有东西塔的镇佑，寺院的进深要小于宽度。

如同一切古老的寺院，开元寺也是经历代重修，今存木构均为明清时期建筑，其中以大雄宝殿年代相对较早，斗拱雄浑有力。

得见东西塔真面目以前，先看到一对宝箧印经式的小石塔，有"绍兴乙丑七月"（1145年）题刻，为南宋的作品。四面浮雕佛传故事，风格朴拙可爱。更加有趣的是塔檐上刻着"当今皇帝"、"皇帝万岁"、"日光菩萨"、"月光菩萨"等字样。

要知道，日光、月光菩萨是东方药师佛的胁侍，两塔暗示着当年的净土信仰。两位主角相距不近。东塔名镇国塔，西塔名仁寿塔，规制全同，仅浮雕图案存在差异。

东塔建于南宋嘉熙二年至淳祐十年间（1238—1250年），西塔建于南宋绍定元年至嘉熙元年间（1228—1237年），同为八角五层楼阁式仿木结构。

大塔的须弥座尺度很小，但不失力量。塔身各层细腻地刻出了门窗、栏杆、立柱、阑额、雀替、斗拱、檐口，对斗拱细节的刻画尤其精到，表现出转角、附角、补间铺作，栌斗、交互斗、散斗、刷头形象逼真，甚至还有我们今天难以解释的构件，推测那该是"替木型小拱头"。

五层塔身罗列起来，气势是难以形容的宏大，也难以想象信仰如何有那么大的力量，让古人倾毕生所有，倾毕生所学来营造一件作品。那是为了来生的净土？还是工作的时候，头脑就是一片净土？

English

Can the massive stone pagodas calm restless beings?Students of architecture, you need to have faith first, then faith in architecture.

Kaiyuan Temple is a famous temple in central Fujian.

The temple was first built in the second year of Chuigong reign of the Tang (686), then called Lianhua Temple (Lotus Temple), and changed to its current name in the 26th year of Kaiyuan reign (738).

Comparing historical records with the many small ancient pagodas scattered around, the scale of today's temple is not very different from that of the Tang-Song period.

On the central axis, from the screen wall to the Hall of Heavenly Kings with an opposite portico, then to the main hall, the Ganlu Precepts Altar, and the Scripture Library, with the east and west pagodas guarding both wings, the depth of the temple is less than its width.

Like all ancient temples, Kaiyuan Temple has been repaired through successive dynasties; the existing timber structures are all Ming-Qing period buildings, among which the Mahavira Hall is relatively early in date, with powerful and vigorous dougong.

Before seeing the true faces of the east and west pagodas, one first sees a pair of small stone pagodas in the baqie yinjing (sutra-reliquary) style, with inscriptions "the seventh month of the Yichou year of Shaoxing" (1145), works of the Southern Song.

The four sides have relief carvings of Buddha's life stories, in a simple and endearing style.

Even more interesting is that the pagoda eaves are carved with characters such as "Current Emperor," "Long Live the Emperor," "Sunlight Bodhisattva," and "Moonlight Bodhisattva.

" You should know that the Sunlight and Moonlight Bodhisattvas are the attendant bodhisattvas of the Eastern Medicine Buddha (Bhaishajyaguru), and the two pagodas hint at the Pure Land faith of those years.

The two protagonists are not close together.

The east pagoda is named Zhenguo Pagoda (Township-Guarding Pagoda), and the west pagoda is named Renshou Pagoda (Benevolent-Longevity Pagoda); they have identical regulations, differing only in their relief patterns.

The east pagoda was built between the second year of Jiaxi reign and the tenth year of Chunyou reign of the Southern Song (1238–1250), and the west pagoda between the first year of Shaoding reign and the first year of Jiaxi reign (1228–1237), both being octagonal five-story pavilion-style structures imitating timber.

The xumizuo (Sumeru pedestal) of the large pagodas is small in scale but not lacking in strength.

Each story of the pagoda body delicately carves out doors, windows, railings, columns, architraves, sparrow brackets (queti), dougong, and eaves; the depiction of dougong details is especially exquisite, showing corner sets, attached-corner sets, and intermediate sets, with vivid images of cap blocks (ludou),交互 blocks (jiaohu dou), loose blocks (sandou), and brush heads (shuatou), and even components that are difficult for us to explain today —推测 they should be "timber-substitute small bracket heads.

" The five stories of pagoda bodies arranged together create an indescribably grand momentum, and it is hard to imagine how faith could have such great power, making ancient people devote all their life's possessions and all their life's learning to creating one work.

Was it for the Pure Land of the next life?Or was it that when working, their minds were already a Pure Land?

推荐级别：★★★★★

洛阳桥

No.213
Luoyang Bridge
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：泉州东郊5公里洛阳江口
类型：桥梁·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石桥结构筏形基础种蛎固基宽阔的洛阳江入海的水面上架设着一眼望不到头的洛阳桥洛阳桥是福建桥梁的状元茅以升洛阳桥初建时长1200米宽6.67米武士造像分立两旁
中文 Chinese

宽阔的洛阳江入海的水面上，架设着一眼望不到头的洛阳桥。"洛阳桥是福建桥梁的状元"——茅以升。洛阳桥初建时长1200米，宽6.67米，武士造像分立两旁。

桥中亭附近历代碑刻林立，有"万古安澜"等宋代石刻；桥北有昭惠庙、真身庵遗址；桥南有蔡襄祠，蔡襄著名的《万安桥记》碑立于祠内。史料记载，当时桥名是"万安桥"，主持人是北宋泉州太守蔡襄。没有一劳永逸的美事，造桥花了七年（1053—1059年），历代修建则贯穿千载。

简单历数一下，宋绍兴八年（1138年），飓风坏桥，郡守赵思诚修复；明宣德间（1426—1435年）桥址下沉，潮至，桥没，知府冯桢命郡人增高三尺；万历三十二年（1424年），地震，桥塌，基址沉降，知府姜志礼修复；清雍正八年（1730年）秋，桥崩，知县工之琦修复；民国二十年（公元1932年）蔡廷锴军长改建为钢筋混凝土公路桥，桥面增高2米；抗日战争时期受到严重破坏，近代复修缮之。

造桥的关键技术有两个——"筏形基础"和"种蛎固基"。所谓"筏形基础"，就是先在江底建成一条矮石堤，然后在堤上建桥墩。这样一来石堤将所有桥墩的基础连为一体，石堤底面积大，因此减小了建造单个桥墩基底对河底的压强，也便因而提高了地基土的承载力，并更有效地增强基础的整体性，调整不均匀沉降。

所谓"种蛎固基"，即在基石上养殖牡蛎，使之胶结成牢固的中流砥柱。宋方勺《泊宅篇》中便有"即多去蛎房散置石基，益胶固焉"。尽管专家之间存在争论，但史料中的说法无疑是世界上把生物学应用于桥梁工程中的先例。端详着现在那些缀满白色蛎房痕迹的桥墩石，历史的沧桑感已荡然胸中，是不是卓越发明确实那么重要吗？

English

On the broad surface where the Luoyang River empties into the sea, Luoyang Bridge stretches as far as the eye can see."Luoyang Bridge is the champion of Fujian bridges" — Mao Yisheng.

When first built, Luoyang Bridge was 1,200 meters long and 6.67 meters wide, with warrior statues standing on both sides.

Near the bridge pavilion, steles from successive dynasties stand in rows, including Song Dynasty stone carvings such as "Eternal Peace Over the Waves"; north of the bridge are the sites of Zhaohui Temple and Zhenzhen Nunnery; south of the bridge is the Cai Xiang Shrine, where Cai Xiang's famous "Record of Wan'an Bridge" stele stands.

Historical records show that the bridge was then named "Wan'an Bridge" (Peace Bridge), and the person in charge was Cai Xiang, prefect of Quanzhou in the Northern Song.

There is no such thing as a once-and-for-all achievement; building the bridge took seven years (1053–1059), and repairs through successive dynasties span a thousand years.

To briefly recount: in the eighth year of Shaoxing reign of the Song (1138), a hurricane damaged the bridge, and Prefect Zhao Sicheng repaired it; during the Xuande reign of the Ming (1426–1435), the bridge foundation sank, and at high tide the bridge was submerged; Prefect Feng Zhen ordered locals to raise it by three chi; in the 32nd year of Wanli reign (1424), an earthquake caused the bridge to collapse and the foundation to sink, and Prefect Jiang Zhili repaired it; in the autumn of the eighth year of Yongzheng reign of the Qing (1730), the bridge collapsed, and Magistrate Gong Zhiqi repaired it; in the 20th year of the Republic (1932), Army Commander Cai Tingkai converted it into a reinforced concrete highway bridge, raising the deck by 2 meters; it was severely damaged during the War of Resistance against Japan, and was repaired again in modern times.

There are two key technologies in building the bridge — "raft foundation" and "oyster-cultivation foundation consolidation.

" The so-called "raft foundation" means first building a low stone embankment at the river bottom, then building bridge piers on the embankment.

In this way, the stone embankment connects the foundations of all piers into one; with a large base area, it reduces the pressure on the river bottom from each individual pier foundation, thereby increasing the bearing capacity of the foundation soil, and more effectively enhancing the integrity of the foundation and adjusting uneven settlement.

The so-called "oyster-cultivation foundation consolidation" means cultivating oysters on the foundation stones, causing them to cement into a firm midstream pillar.

In Song Dynasty author Fang Shao's "Bozhai Pian," there is already mention of "cultivating oysters to consolidate the foundation.

" Although there is debate among experts, the statement in historical records is undoubtedly the world's first precedent of applying biology to bridge engineering.

Looking at the pier stones now covered with traces of white oyster shells, the vicissitudes of history fill the chest — is an outstanding invention really that important?

推荐级别：★★★★

清净寺

No.214
Qingjing Temple
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋—清
地址：泉州市鲤城区南涂门街
类型：宗教建筑·石结构·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石塔结构和石刻手法晚期木结构和晚近的欢天喜地的庙宇比起来泉州清净寺作为古老的清真寺是饱含宗教气氛的肤浅地观察寺院外表便一下自让人想到阿尔多罗西甚至还有路易康不过那是北宋大中祥符二年1009年的大师作品虽然风格的模仿对象是叙利亚大马士革清真寺
中文 Chinese

和晚近的欢天喜地的庙宇比起来，泉州清净寺，作为古老的清真寺，是饱含宗教气氛的。肤浅地观察寺院外表，便一下自让人想到阿尔多·罗西，甚至还有路易·康。

不过那是北宋大中祥符二年（1009年）的大师作品，虽然风格的模仿对象是叙利亚大马士革清真寺，但比例尺度的把握不是抄袭得来的，使用的材料也是福建土产的石材。

寺内现存最重要的建筑包括门楼、古礼拜堂奉天坛遗址，以及今天使用的礼拜堂明善堂。门楼是古寺庙的标志，高耸，南向，以辉绿岩和白花岗岩砌筑。楼顶作宣礼台。入口处接连着两个半个的穹顶，无尽的异域风情。

门东为祝圣亭，内有重修碑记二通，一通为万历"重修清净寺碑记"，一通为正德"重立清净寺碑"。门西就是奉天坛，现仅存石墙、石柱及础。墙上门洞作火焰券，并有多处阿拉伯文铭文。柱、础均圆柱形。柱网三横四纵、高低不一，柱上尚存卯口。柱础有阳刻花纹雕饰。坛堂西端设立龛室，为礼拜的方向。

再西的配院中还有古伊斯兰教石刻和古穆斯林石墓盖等陈设。从门口往北入得内院，正对着的北墙嵌有明永乐五年（1407年）的敕谕碑，院子西头则是明善堂。

此堂始建于明隆庆元年（1567年），现存建筑为清代重建，风格中西合璧。油饰彩绘较新，近年当有重修。

English

Compared with the joyous temples of later periods, Quanzhou Qingjing Temple, as an ancient mosque, is full of religious atmosphere.

A superficial observation of the temple's exterior immediately brings to mind Aldo Rossi, and even Louis Kahn.

However, it was a masterwork from the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu reign of the Northern Song (1009); although the style was modeled after the Great Mosque of Damascus in Syria, the grasp of proportion and scale was not obtained by copying, and the materials used are also locally produced stone from Fujian.

The most important existing buildings in the temple include the gate tower, the site of the ancient prayer hall Fengtian Altar, and the prayer hall Mingshan Hall used today.

The gate tower is the标志 of the ancient temple, tall and imposing, facing south, built of diabase (huilü rock) and white granite.The top of the building serves as a minaret platform.

At the entrance, two half-domes connect, with endless exotic charm.

East of the gate is the Zhusheng Pavilion, containing two repair stele records: one is the Wanli-era "Record of Repairing Qingjing Temple," and the other is the Zhengde-era "Re-erected Stele of Qingjing Temple.

" West of the gate is the Fengtian Altar, now only retaining stone walls, stone columns, and column bases.

The door openings on the walls are in the form of flame arches, with multiple Arabic inscriptions.The columns and bases are all cylindrical.

The column grid is three by four, of varying heights, with mortise openings still remaining on the columns.The column bases have relief-carved floral patterns.

At the west end of the altar hall is a niche room, the direction of prayer.

Further west in the auxiliary courtyard there are also ancient Islamic stone carvings and ancient Muslim stone tomb covers and other furnishings.

Entering the inner courtyard northward from the gate, the north wall directly opposite is embedded with an imperial edict stele from the fifth year of Yongle reign of the Ming (1407), and at the west end of the courtyard is Mingshan Hall.

This hall was first built in the first year of Longqing reign of the Ming (1567); the existing building is a Qing Dynasty reconstruction, with a combined Chinese-Western style.

The oil paint and colored decorations are relatively new, suggesting repairs in recent years.

推荐级别：★★★★★

清源山老君岩·石室

No.215
Laozi Statue and Stone Chamber at Qingyuan Mountain
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：元
地址：泉州市清源山风景名胜区内
类型：宗教建筑
特征标签 Highlights
元代石雕造像工艺石柱建筑遗迹泉州之所以叫作泉州是因为清源山上泉眼众多在古代东方第一大港有这样的好去处自然人文荟萃古迹深厚经过自古以来儒道释三家竞相经营清源山上还有伊斯兰教摩尼教印度教的活动踪迹
中文 Chinese

泉州之所以叫作泉州，是因为清源山上泉眼众多。在古代"东方第一大港"有这样的好去处，自然人文荟萃、古迹深厚。经过自古以来儒、道、释三家竞相经营，清源山上还有伊斯兰教、摩尼教、印度教的活动踪迹，发展成为多种宗教兼容并蓄的文化名山。

景区内宗教寺庙宫观、文人书院石室以及石雕石构石刻等文物为主的人文景观几乎遍布清源山的每个角落。

现存完好的宋、元时期道教、佛教大型石雕共7处，历代摩崖石刻近500处。

元代以来花岗岩仿木结构佛像石室3处，以及近代高僧弘一法师舍利塔和广钦法师塔院。其中老君岩的装饰纹样，以及弥陀岩和瑞像岩的仿木石室最具特点。老君岩造像是独一无二的艺术瑰宝。造像成于宋代。

清乾隆《泉州府志》说："石像天成，好事者略施雕琢。"字里行间充满了道教的传奇味道。

石像高5.63米，厚6.85米，宽8.01米，占地面积55平方米，是我国现存最大，雕技最绝，年代最久的道教石雕造像。

与福州瑞岩弥勒佛像的情况类似，老君岩原有一座高大的道观围护，可惜后来道观被焚，只有老君岩的装饰细节留下来给我们讲述一些带有早期标签性质的做法特征了。顺着山路寻访，过了千手岩和弘一法师舍利塔就是弥陀岩了。这里的仿木石构石室，建于元顺帝至正二十四年（1364年）。

石室重檐攒尖顶，上施窣堵坡式顶刹，下层丰满，上层尺度很小似不甚协调。室身浮雕木结构构件，中开门洞。檐下雕刻斗拱，五铺作，偷心造，四朵补间铺作，转角铺作栌斗尺度显著大于补间，角部施由昂。石室内的阿弥陀佛立像就天然崖壁雕凿而成。

去瑞像岩则要走向东的山路，需要途径碧霄岩继续东行。瑞像岩石室建于北宋元祐二年（1086年），依天柱峰山石雕刻释迦迦佛像。明成化十九年（1483年）建仿木构石室。

石室形制与弥陀岩类似，只是两层中上层呈一方形小屋。室身雕刻、斗拱做法表现出与弥陀岩的继承关系。

English

Quanzhou is called Quanzhou (Spring Prefecture) because there are numerous springs on Qingyuan Mountain.In ancient times, as the "No.

1 Port of the East," having such a fine place naturally meant a gathering of humanities and profound historical sites.

Through the successive operations of Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism since ancient times, Qingyuan Mountain also has traces of Islamic, Manichaean, and Hindu activities, developing into a famous cultural mountain where multiple religions coexist.

Within the scenic area, humanistic landscapes dominated by cultural relics such as religious temples and palaces, literati academies and stone chambers, as well as stone carvings, stone structures, and stone inscriptions, almost cover every corner of Qingyuan Mountain.

There are 7 well-preserved large-scale Daoist and Buddhist stone carvings from the Song and Yuan periods, and nearly 500 cliffside inscriptions from successive dynasties.

Since the Yuan Dynasty, there are 3 granite timber-imitating stone chambers for Buddha statues, as well as the stupa of modern eminent monk Master Hongyi and the pagoda courtyard of Master Guangqin.

Among them, the decorative patterns of Laojun Rock, and the timber-imitating stone chambers of Mituo Rock and Ruixiang Rock are the most distinctive.

The Laojun Rock statue is a unique artistic treasure.The statue was created in the Song Dynasty.

The Qianlong-era "Quanzhou Prefecture Gazetteer" says: "The stone statue was naturally formed, and an enthusiast applied slight carving." Between the lines is full of the legendary flavor of Daoism.

The stone statue is 5.63 meters high, 6.85 meters thick, 8.

01 meters wide, covering 55 square meters; it is the largest, most exquisitely carved, and oldest Daoist stone carving existing in China.

Similar to the situation of the Mile (Maitreya) Buddha statue at Ruiyan in Fuzhou, Laojun Rock originally had a tall Daoist temple surrounding it; unfortunately the temple was later burned down, and only the decorative details of Laojun Rock remain to tell us about some construction features with early-period labels.

Following the mountain path to visit, after passing Qianshou Rock and the stupa of Master Hongyi, one reaches Mituo Rock.

The timber-imitating stone chamber here was built in the 24th year of Zhizheng reign of Emperor Shun of the Yuan (1364).

The stone chamber has a double-eave pyramidal roof, topped with a stupa-style finial; the lower story is full, while the upper story is very small in scale, seeming somewhat不协调.

The chamber body has relief-carved timber structure components, with a door opening in the center.

Under the eaves, dougong are carved, five-step bracket sets, in the touxin (stealth) style, with four intermediate bracket sets; the cap block of the corner bracket set is significantly larger than that of the intermediate sets, with you'ang (corner ang) applied at the corners.

The standing statue of Amitabha Buddha inside the stone chamber was carved from the natural cliff face.

To go to Ruixiang Rock, one must take the eastward mountain path, passing through Bixiao Rock and continuing east.

The Ruixiang Rock stone chamber was built in the second year of Yuanyou reign of the Northern Song (1086), with a statue of Shakyamuni Buddha carved from the stone of Tianzhu Peak.

In the 19th year of Chenghua reign of the Ming (1483), a timber-imitating stone chamber was built.

The form of the stone chamber is similar to that of Mituo Rock, except that among the two stories, the upper one is a square small room.

The chamber body carvings and dougong construction show an继承 relationship with Mituo Rock.

推荐级别：★★★★★

天后宫·德济门遗址

No.216
Temple of the Queen of Heaven and Site of Deji Gate
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：泉州市南门天后路一号
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构泉州古城的南门叫作德济门今天只剩下了城门和城垣的遗址这里曾经出土过伊斯兰教印度教犹太教佛教基督教等宗教石刻那是怎样的昨日的繁华与德济门错开遥相呼应的是泉州天后宫的大门飞檐和灯笼跳跃而热烈
中文 Chinese

泉州古城的南门叫作"德济门"，今天只剩下了城门和城垣的遗址。这里曾经出土过伊斯兰教、印度教、犹太教、佛教、基督教等宗教石刻，那是怎样的昨日的繁华！与德济门错开遥相呼应的是泉州天后宫的大门，飞檐和灯笼，跳跃而热烈，是今天的高楼大厦中的点缀。

处在"蕃舶客航聚集之地"，泉州天后宫建于南宋庆元二年（公元1196年），无论规格还是规模都是不输于人的。

其后元代（1278年）下诏"制封泉州神女护国明著灵惠协正善庆显济天妃"，明代郑和下西洋时也奏令福建镇守官重新其庙，永乐十三年（1415年）改宫号为"天妃宫"。

清康熙十九年（1680年）施琅征海，得敕封"护国庇民妙灵昭应宏仁普济天后"，后易宫名为"天后宫"。如今的天后宫山门不是原来的，而是搬迁来支援的晋江县学的棂星门，好在都是泉州帮的作品。

门座面阔三间带左右旁门，青石龙柱，两侧石雕麒麟，螭虎窗，屋顶单檐歇山，屋脊三段划分，反翘贴瓷八龙二鳄，角脊成凤尾伸展而卷曲，线条柔和优美，整体结构华丽壮观。戏台连接...

English

The south gate of ancient Quanzhou city was called "Deji Gate," and today only the ruins of the gate and city wall remain.

Religious stone carvings of Islam, Hinduism, Judaism, Buddhism, Christianity, and others have been excavated here — what a prosperity of yesterday!

Offset from and echoing Deji Gate from afar is the main gate of Quanzhou Tianhou Palace, with flying eaves and lanterns, lively and warm, an ornament among today's high-rise buildings.

Located in a "place where foreign ships and passenger vessels gathered," Quanzhou Tianhou Palace was built in the second year of Qingyuan reign of the Southern Song (1196 AD), and in both specifications and scale it is second to none.

Later, in the Yuan Dynasty (1278), an imperial edict was issued to "confer upon the Quanzhou goddess the title of Tianfei (Heavenly Consort) who protects the nation, manifests brightness, shows spiritual power, assists righteousness, celebrates goodness, and brings salvation"; during Zheng He's voyages to the Western Seas in the Ming Dynasty, he also petitioned to order the Fujian garrison commander to rebuild the temple, and in the 13th year of Yongle reign (1415) the palace name was changed to "Tianfei Palace.

" In the 19th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1680), Shi Lang's maritime campaign received the imperial conferral of "Tianhou (Empress of Heaven) who protects the nation and people, manifests wondrous spiritual power, and universally saves through great benevolence," and the palace name was later changed to "Tianhou Palace.

" Today's gate of Tianhou Palace is not the original, but the Lingxing Gate moved here from the Jinjiang County School to support it; fortunately, both are works of the Quanzhou school.

The gate base is three bays wide with side gates on left and right, with blue stone dragon columns, stone-carved qilin on both sides, and chihu (hornless dragon) windows; the roof has a single-eave hip-and-gable style, with the roof ridge divided into three sections, with upturned porcelain-inlaid eight dragons and two crocodiles; the corner ridges extend and curl like phoenix tails, with soft and elegant lines, and the overall structure is gorgeous and spectacular.

The stage connects...

推荐级别：★★★★

杨阿苗民居

No.217
Vernacular Dwelling of Yang Amiao
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清—民国
地址：泉州市鲤城区江南街道办事处亭店社区典当路7号
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
近现代民居格局工艺做法虽然建造年代并不古远但是杨家人大可拍着胸脯说我们的房子是清光绪二十年1894年动工光绪三十年1906年完工的亭店社区是泉州著名的侨乡几千居民中杨姓为主其次是林陈等姓氏早期社区人员远播菲律宾印度尼西亚美国越南等地清代民国华侨回乡建有古建筑几十座鲤城区志人物传介绍杨氏民居的创建人是杨阿苗1865至1932年名嘉种菲律宾华侨
中文 Chinese

虽然建造年代并不古远，但是杨家人大可拍着胸脯说："我们的房子是清光绪二十年（1894年）动工，光绪三十年（1906年）完工的。"亭店社区是泉州著名的侨乡，几千居民中，杨姓为主，其次是林、陈等姓氏。

早期社区人员远播菲律宾、印度尼西亚、美国、越南等地，清代、民国华侨回乡建有古建筑几十座。《鲤城区志·人物传》介绍，杨氏民居的创建人是杨阿苗（1865—1932年），名嘉种，菲律宾华侨，十七八岁上去了菲律宾，后来继承其叔父的商行，成为菲律宾经营土特产的著名侨商。

他为人乐善好施，1906年华北大水灾时便捐巨款赈济，荣获清朝光绪皇帝和慈禧太后赐"福"字、"寿"字两匾，1911年还和他人发起捐建泉州第一座钢筋混凝土桥梁——顺济桥，最后不足款项由他补齐。

民居主体建筑是由五开间的硬山式房屋组成的两进院落，东西两侧各带一组护厝，前有三面围以红砖墙的大石埕。

中轴线依次有斗门、门厅、天井、大厅、后轩，每进大小厅和后轩的东西耳房2间，天井两侧有厢房带前廊、通廊，设6个边门通东西护厝。

东西护厝各有独立通外的斗门，内有花厅，东护厝还有1座卷棚式方亭和1口八角形花岗岩井盘的水井。花厅后为卧房，并配有天井，各自成一独立的小庭院。

全部建筑有大小厅堂（包括后轩）7间、大小房间26间、大小天井9个，方亭1座，井1口，布局相当严谨，显得小巧玲珑而又气派宏伟。

特别是主体建筑的中间辟有1个大天井，两翼又各辟2个小天井，俗称"五梅花天井"，独具特色。整座民居突出的特点是精美的装饰。

石雕、木雕、砖雕、交趾陶、灰雕南洋釉面砖，种类繁多，细致入微又不失雅气，堪称闽南近现代时期传统民居的代表作。

English

Although the construction date is not ancient, the Yang family can proudly say: "Our house was started in the 20th year of Guangxu reign of the Qing (1894) and completed in the 30th year of Guangxu reign (1906).

" Tingdian Community is a famous overseas Chinese hometown in Quanzhou; among its several thousand residents, the Yang surname is predominant, followed by Lin, Chen, and other surnames.

Early community members spread as far as the Philippines, Indonesia, the United States, and Vietnam; during the Qing and Republican periods, overseas Chinese returning home built dozens of ancient buildings.

According to the "Biographies" section of the "Licheng District Gazetteer," the founder of the Yang dwelling was Yang Amiao (1865–1932), also named Yang Jiazhong, an overseas Chinese in the Philippines.

He went to the Philippines at around 17 or 18, later inherited his uncle's trading firm, and became a famous overseas Chinese merchant dealing in local products in the Philippines.

He was known for his charity; during the great North China flood of 1906, he donated a large sum for relief, and was honored by the Qing Guangxu Emperor and Empress Dowager Cixi with two plaques inscribed "Fu" (Blessing) and "Shou" (Longevity).

In 1911, he also initiated, together with others, the donation to build Quanzhou's first reinforced concrete bridge — Shunji Bridge — and the final shortfall was made up by him.

The main building of the dwelling is a two-courtyard compound composed of five-bay gable-roofed (yingshan) houses, with a set of side wings (hucuo) on each of the east and west sides, and a large stone courtyard in front enclosed on three sides by red brick walls.

Along the central axis are依次 the doumen (side gate), entrance hall, courtyard, main hall, and rear porch; each courtyard has 2 east and west side rooms for the main and secondary halls and rear porch.

On both sides of the courtyard are wing rooms with front corridors and connecting corridors, with 6 side doors leading to the east and west side wings.

The east and west side wings each have an independent outer gate, with flower halls inside; the east side wing also has 1 rolling-eave square pavilion and 1 well with an octagonal granite well rim.

Behind the flower halls are bedrooms, each with its own courtyard, forming independent small courtyards.

The entire building has 7 large and small halls (including rear porches), 26 large and small rooms, 9 large and small courtyards, 1 square pavilion, and 1 well; the layout is quite rigorous, appearing both exquisite and grand.

In particular, the center of the main building has 1 large courtyard, and each wing has 2 small courtyards, commonly known as the "Five Plum Blossom Courtyards," uniquely distinctive.

The outstanding feature of the entire dwelling is its exquisite decoration.

Stone carvings, wood carvings, brick carvings, cochin pottery, plaster carvings, and Nanyang glazed tiles — of many types, meticulous yet elegant — it can be called a representative work of traditional vernacular dwellings in the modern period of southern Fujian.

推荐级别：★★★

伊斯兰教圣墓

No.218
Holy Tomb of Islam
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：唐—元—清
地址：泉州市丰泽区灵山南麓
类型：陵寝建筑·砖石结构
特征标签 Highlights
砖石结构仿木做法装饰纹样一条北渠仿佛是要隔开尘世与彼岸一片葱郁覆盖着寻访凭吊的石板路据闽书方域志唐武德年间618至626年穆罕默德四位阿拉伯门徒来华其中两位来泉州传教殁葬于此后人尊称为三贤四贤其墓尊称为圣墓
中文 Chinese

一条北渠仿佛是要隔开尘世与彼岸，一片葱郁覆盖着寻访凭吊的石板路。据《闽书·方域志》，唐武德年间（618—626年），穆罕默德四位阿拉伯门徒来华，其中两位来泉州传教，殁葬于此，后人尊称为三贤、四贤，其墓尊称为圣墓。两位贤者的墓葬并列而置，造型简明，曲线微妙，底座饰覆莲纹。

现有一亭覆盖其上，实为20世纪60年代新建，歇山顶，石构仿木。墓后建有马蹄形三面回廊，亦石构仿木。斗拱做法不规则，把头绞项或单斗只替，北面柱头斗拱做法较清晰，东西两面因屋檐降低一材之高，泥道拱降至与栌斗同一水平承枋，做法特异。

廊下陈列碑刻五通，最早者为正中的元至治二年（1322年）修墓时阿拉伯文碑记，旁有郑和第五次奉使西洋行香碑，另有康熙、乾隆及同治年间重修碑记。墓园周围还有历代伊斯兰教徒的石棺墓，落叶为伴，古色沧桑；更有风吹欲动的巨石"碧玉毬"，系泉州胜景之一的"玉球风动"。

English

A northern canal seems to separate the mortal world from the beyond, and a lush green covers the stone path for visiting and paying homage.

According to the "Geography" section of the "Min Shu" (Fujian Book), during the Wude reign of the Tang (618–626), four Arab disciples of Muhammad came to China; two of them came to Quanzhou to preach, died and were buried here, and later generations respectfully called them the Third Sage and Fourth Sage, and their tombs are respectfully called the Holy Tomb.

The tombs of the two sages are placed side by side, with simple造型 and subtle curves, and the bases are decorated with inverted lotus patterns.

There is now a pavilion covering them, actually newly built in the 1960s, with a hip-and-gable roof, in stone structure imitating timber.

Behind the tomb is a horseshoe-shaped three-sided cloister, also in stone structure imitating timber.

The dougong construction is irregular, using toujiao jiaoxiang or single dou zhi ti; the column-head dougong on the north side is relatively clear in construction; on the east and west sides, because the eaves are lowered by one cai (timber unit) in height, the nidao gong (mud-road bracket) is lowered to the same level as the ludou (cap block) to support the fang (beam), a peculiar construction.

Under the cloister are displayed five stele inscriptions; the earliest is the Arabic inscription in the center from the second year of Zhizhi reign of the Yuan (1322) when repairing the tomb; beside it is the stele of Zheng He's fifth voyage to the Western Seas performing incense rites; there are also repair stele records from the Kangxi, Qianlong, and Tongzhi reigns.

Around the tomb garden there are also stone sarcophagi of Islamic believers from successive dynasties, with fallen leaves as companions, ancient and weathered; there is also a huge stone "Jade Ball" that seems about to move in the wind, one of Quanzhou's famous scenic spots known as "Jade Ball Moved by Wind.

"

推荐级别：★★★★★

真武庙

No.219
Zhenwu Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：泉州市丰泽区东海街道石头街法石社区
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构古建筑选址是大有学问的依山面海的泉州真武庙东边是古刺桐港西边距离泉州城不过里许南与晋江市隔江相望所在之地古木森森虽没有武当山的雄奇却有大海的襟怀称作小武当自有它的道理真武庙供奉玄天上帝宋代时作为郡守望祭海神之所自此历经五个朝代香火长盛不衰
中文 Chinese

古建筑选址是大有学问的。依山面海的泉州真武庙，东边是古刺桐港，西边距离泉州城不过里许，南与晋江市隔江相望。所在之地古木森森，虽没有武当山的雄奇，却有大海的襟怀，称作"小武当"自有它的道理。真武庙供奉玄天上帝，宋代时作为"郡守望祭海神之所"，自此历经五个朝代，香火长盛不衰。庙坐东朝西，主要建筑有山门、拜亭、真武殿。山门的气势配得上武当的名头。

这本是一座四柱三间三层牌楼，檐下施如意斗拱，但是倒是两边的山墙和八字影壁配合起来，让它具有的不凡的气魄，而门内幽深的22级石台阶则完美地添加了道教的洞天意味。此外，门左侧有古井一口，名为"三蟹龙泉"，是明万历十四年（1586年）开凿的。进门上阶，前有巨石，石旁有拜亭。

石上有明嘉靖十二年（1533年）晋江知县韩岳立"吞海"石碑一通；亭则重修于清同治九年（1870年）。一老一少相伴也有140多年了。

亭子用重檐攒尖顶，下层檐四角，上层八角，内饰藻井。庙的殿堂部分不大，一进院落，主殿面阔进深各五间，穿斗式木构架，单檐歇山顶。

左旁原建有观音堂，今圮。此部分重建于清道光二十二年（1842年），1985年复重修大木结构，希望不是伤筋动骨的那种。此地古木荫翳，微风习习，确实是泉州一大胜境。

English

The site selection of ancient buildings is a profound学问.

Zhenwu Temple in Quanzhou, nestled against mountains and facing the sea, has the ancient Citong Port to its east, is only about a li from Quanzhou city to its west, and faces Jinjiang City across the river to its south.

The place is densely wooded with ancient trees; although it lacks the grandeur of Wudang Mountain, it has the breadth of the sea, and calling it "Little Wudang" has its own logic.

Zhenwu Temple worships Xuantian Shangdi (the Dark Heavenly Emperor); in the Song Dynasty, it served as the "place where the prefect watched and sacrificed to the sea god," and since then, through five dynasties, its incense has never ceased.

The temple faces west, with main buildings including the mountain gate, worship pavilion, and Zhenwu Hall.The imposing manner of the mountain gate lives up to the Wudang name.

This was originally a four-column three-bay three-story paifai (memorial archway), with ruyi dougong under the eaves; however, it is the combination of the gable walls on both sides and the splayed screen walls that gives it its extraordinary imposing manner, while the deep 22-step stone staircase inside the gate perfectly adds the Daoist cave-heaven flavor.

In addition, on the left side of the gate is an ancient well called "Three Crab Dragon Spring," dug in the 14th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1586).

Entering the gate and ascending the steps, there is a huge stone in front, with a worship pavilion beside it.

On the stone is a stele inscribed "Tunhai" (Swallowing the Sea) erected by Han Yue, magistrate of Jinjiang, in the 12th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1533); the pavilion was repaired in the 9th year of Tongzhi reign of the Qing (1870).

The old and young have accompanied each other for over 140 years.

The pavilion uses a double-eave pyramidal roof, with four corners on the lower eave and eight corners on the upper, with a caisson ceiling inside.

The hall part of the temple is not large, with one courtyard; the main hall is five bays wide and five bays deep, with a chuandou (column-and-tie) timber frame and a single-eave hip-and-gable roof.

To the left there was originally a Guanyin Hall, now ruined.

This part was rebuilt in the 22nd year of Daoguang reign of the Qing (1842), and the major timber structure was repaired again in 1985 — hopefully not the kind that breaks bones and sinews.

This place, with ancient trees casting shade and gentle breezes, is indeed one of Quanzhou's great scenic spots.

推荐级别：★★★★

安海龙山寺

No.220
Longshan Temple in Anhai
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：晋江市安海型厝村北龙山
类型：宗教建筑
特征标签 Highlights
凭吊晋江安海龙山寺供奉千手千眼观音信众如潮隋越王皇泰年间618至619年始建寺奉祀明天启三年1623年重修但说到龙山寺的重要性则不仅在于寺院本身更在于其远播的影响据说在台湾就有二百多座龙山寺建筑形式都与晋江龙山寺大致相同也供奉千手千眼观音
中文 Chinese

晋江安海龙山寺供奉千手千眼观音，信众如潮。隋越王皇泰年间（618—619年）始建寺奉祀。明天启三年（1623年）重修。但说到龙山寺的重要性则不仅在于寺院本身，更在于其远播的影响。据说在台湾就有二百多座龙山寺，建筑形式都与晋江龙山寺大致相同，也供奉千手千眼观音。台湾龙山寺中最著名的是鹿港的龙山寺和台北艋舺的龙山寺。

鹿港的创建于明代，是安海龙山寺主持肇善禅师带着建筑图样前往仿建的，主要工匠则是惠安人王益顺，木料、石头、砖瓦也是一起从泉州运过去的。台北的则是清末时旅台乡亲派代表共赴安海，拿了图纸去建造的。转过放生池，入得"龙山古地"牌楼，就是龙山寺前的大埕。

寺门，又叫金刚殿，面阔五间，单檐歇山顶，屋脊三段划分，轮廓丰富，线条柔和。廊前有石狮、石鼓各一对，再两侧为钟鼓楼。门内院落中有拜亭一座，被唤作天坛，是献祭的主要舞台。大雄宝殿，即圆通宝殿，晚清重建之物。

装饰繁复，木刻、石雕、瓷塑、彩绘遍布，殿前一对清道光年所立的八角形透雕辉绿岩盘龙柱工艺不凡，龙爪各抓一鼓一罄，击之各发鼓、罄之音。殿内则为主尊千手千眼菩萨立像。独木雕就，高4.2米，通身贴金箔，雍容华贵。大殿之后还有新建的藏经阁。

寺中多历代名人墨迹。

English

Longshan Temple in Anhai, Jinjiang, worships the Thousand-Hand Thousand-Eye Guanyin, with devotees flocking like tides.

The temple was first built for worship during the Huangtai reign of the Sui (618–619).It was repaired in the third year of Tianqi reign of the Ming (1623).

But when speaking of the importance of Longshan Temple, it lies not only in the temple itself, but even more in its far-reaching influence.

It is said that there are over two hundred Longshan Temples in Taiwan, all with architectural forms roughly similar to Jinjiang Longshan Temple, and all worshiping the Thousand-Hand Thousand-Eye Guanyin.

The most famous among Taiwan's Longshan Temples are the one in Lukang and the one in Mengjia, Taipei.

The one in Lukang was founded in the Ming Dynasty; it was built by Master Zhaoshan, abbot of Anhai Longshan Temple, who took architectural drawings there to imitate; the main craftsman was Wang Yishun from Hui'an, and the timber, stone, bricks, and tiles were also shipped together from Quanzhou.

The one in Taipei was built in the late Qing when fellow townspeople in Taiwan sent representatives to Anhai together to obtain drawings for construction.

Turning past the release pond, entering the "Ancient Land of Longshan" paifai, one reaches the large courtyard in front of Longshan Temple.

The temple gate, also called the Vajra Hall, is five bays wide, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, the roof ridge divided into three sections, with rich contours and soft lines.

In front of the corridor are a pair of stone lions and a pair of stone drums, with the bell and drum towers further on both sides.

In the courtyard inside the gate is a worship pavilion, called the "Altar of Heaven," the main stage for sacrifices.

The Mahavira Hall, also called the Yuantong Hall, is a late Qing reconstruction.

With elaborate decoration, wood carvings, stone carvings, porcelain sculptures, and colored paintings everywhere; in front of the hall is a pair of octagonal openwork diabase dragon columns erected in the Daoguang reign of the Qing, with extraordinary craftsmanship — each dragon claw grasps a drum and a chime, and striking them produces the sounds of drum and chime respectively.

Inside the hall is the main standing statue of the Thousand-Hand Thousand-Eye Bodhisattva.Carved from a single tree, 4.2 meters high, covered entirely with gold leaf, dignified and elegant.

Behind the main hall is a newly built scripture library.The temple contains many calligraphic works by famous people of successive dynasties.

推荐级别：★

安平桥

No.221
Anping Bridge
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：泉州市晋江安海镇和泉州市南安水头镇之间
类型：桥梁·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石桥结构历代碑记晋江安海镇古称安平道这里的我国现存最长的古桥长约5华里的五里桥就叫作安平桥晋江县志记载晋江南安之界旧日以舟渡宋绍兴八年僧祖派始筑石桥未就二十一年来赵令衿成之酾水三百六十二道长八百十有一丈宽一丈六尺后来明清两代曾多次重修
中文 Chinese

晋江安海镇古称安平道，这里的我国现存最长的古桥——长约5华里的五里桥，就叫作安平桥。《晋江县志》记载："晋江、南安之界，旧日以舟渡，宋绍兴八年，僧祖派始筑石桥未就，二十一年来赵令衿成之，酾水三百六十二道，长八百十有一丈，宽一丈六尺……"。后来明清两代曾多次重修。安平桥是典型的连梁式石板平桥。

桥全长2255米，桥面宽3米至3.8米，共用361个花岗岩条石桥墩分成"酾水三百六十二道"。或许是特意为河水缓急而做的设计，或许也有历代修缮的原因，桥墩采用了长方形、单边船形、双边船形三种不同形式。桥面则用4米至8条大石板铺架。

石板跨度5米至11米，每条宽0.6米至1米，厚0.5米至1米，算来最大的石板重达25吨。桥面两侧有石护栏，栏柱头雕刻动物等形象。桥上筑憩亭五座。

东端为水心亭，西端为海潮庵，中部有中亭；在三亭之间，按里程划分还有两座雨亭，正好凑足5里。亭座周围保存历代修桥碑记16通。亭前伫立宋代石雕护桥将军，顶盔披甲，手执利剑，气度威武。

桥两侧的水中筑有四座对称的方形石塔、一座圆塔，桥的入口处筑有一座白塔，高22米，砖砌，五层，平面呈六角形，空心。今天的古桥已经和当地生活融在一起，毫不显示自己的不凡。那些在桥对面镇中学读书的孩子每天都会在这座桥上走两三个来回。

English

Anhai Town in Jinjiang was anciently called Anping Dao; here lies China's longest existing ancient bridge — the Five-Li Bridge, about 5 Chinese li long — called Anping Bridge.

The "Jinjiang County Gazetteer" records: "At the boundary of Jinjiang and Nan'an, in olden days crossing was by boat; in the eighth year of Shaoxing reign of the Song, the monk Zupai began building a stone bridge but did not finish it; in the 21st year, Zhao Lingjin completed it, with 362 water openings, a length of 811 zhang, and a width of 1 zhang 6 chi.

.." Later, both the Ming and Qing dynasties repaired it many times.Anping Bridge is a typical continuous-beam stone slab flat bridge.

The bridge is 2,255 meters long, with a deck 3 to 3.8 meters wide, using 361 granite strip stone piers divided into "362 water openings.

" Perhaps it was a design specifically for the varying speed of the river water, or perhaps due to repairs through successive dynasties, the piers adopt three different forms: rectangular, single-sided boat-shaped, and double-sided boat-shaped.

The deck is paved with 4 to 8 large stone slabs.The stone slabs span 5 to 11 meters, each 0.6 to 1 meter wide and 0.5 to 1 meter thick; the largest slab weighs up to 25 tons.

On both sides of the deck are stone guardrails, with animal and other figures carved on the railing capitals.Five rest pavilions are built on the bridge.

The east end is the Water Heart Pavilion, the west end is the Sea Tide Nunnery, and the middle has the Central Pavilion; between the three pavilions, divided by mileage, there are two rain pavilions, making exactly 5 li.

Around the pavilion bases are preserved 16 stele records of bridge repairs from successive dynasties.

In front of the pavilion stands a Song Dynasty stone-carved bridge-guarding general, wearing a helmet and armor, holding a sharp sword, with a majestic bearing.

In the water on both sides of the bridge are built four symmetrical square stone pagodas and one round pagoda; at the entrance of the bridge is built a white pagoda, 22 meters high, brick-built, five stories, with a hexagonal plan, hollow inside.

Today's ancient bridge has merged with local life, showing no sign of its extraordinariness.

The children who study at the town middle school across the bridge walk back and forth on this bridge two or three times every day.

推荐级别：★★★★

陈埭丁氏宗祠

No.222
Ancestral Temple Complex for Ding's Clan at Chendi
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：晋江市陈埭镇岸兜村
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构与特色装饰陈埭丁氏祖墓群在泉州灵山陈埭丁氏宗祠坐落于晋江市陈埭镇岸兜村这里可能是福建最大的穆斯林聚居区这里穆斯林的先民是七百多年前沿着海上丝绸之路登陆的阿拉伯商人
中文 Chinese

陈埭丁氏祖墓群在泉州灵山。陈埭丁氏宗祠坐落于晋江市陈埭镇岸兜村。这里可能是福建最大的穆斯林聚居区。

这里穆斯林的先民是七百多年前沿着海上丝绸之路登陆的阿拉伯商人，元明易朝，裔族避居陈埭后，乃以先祖赛典赤瞻思丁（1222—1279年）名字最后音节的音译为姓，由是相传。如今走在陈埭的街巷里，还能偶尔看到带有异族容貌的丁家人。

宗祠始建于明代初年，历经修葺、重建、扩筑，是福建省内历史最悠久、规模最宏大、保存最完整的回族祠堂。宗祠坐北朝南，以廊庑连接殿堂形成院落，有心人还发现宗祠整体布局构成汉字"回"字形，后殿东北削角砌筑，更似汉字书法转角顿笔。

中轴线上主要建筑自南至北依次为泮池、门埕、前厅、中堂、后殿，除泮池外。建筑普遍采用闽南泉州地区的传统民居营造技术，以木结构为骨架，以砖石构造围护，饰以各类装饰。"回"字的外框南侧为宗祠正门，两侧设介绍丁氏家族历史和历代名人的展柜；后殿则为近代名人祠。

院中中堂是宗祠建筑群的核心，神龛供奉丁氏列祖列宗神主，每年春秋致祭。门楣上方的木雕、廊心墙的石雕都以阿拉伯文组字装饰。其他建筑木作、砖作、石作同样颇具匠心，装饰题材纹样丰富，彩绘艳丽多彩。

宗祠里保留有匾额18方，石刻、漆书楹联近30对，诉说着丁氏宗族的辉煌历史。丁氏族人由经商转入汉人的耕读文化，明清两代登进士者十二人、举人廿一人。远望村里清真寺的穹顶，感叹当时丁氏家族融入中国社会的努力。

能够保护好哪怕一点点丁氏宗祠的独特之处，也是对文化多样性的贡献了。

English

The ancestral tomb complex of the Ding clan at Chendai is at Lingshan in Quanzhou.The Chendai Ding Clan Ancestral Temple is located in Andou Village, Chendai Town, Jinjiang City.

This may be the largest Muslim settlement in Fujian.

The ancestors of the Muslims here were Arab merchants who landed over seven hundred years ago along the Maritime Silk Road; when the Yuan gave way to the Ming, the descendants took refuge in Chendai, and then took the transliteration of the last syllable of the name of their ancestor Sayyid Ajall Shams al-Din (1222–1279) as their surname, passed down from then on.

Walking through the streets and alleys of Chendai today, one can occasionally see Ding family members with foreign features.

The ancestral temple was first built in the early Ming Dynasty, and through successive repairs, reconstructions, and expansions, it is the oldest, largest, and best-preserved Hui ethnic ancestral temple in Fujian Province.

The ancestral temple faces south, with corridors connecting the halls to form courtyards; observant people have also discovered that the overall layout of the ancestral temple forms the Chinese character "hui" (return), with the northeast corner of the rear hall built at a beveled angle, even more like the turning stroke and pause of Chinese calligraphy.

The main buildings along the central axis from south to north are依次 the Pan Pond, gate courtyard, front hall, central hall, and rear hall, excluding the Pan Pond.

The buildings generally adopt the traditional vernacular construction techniques of the Quanzhou region in southern Fujian, with timber structure as the skeleton, brick and stone construction as enclosure, decorated with various ornaments.

The south side of the outer frame of the "hui" character is the main gate of the ancestral temple, with display cabinets on both sides introducing the history of the Ding family and famous people of successive generations; the rear hall is the ancestral hall of modern celebrities.

The central hall in the courtyard is the core of the ancestral temple complex, with the shrine enshrining the spirit tablets of the Ding clan's successive ancestors, with sacrifices held every spring and autumn.

The wood carvings above the door lintels and the stone carvings on the corridor center walls are all decorated with Arabic character compositions.

The timber, brick, and stone work of other buildings is also quite ingenious, with rich decorative themes and patterns, and gorgeous and colorful paintings.

The ancestral temple preserves 18 plaques and nearly 30 pairs of stone-carved and lacquer-written couplets, telling the glorious history of the Ding clan.

The Ding clan members shifted from commerce to the Han Chinese farming-and-reading culture; during the Ming and Qing dynasties, twelve became jinshi and twenty-one became juren.

Looking from afar at the dome of the village mosque, one sighs at the efforts of the Ding family to integrate into Chinese society at that time.

Being able to protect even a little bit of the uniqueness of the Ding Ancestral Temple is also a contribution to cultural diversity.

推荐级别：★★

东石玉记商行建筑群

No.223
Yu's Family Business Houses in Dongshi
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：晋江市东石镇第四社区
类型：商业建筑
特征标签 Highlights
传统民居木作砖石作东石港原为泉州三湾十二港之一东石镇是闽南重点侨乡之一也是著名台胞祖籍地据当地老人回忆当年东石港十分繁忙满载台湾土特产的大商船可以沿着石井江一直开到玉记号门前的码头卸货可惜由于港口淤积和人工填海如今的玉记建筑群已离海渐远
中文 Chinese

东石港原为泉州"三湾十二港"之一，东石镇是闽南重点侨乡之一，也是著名台胞祖籍地。据当地老人回忆，当年东石港十分繁忙，满载台湾土特产的大商船，可以沿着石井江一直开到"玉记号"门前的码头卸货。可惜，由于港口淤积和人工填海，如今的玉记建筑群已离海渐远。所谓的"玉记号"，就是清代晚期东石玉井房的蔡章岜、蔡章湾、蔡章叶三兄弟合力创办的。

到了光绪年间（1875—1908年）兴旺发达，进而在东石港附近扩建，成为东石富户。仅现存建筑就有大厝八座和栈房二座，排列有序。和参观平遥的票号不同，这里除了库房之外，难以寻见建筑功能与商业行为的密切关联。真是不好想象当时的商业活动是怎样在这般居住院落的"容器"中悄然运行的。

大厝采用当地传统形式，木结构为骨架，红砖白石垒砌围护，辅以各类装饰小品。大木油饰色调以黑红色为基调，多见书法作品作为内檐装修板新图案。

English

Dongshi Port was originally one of Quanzhou's "Three Bays and Twelve Ports"; Dongshi Town is one of the key overseas Chinese hometowns in southern Fujian, and also a famous ancestral home of Taiwan compatriots.

According to recollections of local elders, Dongshi Port was very busy in those days; large merchant ships fully loaded with Taiwanese local products could sail along the Shijing River all the way to the dock in front of the "Yu Ji Hao" (Yu's Mark) to unload.

Unfortunately, due to port siltation and artificial land reclamation, today's Yu building complex is gradually moving away from the sea.

The so-called "Yu Ji Hao" was jointly founded by three brothers — Cai Zhangba, Cai Zhangwan, and Cai Zhangye — of the Yujing branch in Dongshi in the late Qing Dynasty.

It flourished during the Guangxu reign (1875–1908), and then expanded near Dongshi Port, becoming a wealthy household in Dongshi.

The existing buildings alone include eight large mansions (dacuo) and two warehouses, arranged in an orderly manner.

Unlike visiting the piaohao (remittance houses) of Pingyao, here apart from the warehouses, it is difficult to find a close connection between architectural function and commercial behavior.

It is really hard to imagine how commercial activities at that time quietly operated in the "container" of such residential courtyards.

The large mansions adopt the local traditional form, with timber structure as the skeleton, red brick and white stone masonry as enclosure, supplemented by various decorative小品.

The oil paint of the major timber uses a black-red tone as the base, with calligraphy works commonly seen as new patterns for interior eave decoration panels.

推荐级别：★★

衙口施氏大宗祠·靖海侯府

No.224
Grand Ancestral Temple Complex for Shi's Clan in Yakou and Mansion of Marquis Jinghai
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：晋江市龙湖镇衙口村（钱江村）
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
传统民居木作砖石作衙口村中心的施琅纪念广场边上并排着一连串充满闽南风情的大厝施氏大宗祠靖海侯府东衙西衙中衙小宗都爷衙而两代施琅纪念馆西祠和侯府无疑是这里的主角东侧的是施氏大宗祠
中文 Chinese

衙口村中心的施琅纪念广场边上并排着一连串充满闽南风情的大厝——施氏大宗祠、靖海侯府、东衙、西衙、中衙、小宗、都爷衙……而两代施琅纪念馆——西祠和侯府，无疑是这里的主角。东侧的是施氏大宗祠。

祠堂始建于明崇祯庚辰年（1640年），其后几经波折，康熙二十六年（1687年），施琅于故址重建之。

宗祠坐北朝南，为五开间三进带护厝，前设石庭，后附花园，系典型闽南院落。中轴线由照墙、前埕、大门、中埕、前厅、后埕、后厅组成，左右有两廊，左边有火巷隔开，还有一列厢房。

大门悬"施氏大宗"匾；中进大厅，额曰"树德堂"，奉祀始祖公和族中显贵者牌位，及施琅等四位祖先画像；后进乃施琅专祠。现在的后花园已无人问津，但仍然保留了许多近代海内外施氏捐款维修宗祠的石碑。院中单体建筑也是典型的泉州当地做法，采用硬山屋顶，抬梁式与穿斗式相结合木构架。

墙体大多采用"出砖入石"和"一斗一卧"砌筑方法。靖海侯府是施琅故居，坐北朝南，与宗祠并列。侯府始建于清朝初年，成于康熙二十八年（1689年）。原为三进双护厝大型建筑，今...

English

Alongside the Shi Lang Memorial Square in the center of Yakou Village, a row of large mansions full of southern Fujian charm stands side by side — the Shi Clan Grand Ancestral Temple, the Mansion of Marquis Jinghai, the East Yamen, West Yamen, Central Yamen, Minor Ancestral Hall, Duye Yamen.

..And the two generations of Shi Lang Memorial Halls — the West Shrine and the Marquis Mansion — are undoubtedly the protagonists here.On the east side is the Shi Clan Grand Ancestral Temple.

The ancestral temple was first built in the Gengchen year of Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1640), and after several twists and turns, in the 26th year of Kangxi reign (1687), Shi Lang rebuilt it on the original site.

The ancestral temple faces south, with five bays and three courtyards with side wings (hucuo), a stone courtyard in front, and a garden attached at the back, a typical southern Fujian courtyard.

The central axis consists of the screen wall, front courtyard, main gate, central courtyard, front hall, rear courtyard, and rear hall, with two corridors on left and right, a fire alley separating on the left, and a row of wing rooms.

The main gate hangs the plaque "Shi Clan Grand Ancestral Temple"; the central hall, with the plaque "Shude Hall" (Hall of Cultivating Virtue), enshrines the spirit tablets of the founding ancestor and distinguished clan members, as well as portraits of four ancestors including Shi Lang; the rear courtyard is the dedicated shrine of Shi Lang.

The back garden today is neglected, but still preserves many stone steles from modern times recording donations by Shi clan members at home and abroad for the repair of the ancestral temple.

The individual buildings in the courtyard are also typical Quanzhou local practice, using gable roofs (yingshan) with a combination of tailiang (beam-lifting) and chuandou (column-and-tie) timber frames.

The walls mostly use the "chu zhuan ru shi" (bricks protruding, stones inset) and "yi dou yi wo" (one bucket one horizontal) masonry methods.

The Mansion of Marquis Jinghai is the former residence of Shi Lang, facing south,并列 with the ancestral temple.

The Marquis Mansion was first built in the early Qing Dynasty and completed in the 28th year of Kangxi reign (1689).

Originally a large three-courtyard double-side-wing building, today...

推荐级别：★★★

六胜塔·石湖码头

No.225
Liusheng Pagoda and Shihu Dock
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：元
地址：石狮市蚶江镇石渔村、石农村交界处
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石结构和石刻手法仿木特征今天去石狮市石湖的人要么是去运输货物的码头要么偶有闲情访古早没了古代作为东方第一大港组成部分的热闹景象古代的石湖码头叫作林銮渡由航海家林銮开创除了石基石墙和明代纪念大臣曾樱的再借亭等少量遗迹码头的原来面貌已经非常难寻了
中文 Chinese

今天去石狮市石湖的人要么是去运输货物的码头，要么偶有闲情访古，早没了古代作为东方第一大港组成部分的热闹景象。古代的石湖码头叫作林銮渡，由航海家林銮开创。除了石基、石墙和明代纪念大臣曾樱的"再借亭"等少量遗迹，码头的原来面貌已经非常难寻了。凭吊之地倒是在六胜塔。

其实，如同泉州湾沿海线众多高高的石塔一样，六胜塔古时就是海上的航标，也可以称为海上丝绸之路的第一座灯塔。

六胜塔，又名万寿塔，俗称石湖塔，北宋政和年间（1111—1117年），高僧祖慧、宋什等募捐建六胜塔于山坳；南宋景炎二年（1277年），该塔被元军毁坏；元顺帝至元二年（1336年）重建，得名万寿塔。

塔为花岗石仿木结构楼阁式塔，八角形平面，五级，高36.06米，底围47米。首层南门门额上悬"万寿塔"匾，并有"至元丙子腊月立"（1336年12月）、"檀樾锦江凌恢甫重建"等字。

每级由塔心、外壁、回廊组成，有券顶门、方龛各4个，门龛各层换位排列，阴刻仿木装修，全塔浮雕金刚、力士像80尊。檐下施补间铺作二朵，附角二朵，双杪五铺作斗拱，转角栌斗雕刻成仰莲形状。

塔檐八角翘脊，石雕仿木椽飞瓦陇，脊上各雕坐佛一尊，顶安塔刹，比例略感偏小。令六胜塔更具历史价值的是塔上逐层刻有建造者的姓名和时间。

English

People going to Shihu in Shishi City today either go to the cargo transport dock, or occasionally visit ancient sites in their leisure time, long gone is the bustling scene of ancient times as part of the No.

1 Port of the East.The ancient Shihu Dock was called Linluan Ferry, founded by the navigator Lin Luan.

Apart from a few remains such as the stone foundation, stone wall, and the "Zaijie Pavilion" commemorating the Ming Dynasty minister Zeng Ying, the original appearance of the dock is already very hard to find.

The place for paying homage is rather at Liusheng Pagoda.

In fact, like the many tall stone pagodas along the coastline of Quanzhou Bay, Liusheng Pagoda was a maritime beacon in ancient times, and can also be called the first lighthouse of the Maritime Silk Road.

Liusheng Pagoda, also known as Wanshou Pagoda (Longevity Pagoda), commonly called Shihu Pagoda, was built by eminent monks Zuhui, Song Shi, and others through fundraising in a mountain hollow during the Zhenghe reign of the Northern Song (1111–1117); in the second year of Jingyan reign of the Southern Song (1277), the pagoda was destroyed by Yuan forces; it was rebuilt in the second year of Zhiyuan reign of Emperor Shun of the Yuan (1336), and named Wanshou Pagoda.

The pagoda is a granite timber-imitating pavilion-style pagoda, with an octagonal plan, five stories, 36.06 meters high, and a base circumference of 47 meters.

On the lintel of the south gate of the first story hangs the plaque "Wanshou Pagoda," with inscriptions such as "Erected in the 12th month of the Bingzi year of Zhiyuan" (December 1336) and "Rebuilt by patron Ling Huifu of Jinjiang.

" Each story consists of a pagoda core, outer wall, and cloister, with 4 arched-top doors and 4 square niches each; the doors and niches are arranged in alternating positions on each story, with incised timber-imitating decoration; the entire pagoda has 80 relief statues of Vajra warriors and strongmen.

Under the eaves are two intermediate bracket sets and two attached-corner bracket sets, with double-tiao five-step dougong; the corner cap blocks are carved in the shape of upward lotuses.

The pagoda eaves have eight upturned ridges, with stone carvings imitating timber rafters and tile rows; on each ridge is carved a seated Buddha, with a pagoda finial on top, the proportions feeling slightly small.

What gives Liusheng Pagoda even greater historical value is that the names and times of the builders are carved layer by layer on the pagoda.

推荐级别：★★★★★

姑嫂塔

No.226
Gusao Pagoda
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：石狮市蚶江镇石渔村、石农村交界处
类型：宗教建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
斗拱拆换下来的老构件八闽志记载在永宁里有石塔甚宏丽商舶自海迁者指为抵岸之期指的就是姑嫂塔塔的大名也叫万寿塔又称关锁塔位于石狮宝盖山顶建于南宋绍兴年间清乾隆四十三年1778年维修姑嫂塔的名字见于明何乔远的闽书昔有姑嫂为商人妇商贩海久不至姑嫂塔而望之若望夫石然塔中刻二女
中文 Chinese

《八闽志》记载："在永宁里有石塔甚宏丽，商舶自海迁者，指为抵岸之期。"指的就是姑嫂塔。塔的大名也叫万寿塔，又称关锁塔，位于石狮宝盖山顶，建于南宋绍兴年间，清乾隆四十三年（1778年）维修。

姑嫂塔的名字见于明何乔远的《闽书》："昔有姑嫂为商人妇，商贩海久不至，姑嫂塔而望之，若望夫石然，塔中刻二女。"塔为花岗岩仿木结构楼阁式石塔，坐东朝西，八角平面，四重檐，通高22.86米。

塔身宽大，底层宽3.8米，逐层缩减，顶层宽2.5米。塔底不露基座，环以廊，前安单檐歇山顶抱厦，面阔三间，进深一间。

塔身转角石柱顶上为大栌斗，檐下半混叠涩以代斗拱，屋面洗练，不做椽飞瓦陇之类；塔心室八角至顶，边有阶梯可逐层攀登；各层上有平座、望柱和栏板。第一层西北面开拱形石门，二层至五层各开两个门洞。第二层门额刻"万寿宝塔"四字，内壁刻佛教偈语两处，门边有碑一方。第三层内壁雕立佛三尊及清代维修记事三则。塔盖翘脊上坐佛像八尊，顶置葫芦塔刹。

站在姑嫂塔的正门前可以俯瞰石狮市。林立的高楼，当有不少是赴海外淘金者归来的投资吧。比起古代华侨，"皆背离其室家，或十余年未返者，返则儿子长育至不相识，盖有新婚之别，娶以数日离者"，今天的世界无形之间小了很多。奔波的冲动似乎没变，往来的心境应当是大不相同的。

English

The "Bamin Zhi" (Records of the Eight Min) records: "In Yongning Village there is a stone pagoda, very magnificent and beautiful; merchant ships coming from the sea use it to mark the time of arrival at shore.

" This refers to Gusao Pagoda (Sisters-in-Law Pagoda).

The pagoda's formal name is also Wanshou Pagoda (Longevity Pagoda), also called Guansuo Pagoda, located on the top of Baogai Mountain in Shishi, built during the Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song, and repaired in the 43rd year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1778).

The name Gusao Pagoda appears in He Qiaoyuan's "Min Shu" (Fujian Book) of the Ming: "In olden times there were two sisters-in-law who were wives of merchants; the merchants traded at sea and did not return for a long time, so the sisters-in-law climbed the pagoda to watch for them, like the Husband-Watching Stone, and two women are carved inside the pagoda.

" The pagoda is a granite timber-imitating pavilion-style stone pagoda, facing west, with an octagonal plan, four sets of eaves, and a total height of 22.86 meters.

The pagoda body is wide, with the bottom story 3.8 meters wide, tapering layer by layer, and the top story 2.5 meters wide.

The base of the pagoda does not expose its pedestal, surrounded by a corridor, with a single-eave hip-and-gable roof portico in front, three bays wide and one bay deep.

On top of the corner stone columns of the pagoda body are large cap blocks; under the eaves, semi-circular corbelling (diese) replaces dougong; the roof surface is refined, without rafters or tile rows; the pagoda's inner chamber is octagonal to the top, with stairs along the side for climbing layer by layer; each story has a flat seating, baluster columns, and railing panels.

The first story has an arched stone door on the northwest side, and the second to fifth stories each have two door openings.

The second story door lintel is carved with the four characters "Wanshou Baota" (Longevity Pagoda), with two Buddhist gathas carved on the inner wall and a stele beside the door.

The third story inner wall has three standing Buddha statues and three records of Qing Dynasty repairs.

On the upturned ridges of the pagoda roof sit eight Buddha statues, with a gourd-shaped pagoda finial on top.Standing in front of the main gate of Gusao Pagoda, one can overlook Shishi City.

Among the forest of high-rise buildings, quite a few must be investments returned by those who went overseas to seek their fortune.

Compared to ancient overseas Chinese, who "all left their families, some not returning for over ten years, and when they returned their sons had grown up and did not recognize them — there were partings of newlyweds, married for only a few days before leaving," today's world has无形 become much smaller.

The impulse to rush about seems unchanged, but the state of mind in coming and going should be quite different.

推荐级别：★★★★

永宁城隍庙

No.227
City God Temple in Yongning
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：石狮市永宁镇永宁街
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构永宁大大有名的时代要追溯到明朝明洪武二十年1387年建卫的时候永宁卫与天津卫威海卫并称全国三大卫所有卫所就会有城隍因此一般认为永宁城隍庙也是始建这个时候史料说明原永宁城隍庙规模仅限于现在的后殿
中文 Chinese

永宁大大有名的时代要追溯到明朝，明洪武二十年（1387年）建卫的时候，永宁卫与天津卫、威海卫并称全国三大卫所。有卫所就会有城隍，因此一般认为，永宁城隍庙也是始建这个时候。

史料说明，原永宁城隍庙规模仅限于现在的后殿。经由道光十五年（1835年）的扩建和清光绪年间再扩建，才具备了今天的规模。

城隍庙坐落于南门与小东门之间，坐北朝南，在中轴线上依次排列着门楼、前殿、戏台、拜亭、主殿。前殿与戏台连缀而建，拜亭和主殿也紧紧相抵。主殿面阔五间，进深三间。

前后殿均为重檐歇山式屋顶，其余为单檐歇山顶。庙中所设置的等级分明的主神、佐神、隶役等，俨然形成一套完整的阴间王朝的官吏系统。

此外，永宁城隍庙与石狮城隍庙、台湾鹿港城隍庙有着特殊渊源，侧面说明了此庙的深远影响力。

English

The era when Yongning was greatly famous traces back to the Ming Dynasty; when the guard was established in the 20th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1387), Yongning Guard, along with Tianjin Guard and Weihai Guard, were called the three major guards of the country.

Where there is a guard, there is a city god; therefore it is generally believed that Yongning City God Temple was also first built at this time.

Historical records indicate that the original scale of Yongning City God Temple was limited to the present rear hall.

Through the expansion in the 15th year of Daoguang reign (1835) and another expansion during the Guangxu reign of the Qing, it acquired its present scale.

The City God Temple is located between the South Gate and the Small East Gate, facing south, with the gate tower, front hall, stage, worship pavilion, and main hall arranged in sequence along the central axis.

The front hall and stage are built connected together, and the worship pavilion and main hall are also closely adjacent.

The main hall is five bays wide and three bays deep.

Both the front and rear halls have double-eave hip-and-gable roofs, while the rest have single-eave hip-and-gable roofs.

The clearly hierarchical main deity, assistant deities, and subordinate officials set up in the temple seemingly form a complete bureaucratic system of the underworld dynasty.

In addition, Yongning City God Temple has special connections with Shishi City God Temple and Lukang City God Temple in Taiwan, indirectly illustrating the far-reaching influence of this temple.

推荐级别：★

蔡氏古民居建筑群

No.228
Ancient Vernacular Buildings of Cai Family
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：南安市官桥镇漳里村漳州寮村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
民居格局木结构砖石构造下了泉州绕城高速从324国道拐入通往漳州寮的小路看到的是现代的工厂当年蔡氏民居的奠基人清末菲律宾华侨蔡资深是不是同意这样的发展模式呢蔡资深1839至1911年16岁随父南渡菲律宾经商成为富侨
中文 Chinese

下了泉州绕城高速，从324国道拐入通往漳州寮的小路，看到的是现代的工厂。当年蔡氏民居的奠基人，清末菲律宾华侨蔡资深是不是同意这样的发展模式呢？蔡资深（1839—1911年）16岁随父南渡菲律宾经商成为富侨，回国后从同治年间（1862年）至宣统三年（1911）间斥资买地，大兴土木，营造蔡氏宅第。

1911年，最后一座规模最小的书房醉经堂竣工。迄今尚存的宅院有同治年间兴建的2座，光绪年间兴建的13座和宗祠1座，宣统年间的醉经堂1座，计大小房间近400间。

总体布局分东西二部，西部为主，东侧为辅并附建有一组书轩、梳妆阁、醉经堂等建筑。东部和西部之间设有院墙和院门。

蔡浅厝始建于光绪癸卯（1903年），为资深晚年自用，后归其六子所用；蔡浅别馆则建于光绪壬寅（1902年），后归其八子所用；德典厝归四弟所居，并为其建书房厝一座；世用厝为其三子所建；最大的孝友第，后归七、九、十子所用；东部建大厝5座，均为其管家经理所建或换地资助堂亲所建，为世切厝、世子厝、德恩厝、德昆厝和岁星厝，其建筑风格相近，而规模和装饰都比蔡氏家族所居稍逊一筹。

建筑群呈五行排列，每列二至四座，每座一至三进院落，左右或单边建有护厝。每两座宅第之间前后相距10米左右，铺砌石埕相连，埕边凿水井1口，辅以井台；各座左右两侧又各有2米宽的石路相隔，可用作防火通道。

单体建筑多为五开间，穿斗式结构，雕梁画栋，硬山或卷棚屋顶，屋脊高翘。门前墙砖石浮雕，窗格雕刻花鸟，门墙厅壁点缀书画。装饰做法中木雕、石雕、砖雕丰富，花岗岩下碱的空斗砌筑墙面也颇具装饰性，较全面地反映了泉州地区传统做法。

按照当地的说法，此类建筑形式叫作"皇宫起"。

English

Getting off the Quanzhou Ring Expressway and turning from National Highway 324 onto the small road leading to Zhangzhouliao, what one sees are modern factories.

Would Cai Zishen, the founder of the Cai family dwellings and an overseas Chinese in the Philippines in the late Qing, have agreed with such a development model?

Cai Zishen (1839–1911) went south to the Philippines with his father at the age of 16 to do business and became a wealthy overseas Chinese; after returning to China, from the Tongzhi reign (1862) to the third year of Xuantong reign (1911), he spent heavily to buy land and undertake large-scale construction, building the Cai family residences.

In 1911, the smallest-scale study, Zuijing Hall, was completed.

The surviving residences today include 2 built during the Tongzhi reign, 13 built during the Guangxu reign and 1 ancestral hall, and 1 Zuijing Hall from the Xuantong reign, totaling nearly 400 large and small rooms.

The overall layout is divided into eastern and western parts, with the western part as the main and the eastern part as auxiliary, with an attached group of buildings including a study, dressing pavilion, and Zuijing Hall.

Between the eastern and western parts there are courtyard walls and gates.

Cai Qian Cuo was first built in the Guimao year of Guangxu (1903), for Zishen's own use in his later years, later used by his sixth son; Cai Qian Bie Guan was built in the Renyin year of Guangxu (1902), later used by his eighth son; De Dian Cuo was lived in by his fourth brother, for whom a study residence was also built; Shi Yong Cuo was built by his third son; the largest, Xiao You Di, later went to his seventh, ninth, and tenth sons; in the eastern part, 5 large residences were built, all constructed by his housekeepers and managers or with land-exchange subsidies for clan relatives — Shi Qie Cuo, Shi Zi Cuo, De En Cuo, De Kun Cuo, and Sui Xing Cuo — with similar architectural styles but slightly inferior in scale and decoration to those lived in by the Cai family.

The building complex is arranged in five rows, with two to four buildings per row, each with one to three courtyards, with side wings (hucuo) on both or one side.

Between every two residences, the front-to-back distance is about 10 meters, connected by paved stone courtyards, with a well dug at the edge of each courtyard, supplemented by a well platform; on the left and right sides of each residence there are also 2-meter-wide stone paths separating them, which can serve as fire passages.

The individual buildings are mostly five-bay, with chuandou (column-and-tie) structure, carved beams and painted rafters, with gable (yingshan) or rolling (juanpeng) roofs, with high upturned roof ridges.

In front of the doors, brick and stone reliefs on the walls, window lattices carved with flowers and birds, and calligraphy and paintings adorn the door walls and hall walls.

Among the decorative practices, wood carvings, stone carvings, and brick carvings are rich, and the empty-bucket masonry walls with granite plinths are also quite decorative, comprehensively reflecting the traditional practices of the Quanzhou region.

According to local saying, this type of architectural form is called "huanggong qi" (palace-style start).

推荐级别：★★

林氏民居叠楼

No.229
Lapped Vernacular Buildings of Lin Family
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：南安市省新镇满山红村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
民居格局木结构砖石构造面对着池塘有大石埕连接在一起的是宗祠正屋叠楼书房一串四组院落这是南安的林氏民居虽然没有官桥镇的蔡氏民居那么大那么出名但是有自己的突出特点叠楼建筑坐北朝南四组建筑通长达110多米已是相当壮观叠楼高耸更平添一笔不凡
中文 Chinese

面对着池塘，有大石埕连接在一起的，是宗祠、正屋、叠楼、书房一串四组院落。这是南安的林氏民居，虽然没有官桥镇的蔡氏民居那么大，那么出名，但是有自己的突出特点——叠楼。建筑坐北朝南四组建筑通长达110多米已是相当壮观，叠楼高耸，更平添一笔不凡。

最西侧的宗祠一进院子，一正两厢，西有跨院，当地称作"单进二落带单边护厝"。单体建筑用硬山顶建筑，燕尾脊，抬梁式木构架。

门后天井两侧有卷棚式回廊和宗祠前廊雕刻装饰尤其细腻。隔着防火夹道，西起第二院称为正屋。正屋二进三落五开间带双护厝，左右铺陈很开，方便居住。特别的是，护厝前端，如同角上的望楼一般，做成了二层砖楼。

再东就是真正的叠楼，二进三落（原有后落已经倒塌无存），五开间带双护厝，天井左右两厢和第二落都是二层叠楼建筑，东西护厝前端也各盖角楼，屋面以硬山顶、歇山顶相互错落，方形、八角形屋面彼此交接，整体院落体型丰富，颇具设计感。

叠楼室内装饰色彩一变，以红绿相间为基调，日久色沉，亦不觉唐突。厅堂装饰的水泥彩花地砖，系从东南亚国家进口，图案带有明显的异域风格。

最东的书房则带有一些园林式意味，前有花圃，后廊筑一方亭与天井相互衔接，天井中建有假山、鱼池，两侧均为三开间建筑，东侧中间为小厅堂，西侧立面砖砌拱券三个。

建筑小巧，穿斗式木构架，硬山顶、悬山顶配合，看上去很是轻巧。如此多的与众不同，是因为民居的主人是清光绪晚期华侨建筑家林路（1851—1929年）。他幼时家贫，依父嘱从事营造，有"小鲁班"之名。

后来南渡新加坡谋生，最初从事建筑业兼制砖瓦，后成为著名建筑家，继而投资经营树胶生产。代表作有新加坡维多利亚纪念堂。事业有成后林路回归故里，曾捐献巨资，被朝廷封为"福建花翎道"，赏戴花翎。于是才有了他自己设计的叠楼建筑群。此组群之东约200米处有林路旧居，应给以必要的保护。

English

Facing the pond, connected by a large stone courtyard, are a string of four groups of courtyards: the ancestral hall, the main house, the lapped building (dielou), and the study.

This is the Lin family dwelling in Nan'an; although not as large or as famous as the Cai family dwelling in Guanqiao Town, it has its own outstanding feature — the lapped building.

The buildings face south, with the four groups of buildings having a total length of over 110 meters, already quite spectacular; the tall lapped buildings add an extraordinary touch.

The westernmost ancestral hall has one courtyard, with one main hall and two wing rooms, with a side courtyard to the west, locally called "single-entry two-lop with single-side wing.

" The individual buildings use gable roofs (yingshan), swallow-tail ridges (yanweiji), and tailiang (beam-lifting) timber frames.

On both sides of the courtyard behind the door are rolling-eave corridors, and the carvings and decorations on the front corridor of the ancestral hall are especially exquisite.

Across the fire alley, the second courtyard from the west is called the main house.

The main house has two entries and three lops, five bays with double side wings, spread out widely on left and right, convenient for living.

What is special is that the front ends of the side wings, like watchtowers at the corners, are made into two-story brick buildings.

Further east is the真正的 lapped building, with two entries and three lops (the original rear lop has collapsed and no longer exists), five bays with double side wings; the two wing rooms on both sides of the courtyard and the second lop are all two-story lapped buildings; the front ends of the east and west side wings also each have corner towers, with roofs alternating between gable and hip-and-gable styles, and square and octagonal roofs intersecting with each other, giving the overall courtyard a rich form and quite a sense of design.

The interior decoration of the lapped building changes in color, with a red-green alternating base tone; over time the colors darken, without feeling jarring.

The cement colored flower floor tiles decorating the halls were imported from Southeast Asian countries, with patterns with obvious exotic styles.

The easternmost study has something of a garden style, with a flower bed in front, and a square pavilion built on the rear corridor connecting with the courtyard; in the courtyard are built rockeries and fish ponds, with three-bay buildings on both sides, with a small hall in the middle of the east side and three brick archways on the west side facade.

The building is small and exquisite, with chuandou (column-and-tie) timber frame, combining gable and overhanging gable roofs, looking very light and nimble.

So much uniqueness is because the owner of the dwelling was Lin Lu (1851–1929), an overseas Chinese architect in the late Guangxu reign of the Qing.

He was poor in childhood, and following his father's wishes engaged in construction, earning the name "Little Lu Ban.

" Later he went south to Singapore to make a living, initially engaging in construction and also making bricks and tiles, later becoming a famous architect, and then investing in rubber production.

His representative work includes the Victoria Memorial Hall in Singapore.

After achieving success in his career, Lin Lu returned to his hometown, once donated a huge sum, and was enfeoffed by the court as "Fujian Hualing Dao," awarded the wearing of a peacock feather.

Thus came into being the lapped building complex designed by himself.About 200 meters east of this complex is the former residence of Lin Lu, which should be given necessary protection.

推荐级别：★★★★★

南安中宪第

No.230
Residence of Grand Master Exemplar in Nan'an
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：南安市石井镇延平街道
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
民居格局木结构砖石构造南安石井还有一处值得拜访的民居被称为中宪第名字的由来是其创建人郑运锦的儿子郑汝成石井镇的位置暗示着郑家和台湾地区的关系
中文 Chinese

南安石井还有一处值得拜访的民居，被称为"中宪第"。名字的由来是其创建人郑运锦的儿子郑汝成。石井镇的位置暗示着郑家和台湾地区的关系，它东隔马江毗邻晋江东石，西连龟山与厦门翔安接壤，北与水头交界，南与金门仅距6海里。

在那个父子亲戚事业相传的年代，郑芝龙、郑成功、郑经三代起于南安，同为郑姓的郑运锦则也经商于闽台之间，后成为台湾一大富商，归乡后清代雍正六年（1728年）始建此宅。

清乾隆年间（1736—1795年），郑运锦的长子郑汝成由贡监生授州司马加五级并诰封中宪大夫，期间又进行扩建宅第，故得名"中宪第"。中宪第坐南朝北，与常见的朝向相反，分为东西两路，东为主院，西有水榭、书房、演武厅、梳妆楼遗址和园林设施。东路主体建筑四进，中轴线自北向南依次为门厅、大厅、中厅、后厅。

大门面阔五间，中三间内凹以容客，悬有"中宪第"匾；门厅后为天井，南墙中复开门；进石框大门为第二进，厅堂面阔五间，穿斗减柱式构架，硬山顶，燕尾形屋脊，带前后天井，前天井两侧有廊庑；进二道石框大门为第三进，厅堂面阔五间，穿斗式构架，硬山顶，燕尾形屋脊，明间分前后厅，次间、尽间分前后房，中间以廊作为连接；第四进为后落，罩房面阔十三间，穿斗式构架，硬山顶，与东西护厝相接，形成围合。

各进主厝山墙设边门，经过雨亭与东西护厝相连。西路穿过水榭，有书轩、演武厅、花园、梳妆楼、曲桥、月亮潭、亭阁等建筑，乃文乃武，是登临赏月玩水等休憩场所。水榭屋顶与西重护厝相衔接，双边作两小坡，西临水，翼以扶栏，西面作砖砌拱券三个，并连通月亮潭的石曲桥，设计颇有逸趣。

通观中宪第，木雕、石雕、砖饰三者兼具匠心。雕刻综合采用线刻、浮雕、透雕技法，内容兼顾历史典故、飞禽走兽、文房四宝；拼合砖装饰也代表了当地的高超技艺。

English

There is another residence worth visiting in Shijing, Nan'an, called "Zhongxian Di" (Residence of the Grand Master Exemplar).The name comes from Zheng Rucheng, the son of its founder Zheng Yunjin.

The location of Shijing Town hints at the relationship between the Zheng family and the Taiwan region: it borders Jinjiang Dongshi across the Ma River to the east, connects with Guishan and borders Xiamen Xiang'an to the west, borders Shuitou to the north, and is only 6 nautical miles from Kinmen to the south.

In that era when fathers, sons, and relatives passed down their careers, Zheng Zhilong, Zheng Chenggong, and Zheng Jing three generations arose from Nan'an; Zheng Yunjin, also of the Zheng surname, also traded between Fujian and Taiwan, later becoming a major wealthy merchant in Taiwan.

After returning to his hometown, he first built this residence in the sixth year of Yongzheng reign of the Qing (1728).

During the Qianlong reign of the Qing (1736–1795), Zheng Yunjin's eldest son Zheng Rucheng, from a gongjian (tribute student) background, was appointed as Zhou Sima with five additional ranks and posthumously honored as Zhongxian Dafu (Grand Master Exemplar); during this period the residence was further expanded, hence the name "Zhongxian Di.

" Zhongxian Di faces south, opposite to the common orientation, divided into east and west routes; the east is the main courtyard, and the west has a waterside pavilion, study, martial arts hall, dressing tower ruins, and garden facilities.

The main building of the east route has four entries, with the central axis from north to south being依次 the entrance hall, main hall, central hall, and rear hall.

The main gate is five bays wide, with the middle three bays recessed to accommodate guests, hanging the plaque "Zhongxian Di"; behind the entrance hall is a courtyard, with another door in the middle of the south wall; entering the stone-framed main gate is the second entry, with a hall five bays wide, chuandou column-reduced frame, gable roof, swallow-tail ridge, with front and rear courtyards, and corridors on both sides of the front courtyard; entering the second stone-framed gate is the third entry, with a hall five bays wide, chuandou frame, gable roof, swallow-tail ridge, with the central bay divided into front and rear halls, and the secondary and end bays divided into front and rear rooms, connected by corridors in the middle; the fourth entry is the rear lop, with a covering house thirteen bays wide, chuandou frame, gable roof, connecting with the east and west side wings to form an enclosure.

Each entry's main residence has side doors on the gable walls, connecting with the east and west side wings through rain pavilions.

The west route, passing through the waterside pavilion, has buildings such as a study, martial arts hall, garden, dressing tower, zigzag bridge, moon pond, and pavilions — both literary and martial, serving as rest places for climbing, enjoying the moon, and playing with water.

The waterside pavilion roof connects with the west double side wing, with two small slopes on both sides, facing water on the west, with railings, and three brick archways on the west side, connecting with the stone zigzag bridge of the moon pond, with quite a leisurely design.

Looking at Zhongxian Di as a whole, wood carvings, stone carvings, and brick decorations all show ingenuity.

The carvings comprehensively use line carving, relief, and openwork techniques, with content covering historical allusions, birds and beasts, and the four treasures of the study; the assembled brick decorations also represent the superb local craftsmanship.

推荐级别：★★★

桃源宫·陀罗尼经幢

No.231
Dharani Sutra Pillar in Taoyuan Temple
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：南安丰州镇桃源村
类型：宗教建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石结构和石刻手法纹样和历史信息研究者总结泉州是全省经幢数量最多的地区目前发现的石经幢共有20座其中鲤城区10座晋江5座惠安3座南安1座石狮1座除了开元寺大雄宝殿旁的一座石经幢建于唐大中八年854年其余均建于两宋年间南安桃源宫的陀罗尼经幢为北宋天圣3年1025年作品历史信息之丰富是同类遗存中的代表
中文 Chinese

研究者总结，泉州是全省经幢数量最多的地区。目前发现的石经幢共有20座，其中鲤城区10座，晋江5座，惠安3座，南安1座，石狮1座。

除了开元寺大雄宝殿旁的一座石经幢建于唐大中八年（854年），其余均建于两宋年间。

南安桃源宫的陀罗尼经幢为北宋天圣3年（1025年）作品，历史信息之丰富，是同类遗存中的代表。桃源宫又称"唐王宫"，坐落于风景名胜区九日山下的南安丰州镇。宫庙始建于唐，供奉李世民。

而真正让桃源宫闻名于世的，还是宋代的陀罗尼经幢。桃源宫陀罗尼经幢为南安葛门陈二十二娘为追荐其夫而建，使用花岗岩石构筑，八角形平面，通高7米，分为幢座、幢身、幢顶三部分。幢座为四层须弥座，逐渐向上收分。

第一层八边形须弥座用双层下枋，下枭雕刻覆莲瓣，八边形束腰转角雕力士，中间为飞天浮雕，上枭为仰莲瓣；第二层须弥座下枋为八边形，雕整齐连续的海浪纹样，下枭圆弧形雕水波纹，束腰圆形浮雕双龙戏珠，上枭圆形分成八瓣雕牡丹花图案；第三层须弥座的束腰直接位于二层须弥座顶部，为八面体，每面有方形石龛，内雕风格各异的护法神像，上枋八边形，...

English

Researchers summarize that Quanzhou is the region with the largest number of sutra pillars (jingchuang) in the province.

Currently, 20 stone sutra pillars have been discovered, including 10 in Licheng District, 5 in Jinjiang, 3 in Hui'an, 1 in Nan'an, and 1 in Shishi.

Except for one stone sutra pillar beside the Mahavira Hall of Kaiyuan Temple, built in the eighth year of Dazhong reign of the Tang (854), the rest were all built during the Northern and Southern Song dynasties.

The Dharani Sutra Pillar at Taoyuan Temple in Nan'an is a work from the third year of Tiansheng reign of the Northern Song (1025), with rich historical information, and is a representative among similar remains.

Taoyuan Temple, also called "Tang King Palace," is located in Fengzhou Town, Nan'an, at the foot of the famous scenic area Jiuri Mountain.

The temple was first built in the Tang Dynasty, enshrining Li Shimin (Emperor Taizong of Tang).

But what truly made Taoyuan Temple famous worldwide is the Song Dynasty Dharani Sutra Pillar.

The Dharani Sutra Pillar at Taoyuan Temple was built by Chen Ershiniang of Ge Gate in Nan'an to perform posthumous rites for her husband, constructed using granite, with an octagonal plan, a total height of 7 meters, divided into three parts: pillar base, pillar body, and pillar top.

The pillar base is a four-tier Sumeru pedestal (xumizuo), gradually tapering upward.

The first-tier octagonal Sumeru pedestal uses a double lower lintel, with the lower hawk-beak molding carved with inverted lotus petals; the octagonal waist has carved guardian figures at the corners, with apsara (feitian) reliefs in the middle, and the upper hawk-beak molding has upward lotus petals; the second-tier Sumeru pedestal's lower lintel is octagonal, carved with neatly continuous wave patterns; the lower hawk-beak molding is arc-shaped, carved with water wave patterns; the round waist has relief carvings of two dragons playing with a pearl; the upper hawk-beak molding is round, divided into eight petals carved with peony flower patterns; the third-tier Sumeru pedestal's waist is directly located at the top of the second-tier Sumeru pedestal, as an octahedron, with square stone niches on each face, inside carved with guardian deity statues of various styles, and the upper lintel is octagonal, .

..

推荐级别：★★★★

五塔岩石塔

No.232
Five Stone Pagodas before Wutaya Temple
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：南安市官桥镇竹口村五塔岩寺前
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
石结构和石刻手法仿木特征泉水潺潺巨岩参差藤木枯荣五塔岩景区景色多姿人文鼎盛南安县志记载灵水岩峰峦耸秀中多石洞五塔岩寺建于宋代因山就势寺后利用天然石洞建定光佛的道场为元代重建五塔岩寺前不远即是五塔
中文 Chinese

泉水潺潺，巨岩参差，藤木枯荣。五塔岩景区，景色多姿，人文鼎盛。《南安县志》记载："灵水岩峰峦耸秀，中多石洞。"五塔岩寺建于宋代，因山就势，寺后利用天然石洞建定光佛的道场，为元代重建。五塔岩寺前不远即是五塔。五塔窄堵坡式，一字排开，面对五塔岩寺，背向远山，下临深壑，荡胸生层云。

五座塔均为宋代所建，间距2米，中间一座略高，为5.5米，两边的塔高均高5.3米。五塔造型基本相同，由底座、基座、塔身、塔刹组成，唯塔身龛中佛像坐姿、手印不一。塔座底四边形，以条石铺砌。塔之基座则为二层须弥座。

第一层座六角形须弥座，依次有圭角、下枋、下枭、束腰、上枭等五层构件。底层圭形饰卷云，下枋刻卷草缠枝花，束腰上有狮子戏球、宝相花等浮雕及文字题铭。第二层须弥座上置圆形仰莲盘，其上为六瓣瓜棱状，鼓形。上枋亦为仰莲盘。塔身有下覆莲，塔身呈六瓣长瓜棱状，鼓形，正面沉雕有一尖拱形佛龛，龛内浮雕佛像。塔身上为塔盖，作六角飞檐状，檐角均有悬挂风铃的支挂残迹。

塔盖上为塔刹，塔刹有圆形底盘，相轮为四，上接小盖，盖上置葫芦塔尖。

塔、寺周围有石刻多方，重要者包括宋咸淳庚午年（1270年）捐资石刻，元至大戊申年（1308年）重建的记事石刻，以及元泰定甲子年（1324年）化城梁少师七世孙梁瞿卿喜舍山地入寺的石刻等。

English

Spring water murmurs, giant rocks are uneven, vines and trees wither and flourish.The Wutaya Rock scenic area has diverse scenery and flourishing humanities.

The "Nan'an County Gazetteer" records: "Lingshui Rock has towering and graceful peaks, with many stone caves inside.

" Wutaya Temple was built in the Song Dynasty, adapting to the mountain terrain; behind the temple, a natural stone cave was used to build the道场 of Dingguang Buddha, rebuilt in the Yuan Dynasty.

Not far in front of Wutaya Temple are the Five Pagodas.

The five pagodas are in the stupa (zhadupo) style, arranged in a row, facing Wutaya Temple, with their backs to distant mountains, overlooking deep ravines below, with clouds rising to the chest.
