In the past, the city's waters were blue and gentle, with boats passing like shuttles; ships fully loaded with goods entered through the east and west sluice gates and could go directly to Yutou Temple (today's Nanchang Road) in the city center.

In today's crowded urban area, one can still find the preserved Dongqiaoting and Xiqiaoting (East and West Bridge Pavilions), as well as the lush banyan trees in front of the pavilions.

In comparison, Dongqiaoting is more rustic, while Xiqiaoting has followed the tastes of the nouveau riche, reminding one of a cooked crab.

Dongqiaoting was first built in the 11th year of Yuanhe reign of the Tang (816); on the day the bridge was completed, it coincided with Zhangzhou native Zhou Kuangwu passing the jinshi examination, so it is also called "Jidi Bridge" (Passing the Examination Bridge).

In the Song Dynasty, pavilions were built on the bridge, repaired through successive dynasties; the existing three-courtyard bridge pavilions are exquisitely carved, full of ancient charm.

Especially the roof frames and dougong, with delicate workmanship and appropriate shapes, are uncommon masterpieces.

推荐级别：★★★

府文庙大成殿

No.259
Hall of Great Achievement in Temple of Confucius in Zhangzhou Prefecture
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋—清
地址：漳州市芗城区修文西路
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构彩画遗存漳州文庙位于漳州老城区的修文西路上是漳州城内最大的古建筑群也是漳州市文物管理委员会的办公室所在地幸运的拜访者还有可能得到专业老师的指教文庙始建于宋庆历四年1044年按宋制孔庙与官学并建一处
中文 Chinese

漳州文庙位于漳州老城区的修文西路上，是漳州城内最大的古建筑群，也是漳州市文物管理委员会的办公室所在地。幸运的拜访者还有可能得到专业老师的指教。文庙始建于宋庆历四年（1044年），按宋制，孔庙与官学并建一处。

政和二年（1112年）移于州左，绍兴九年（1139年）复原址，历代经多次重修。据记载，朱熹、郑成功、黄道周都曾到此祭祀孔子。其中，朱熹在任漳州知事时，曾"每旬之二日必领官属下州学，视诸生，讲小学，为正其义"。

文庙前的道路左右分别建有"德配天地"、"道冠古今"两座牌坊，原为木构牌坊，现存的石牌坊是民国时期蒋鼎文出资重修的。文庙整体坐北向南，占地15000平方米，现存建筑面积2600平方米。

中轴线上依次设有作为现大门的仪门、戟门、两庑、丹墀、祭台和大成殿。殿西侧建有敬一亭。原有建筑明伦堂、棂星门等已毁。戟门面阔九间，进深两间。木构梁枋，石制圆柱。穿斗式的屋架看起来简洁古朴。

东西两庑均面阔八间，进深两间，其中一间形成室外连廊。大成殿面阔五间，进深六间，为重檐歇山顶，上层檐只留当心三间。殿前有祭台、丹墀，其内供有孔子像一尊。

大成殿前檐出廊的六根廊柱为浮雕蟠龙石柱，而檐柱和金柱则为圆形石柱。正檐檐柱间置隔扇门，而后檐墙则在明间设门，东西次、梢间各开方窗。室内的木构造继承了早期"插柱造"的做法。同时，大成殿的斗拱也都保留了早期斗拱上昂造等很多的特征。

大成殿大量额枋、木雕构件、脊桁、天花上均有彩绘遗留，局部保留有十分鲜艳的色彩。1999年由中国文物研究所指导进行维修，我的老师郭黛姮先生也参加了指导。当时采用了"抽梁换柱"、"填心"、"包心"等方法对木结构进行了维修，并对彩画进行了加固。

环视殿内，可以想象过去的文庙遍布彩画和原汁原味的金碧辉煌的场景。

English

Zhangzhou Confucian Temple is located on Xiuwen West Road in the old urban area of Zhangzhou; it is the largest ancient building complex in Zhangzhou City and also the office location of the Zhangzhou Cultural Relics Management Committee.

Lucky visitors may also receive guidance from professional teachers.

The Confucian Temple was first built in the fourth year of Qingli reign of the Song (1044); according to Song system, the Confucian Temple and official school were built together.

In the second year of Zhenghe reign (1112), it was moved to the left of the prefecture; in the ninth year of Shaoxing reign (1139), it was restored to its original site, and has undergone multiple repairs through successive dynasties.

According to records, Zhu Xi, Zheng Chenggong, and Huang Daozhou all came here to sacrifice to Confucius.

Among them, when Zhu Xi served as the magistrate of Zhangzhou, he "on the second day of every ten-day period must lead officials to the prefectural school, observe the students, lecture on elementary learning, and rectify their righteousness.

" On the left and right of the road in front of the Confucian Temple, two memorial archways "De Pei Tian Di" (Virtue Matching Heaven and Earth) and "Dao Guan Gu Jin" (Way Capping Past and Present) were respectively built, originally wooden archways; the existing stone archways were rebuilt with funds from Jiang Dingwen during the Republican period.

The Confucian Temple as a whole faces south from the north, covering 15,000 square meters, with an existing building area of 2,600 square meters.

Along the central axis are依次 the Yi Gate (serving as the current main gate), Halberd Gate, two side wings, Dan Chi (red courtyard), sacrificial platform, and Dacheng Hall.

On the west side of the hall, a Jingyi Pavilion is built.Original buildings such as the Minglun Hall and Lingxing Gate have been destroyed.

The Halberd Gate is nine bays wide and two bays deep, with timber beams and stone cylindrical columns; the chuandou (column-and-tie) roof frame looks simple and ancient.

Both the east and west side wings are eight bays wide and two bays deep, with one bay forming an outdoor corridor.

The Dacheng Hall is five bays wide and six bays deep, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, with the upper eave retaining only the central three bays.

In front of the hall are a sacrificial platform and Dan Chi, inside which a statue of Confucius is enshrined.

The six corridor columns of the front eave of the Dacheng Hall are relief-carved dragon-coiled stone columns, while the eave columns and golden columns are circular stone columns.

Between the front eave columns are lattice doors, while the rear eave wall has a door in the central bay, with square windows in the east and west secondary and end bays.

The interior timber structure inherits the early "inserted column" (chazhu zao) method.

At the same time, the dougong of the Dacheng Hall also retain many features of early dougong such as the upward-ang construction.

A large number of额枋, timber-carved components, ridge purlins, and ceilings in the Dacheng Hall all have remaining colored paintings, with some parts retaining very vivid colors.

In 1999, repairs were carried out under the guidance of the Chinese Institute of Cultural Relics, and my teacher Ms.Guo Daiheng also participated in the guidance.

At that time, methods such as "extracting beams and replacing columns," "filling the core," and "wrapping the core" were used to repair the timber structure, and the colored paintings were reinforced.

Looking around the hall, one can imagine the past Confucian Temple covered with colored paintings and the original resplendent scene.

推荐级别：★★★★

林氏宗祠

No.260
Ancestral Temple Complex for Lin's Clan
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：宋—清
地址：漳州市芗城区修文西路
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
木结构斗拱做法漳州林氏宗祠又称比干庙是漳州七县林姓氏族合建的供奉林氏始祖比干作为漳邑林氏祭祖之所和历年本宗族赴考往来生员的接待站原来的宗祠规模不小而今前后进已废仅存正殿了只是这远远一瞥已经让我们感到此殿非同寻常绝对不虚此行
中文 Chinese

漳州林氏宗祠，又称比干庙，是漳州七县林姓氏族合建的，供奉林氏始祖比干，作为漳邑林氏祭祖之所和历年本宗族赴考往来生员的接待站。原来的宗祠规模不小，而今前后进已废，仅存正殿了。只是这远远一瞥，已经让我们感到此殿非同寻常，绝对不虚此行。

大殿面南，红瓦，重檐歇山顶，殿身三间，下层原构似为副阶周匝，但经过复杂的历史改造，可见旧有结构痕迹，前后下层单独做卷棚顶，用垂脊戗脊，是檐下另加抱厦的样子。

铺作部分，明间用补间四朵，次间用二朵，偷心造，施华拱一跳、下昂二根，昂形耍头，伸出构件雕刻、装饰花板皆精良独特。可惜宗祠确切建筑年代已无考，也没有机缘入得殿内，只从间接资料得知室内有上昂的做法。

关于形制年代，有的只是一些专家给出的模糊说法"始建于宋代，因清末曾修葺，故亦带有清式建筑的痕迹"。

English

The Zhangzhou Lin Clan Ancestral Temple, also known as Bigan Temple, was jointly built by the Lin clan from seven counties of Zhangzhou, enshrining the Lin clan ancestor Bigan, serving as a place for the Lin clan of Zhangzhou to worship ancestors and as a reception station for clan members going to and from examinations over the years.

The original ancestral temple was not small in scale, but today the front and rear courtyards have been destroyed, with only the main hall remaining.

Just this distant glance has already made us feel that this hall is extraordinary, absolutely worth the trip.

The main hall faces south, with red tiles and a double-eave hip-and-gable roof, with the hall body three bays wide; the original structure of the lower layer seems to have been a surrounding secondary eave (fujie zhouza), but through complex historical modifications, traces of the old structure can be seen; the front and rear lower layers separately have curved-roof ceilings (juanpeng ding), with vertical ridges and diagonal ridges, looking like an additional抱厦 (baosha) under the eaves.

In the bracket set part, the central bay uses four intermediate bracket sets, the secondary bays use two, in the "stealing-heart" (touxin zao) construction, with one hua-gong jump and two lower ang, with ang-shaped shuatou (cantilever head); the protruding component carvings and decorative patterned boards are all exquisite and unique.

Unfortunately, the exact construction date of the ancestral temple is no longer verifiable, and there was no opportunity to enter the hall; only from indirect materials do we know that the interior has the upward-ang construction method.

Regarding the date of the form, there are only vague statements given by some experts: "First built in the Song Dynasty, because it was repaired in the late Qing, it also bears traces of Qing-style architecture.

"

推荐级别：★★★★

可园

No.261
Keyuan Residence
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州芗城区新桥街道文川
类型：园林·私家园林
特征标签 Highlights
凭吊可园不可以再这样下去了这座位于漳州老街区文川里的闽南名园是清代闽中十大才子之一郑开禧的私家花园美名可园取自苏东坡的话凡物皆有可观苟有可观皆有可乐文学作品当中老人口碑当中园中原先亭榭台楼阁池塘小桥假山园圃尽有令人目不暇接还演绎了一批厦大学子的爱国故事而今经过动荡岁月对财富和权力的洗牌经过冲动岁月对文化和遗产的洗牌可园终于在物质和精神两个世界内被均贫富了
中文 Chinese

可园不可以再这样下去了。这座位于漳州老街区文川里的闽南名园，是清代闽中十大才子之一郑开禧的私家花园。美名"可园"取自苏东坡的话："凡物皆有可观，苟有可观，皆有可乐。"文学作品当中，老人口碑当中，园中原先亭、榭、台、楼、阁、池塘、小桥、假山、园圃尽有，令人目不暇接，还演绎了一批厦大学子的爱国故事。

而今，经过动荡岁月对财富和权力的洗牌，经过冲动岁月对文化和遗产的洗牌，可园终于在物质和精神两个世界内被均贫富了。宅第部分，主厝大厅保存得相对较为完好，建造主厝墙脚的石条雕花也很精巧，显示出中西合璧的风格。主厝之后才是园林部分。庭院内植物生长得郁郁葱葱。最多可以说，虽现状较为破败，仍不掩其曲径幽幽、典雅宁静之美。

倔强的月亮门似乎努力在对抗着新时代的粗糙，掇石的婀娜也全然没有在瓦砾中放弃浪漫的希望，一汪碧水无言地反射着周围的一切，毫不在意众生的审美。当然，园内留下了"吟香阁"、"思哺堂"等建筑，我们唯有为它们祈祷。可园已经不可以再这样下去了。

English

Keyuan can no longer go on like this.

This famous Minnan garden located in Wenchuan Lane of the old Zhangzhou district was the private garden of Zheng Kaixi, one of the ten great talents of central Fujian in the Qing Dynasty.

The beautiful name "Keyuan" (Garden of Worth) is taken from Su Dongpo's words: "All things have something worth observing; if there is something worth observing, there is something worth enjoying.

" In literary works and in the oral traditions of the elderly, the garden originally had pavilions, open halls, terraces, towers, attics, ponds, small bridges, rockeries, and vegetable gardens all present, dazzling the eye, and also staged patriotic stories of a group of Xiamen University students.

Today, after the turbulent years reshuffled wealth and power, and after the impulsive years reshuffled culture and heritage, Keyuan has finally been "equalized in wealth" in both the material and spiritual worlds.

In the residential part, the main mansion hall is relatively well preserved, and the carved stone strips at the base of the main mansion walls are also very exquisite, showing a style combining Chinese and Western elements.

Behind the main mansion is the garden part.Plants in the courtyard grow lushly.

At most one can say that although the current condition is rather dilapidated, it still does not conceal its beauty of winding paths and elegant tranquility.

The stubborn moon gate seems to be striving against the crudeness of the new era, and the graceful rockeries have absolutely not given up romantic hope amid the rubble; a pool of blue water silently reflects everything around, indifferent to the aesthetics of all living beings.

Of course, the garden has retained buildings such as the "Yinxiang Pavilion" (Chanting Fragrance Pavilion) and "Sibu Hall" (Thinking of Nourishment Hall), and we can only pray for them.

Keyuan can no longer go on like this.

推荐级别：★★★

路边威惠庙

No.262
Weihui Temple in Lubian
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州市芗城区天宝镇路边村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构凭吊唐史无人修列传漳江有庙祀将军说的就是陈元光他的祖籍是河南光州固始县少年随父归德将军陈政奉诏南征入闽安定边陲后袭父职拓地开屯
中文 Chinese

"唐史无人修列传，漳江有庙祀将军"说的就是陈元光。他的祖籍是河南光州固始县，少年随父"归德将军"陈政奉诏南征入闽，安定边陲。后袭父职，拓地开屯。武则天垂拱二年（686年），首任漳州刺史，后创办府学，兴农惠工，终使漳州成为闽南重镇。

所以陈元光成了开漳将士后裔所尊奉的"开漳圣王"，所建庙宇就被称为威惠庙，同祀观音和韩氏先祖等。威惠庙的祖庙就是芗城路边村巨大古树下的这一座。

庙中樟木雕观音坐像是元延祐六年（1319年）的，出水石莲花上有元泰定三年（1326年）的题记，因此，路边威惠庙的始建年代可以上溯到元延祐六年。

经过历代改造修缮，现存的建筑为清代重修的作品。这里的威惠庙的规模不像它的名声那样大，只有一进院落，前后两座殿宇。两殿也很小巧，面阔三间，屋脊也划分三段，起翘高挑，龙塑飞腾，垂脊端更塑天宫楼阁。室内木结构则是出乎意料的古朴，不仅雕刻装饰细致精美，多处还保留有历代油饰彩画、壁画的痕迹，可供研究者开展各种分析检测工作。

English

"The Tang history has no one to write biographies, but the Zhang River has temples to sacrifice to the general" — this refers to Chen Yuanguang.

His ancestral home was Gushi County, Guangzhou, Henan; as a youth he followed his father Chen Zheng, "General of Returning Virtue," who was ordered to march south into Fujian and stabilize the frontier.

Later he inherited his father's position, expanding territory and opening military colonies.

In the second year of Chuigong reign of Wu Zetian (686), he became the first prefect of Zhangzhou, later founded the prefectural school, promoted agriculture and benefited craftsmen, finally making Zhangzhou an important town in southern Fujian.

Therefore, Chen Yuanguang became the "Sacred King of Opening Zhangzhou" revered by the descendants of the soldiers who opened Zhangzhou, and the temples built were called Weihui Temples (Temples of Power and Grace), also enshrining Guanyin and Han clan ancestors.

The ancestral temple of Weihui Temple is this one under the huge ancient tree in Lubian Village, Xiangcheng.

The camphor-wood carved seated Guanyin statue in the temple is from the sixth year of Yanyou reign of the Yuan (1319), and the water-emerged stone lotus has an inscription from the third year of Taiding reign of the Yuan (1326); therefore, the founding date of Lubian Weihui Temple can be traced back to the sixth year of Yanyou reign of the Yuan.

Through modifications and repairs in successive dynasties, the existing buildings are works repaired in the Qing Dynasty.

The scale of the Weihui Temple here is not as large as its reputation, with only one courtyard and two halls front and back.

Both halls are also very small and exquisite, three bays wide; the roof ridge is also divided into three sections, with high upturned ends and soaring dragon sculptures, and the ends of the vertical ridges are further sculpted with heavenly palace pavilions.

The interior timber structure is unexpectedly ancient, not only with exquisite carving and decoration, but also retaining traces of oil paint, colored paintings, and murals from successive dynasties in many places, available for researchers to carry out various analytical and testing work.

推荐级别：★★★

南山寺

No.263
Nanshan Temple
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州市芗城区西桥街道丹霞山麓
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局晚期木结构南山寺位于漳州市区九龙江南侧的丹霞山麓从江滨公园一侧的人行桥跨过九龙江再向东步行一段时间就可以看到一座写有南山禅寺的牌楼从这里走一段林荫大道途经一座城隍庙到达路的尽端就可以看到南山寺了南山寺初建于唐开元二十四年736年为唐玄宗李隆基任太子时的太傅陈邕所建私宅
中文 Chinese

南山寺位于漳州市区九龙江南侧的丹霞山麓。从江滨公园一侧的人行桥跨过九龙江，再向东步行一段时间就可以看到一座写有"南山禅寺"的牌楼，从这里走一段林荫大道，途经一座城隍庙到达路的尽端，就可以看到南山寺了。

南山寺初建于唐开元二十四年（736年），为唐玄宗李隆基任太子时的太傅陈邕所建私宅。相传，由于府邸建造形式类似宫廷，严重逾制，被告到了朝廷。皇上听闻后派钦差查案。为了避罪，陈邕的女儿主动要求削发为尼，按照隋唐以来的惯例，献宅田以为寺院，将私宅改为寺庙。

南山寺初名延福禅寺，宋乾德年间刺史陈文颢重修，名"报劬院"，后改曰"崇福"。明朝改为南山寺，彼时香火兴旺，是禅宗临济喝云派的发源地。南山寺历代多有重修，仅方志上记载就有元至正、明嘉靖、隆庆年间几次重修。现存建筑为清末重修。

南山寺坐南朝北，中轴线上自北而南依次为山门、天王殿、放生池、大雄宝殿、法堂。法堂左右两侧设有祖师堂、太傅殿。位于中轴线东西两侧的则分别是西侧的地藏殿、福日斋、念佛堂，以及东侧的观音殿、德星堂、净业堂。东侧还有方丈楼、泰清寺等，以及传说中陈邕女儿金花修行的小阁楼。

山门为五开间两进深，其上有匾额"南山寺"，为明末名宦黄道周所书。西侧匾额上书"般若"，东侧为"解脱"。走进山门，可以看到天王殿的正面。当中挂有虞愚所书"天王殿"三字。殿中供奉弥勒佛，佛龛上有匾额"皆大欢喜"。四周供有四大金刚。弥勒佛背后则是护法韦陀。

再行，有两个巨大的放生池，放生池之后则是大雄宝殿。大殿面阔五间，进深五间，为重檐歇山顶，"大雄宝殿"是赵朴初的字。檐内则有弘一法师手书"妙相庄严"匾。

殿中佛坛上供奉三宝佛，并塑阿难、迦叶两尊者于两旁。在三尊大佛的背后，则供奉观世音菩萨、文殊菩萨和普贤菩萨。大雄宝殿东侧的净业堂，旧称石佛阁。其中石佛系初唐时期由一块天然石笋雕琢而成。净业堂内有一口铜钟，为元延祐年间重铸。石佛阁内的石柱上有大量刻字，为过去文人所题对联。

从大雄宝殿出来上坡右手边是藏经楼。南山寺的藏经楼内藏有大量珍品经文，包括血书《华严经》、《贝叶经》等。其中还供有一尊高约两米、通体为一块石头雕琢而成的玉佛。

English

Nanshan Temple is located at the foot of Danxia Mountain on the south side of the Jiulong River in the urban area of Zhangzhou.

Crossing the Jiulong River from the pedestrian bridge on the side of Jiangbin Park, then walking east for a while, one can see a memorial archway inscribed with "Nanshan Chan Temple"; from here, walking along a tree-lined avenue, passing a City God Temple and reaching the end of the road, one can see Nanshan Temple.

Nanshan Temple was first built in the 24th year of Kaiyuan reign of the Tang (736), as a private residence built by Chen Yong, the Grand Tutor of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang when he was crown prince.

According to legend, because the mansion was built in a form similar to the imperial palace, seriously exceeding the regulations, it was reported to the court.

Upon hearing this, the emperor sent an imperial envoy to investigate.

To avoid punishment, Chen Yong's daughter voluntarily requested to shave her head and become a nun; following the convention since the Sui and Tang dynasties, she donated the mansion and fields to become a temple, converting the private residence into a monastery.

Nanshan Temple was initially named Yanfu Chan Temple; during the Qiande reign of the Song, Prefect Chen Wenhao repaired it, naming it "Baoqu Courtyard," later changed to "Chongfu.

" In the Ming Dynasty it was renamed Nanshan Temple, at which time incense was flourishing and it was the birthplace of the Linyi Heyun sect of Chan Buddhism.

Nanshan Temple has been repaired many times through successive dynasties; only local gazetteers record several repairs in the Zhizheng reign of the Yuan and the Jiajing and Longqing reigns of the Ming.

The existing buildings were repaired in the late Qing.

Nanshan Temple faces north from the south, with the central axis from north to south依次 being the mountain gate, Hall of Heavenly Kings, Free Life Pond, Mahavira Hall, and Dharma Hall.

On the left and right sides of the Dharma Hall are the Patriarch Hall and Grand Tutor Hall.

Located on the east and west sides of the central axis are respectively the Ksitigarbha Hall, Furizhai, and Buddha Recitation Hall on the west, and the Guanyin Hall, Dexing Hall, and Jingye Hall on the east.

On the east side there are also the Abbot's Building, Taiqing Temple, etc., as well as the small attic where legend says Chen Yong's daughter Jinhua practiced.

The mountain gate is five bays wide and two bays deep, with a plaque "Nanshan Temple" on it, written by the late Ming official Huang Daozhou.

The west side plaque reads "Prajna," and the east side is "Liberation." Entering the mountain gate, one can see the front of the Hall of Heavenly Kings.

In the center hangs the three characters "Hall of Heavenly Kings" written by Yu Yu.The hall enshrines Maitreya Buddha, with a plaque "All Are Greatly Joyful" on the Buddhist niche.

Around it are enshrined the Four Great Vajras.Behind Maitreya Buddha is the protector Skanda.Further on, there are two huge Free Life Ponds; after the ponds is the Mahavira Hall.

The main hall is five bays wide and five bays deep, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof; "Mahavira Hall" is in the calligraphy of Zhao Puchu.

Inside the eaves is a plaque "Wondrous Form and Solemn Dignity" in the hand of Master Hongyi.

On the Buddhist altar in the hall are enshrined the Three Treasure Buddhas, with the two venerables Ananda and Kashyapa sculpted on both sides.

Behind the three great Buddhas are enshrined Guanyin Bodhisattva, Manjushri Bodhisattva, and Samantabhadra Bodhisattva.

The Jingye Hall on the east side of the Mahavira Hall was formerly called the Stone Buddha Pavilion.

The stone Buddha inside was carved from a natural stone stalagmite in the early Tang period.

In the Jingye Hall there is a bronze bell, recast during the Yanyou reign of the Yuan.

On the stone pillars inside the Stone Buddha Pavilion are many inscriptions, couplets written by literati of the past.

Coming out of the Mahavira Hall and going uphill, on the right is the Scripture Library.

The Scripture Library of Nanshan Temple contains a large number of precious scriptures, including the blood-written "Avatamsaka Sutra," "Palm-leaf Sutra," etc.

Among them is also enshrined a jade Buddha about two meters high, carved entirely from a single piece of stone.

推荐级别：★★

松州书院

No.264
Songzhou Academy
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：唐—清
地址：漳州市芗城区浦南镇的松洲村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
庙院合一的格局早期石作晚期木结构寻访漳州北郊的松州书院起初只是为了凭吊缅怀一下开漳圣王陈元光父子对教育事业的垂青要知道虽然有时间可考的私人创建的书院首推贞观九年635年的张九宗书院但是史料记载的当时具备讲学授徒活动条件的书院也就只有四所吉水县的皇寮书院漳州府的松州书院德安县的义门书院和奉新县的梧桐书院松州书院居其一
中文 Chinese

寻访漳州北郊的松州书院，起初只是为了凭吊，缅怀一下"开漳圣王"陈元光父子对教育事业的垂青。

要知道，虽然有时间可考的私人创建的书院首推贞观九年（635年）的张九宗书院，但是史料记载的当时具备讲学、授徒活动条件的书院也就只有四所——吉水县的皇寮书院、漳州府的松州书院、德安县的义门书院和奉新县的梧桐书院，松州书院居其一。

唐中宗景龙二年（708年），陈元光之子创立书院。《龙溪县志》记载："松州书院在二十四都，唐朝陈晌与士民讲学处。

"这里有书舍、厅堂、跑马场，面积约15亩，既可习文，又可习武。唐贞元二年（786年），州治迁至龙溪县，书院前增建松州大庙，祀陈元光及其部将，形成前庙后校的格局。

后来书院历经各朝重修，一直保持这种庙堂兼书院的特点。终于，1864年太平军战乱毁掉了书院，而执拗的文化再一次从灰烬中站立了起来。今天的书院，最养眼的是石作。

无论是院落中的铺墁和石狮，还是藏在一角的莲花柱础和须弥座，但完全属于我们不熟悉的年代。晚近的木作虽不完整但古意悠悠，耐人寻味。从新近悬挂的招牌来看，显然有司正计划着"注入历史内涵"，但愿那些古朴的构架和木雕不会被盖在光鲜的油漆之下。门房中，两位看庙的大爷正在看电视打发时光，定睛一瞧，那是NBA。

English

Visiting Songzhou Academy in the northern suburbs of Zhangzhou was initially only to pay homage, to cherish the memory of the "Sacred King of Opening Zhangzhou" Chen Yuanguang and his son's regard for education.

One should know that although the earliest privately founded academy with a verifiable date is the Zhang Jiuzong Academy from the ninth year of Zhenguan reign (635), the historical records show that at that time there were only four academies with conditions for lecturing and teaching disciples — the Huangliao Academy in Jishui County, the Songzhou Academy in Zhangzhou Prefecture, the Yimen Academy in De'an County, and the Wutong Academy in Fengxin County, with Songzhou Academy being one of them.

In the second year of Jinglong reign of Emperor Zhongzong of Tang (708), Chen Yuanguang's son founded the academy.

The "Longxi County Gazetteer" records: "Songzhou Academy is in the 24th district, a place where Chen Xiang of the Tang Dynasty lectured with scholars and commoners.

" Here there were study rooms, halls, and a horse racing field, covering about 15 mu, where one could both study literature and practice martial arts.

In the second year of Zhenyuan reign of the Tang (786), the prefectural seat was moved to Longxi County, and the Songzhou Grand Temple was added in front of the academy, enshrining Chen Yuanguang and his generals, forming a pattern of temple in front and school behind.

Later, the academy was repaired through successive dynasties, always maintaining this characteristic of being both a temple and an academy.

Finally, in 1864, the Taiping Rebellion destroyed the academy, but the stubborn culture once again stood up from the ashes.

In today's academy, the most eye-catching is the stonework.

Whether it is the paving and stone lions in the courtyard, or the lotus column bases and sumeru pedestals hidden in a corner, they all belong entirely to an era unfamiliar to us.

The more recent timberwork, although incomplete, is full of ancient charm and thought-provoking.

Judging from the newly hung signboards, it is clear that the authorities are planning to "inject historical connotation"; one hopes that those ancient frames and wood carvings will not be covered under glossy paint.

In the gatehouse, two old men watching the temple are watching TV to pass the time; looking closely, it is the NBA.

推荐级别：★★★★

霞东书院

No.265
Xiadong Academy
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州市芗城区西桥街道丹霞山麓
类型：文教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
书院格局晚期木结构从漳州市区出发乘坐26路28路或701路公交车到达丹霞园西公交站后向北走咸鱼市路右转再走一段就可以看到霞东书院霞东书院距离定潮楼很近被住宅楼簇拥着坦然对待来自一切角度的注视霞东书院始建于清康熙四十五年1706年原为将领蓝理的公馆乾隆年间文华殿大学士蔡新归隐后在此讲学塑文昌像以祭祀因而又称文昌宫
中文 Chinese

从漳州市区出发，乘坐26路、28路或701路公交车到达丹霞园（西）公交站后向北走，咸鱼市路右转再走一段就可以看到霞东书院。霞东书院距离定潮楼很近，被住宅楼簇拥着，坦然对待来自一切角度的注视。

霞东书院始建于清康熙四十五年（1706年），原为将领蓝理的公馆。乾隆年间文华殿大学士蔡新归隐后在此讲学，塑文昌像以祭祀，因而又称文昌宫。道光元年（1821年）重建。西侧有古碑数个，包括姚莹、章銮撰碑。

霞东书院坐西北而朝东南，由山门、正殿和两侧廊房组成"口"字形布局。山门为三开间建筑，上悬书有"文昌宫"的匾额。正殿面阔进深各三间，为悬山顶燕尾脊式建筑，在混凝土线条的背景下自由而热烈地舒展着。

室内木构架采用了抬梁穿斗混合式构架，斗拱细节和雕刻都非常精美，配合脊檩彩画，与室外形象形成对比，弥漫着素雅之气。

English

Starting from the urban area of Zhangzhou, take bus No.26, 28, or 701 to the Danxiayuan (West) bus stop, then walk north, turn right at Xianyu Shi Road, and walk a bit further to see Xiadong Academy.

Xiadong Academy is very close to Dingchao Tower, surrounded by residential buildings, calmly treating gazes from all angles.

Xiadong Academy was first built in the 45th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1706), originally the mansion of general Lan Li.

During the Qianlong reign, after Cai Xin, Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall, retired and returned home, he lectured here and had a statue of Wenchang (God of Literature) sculpted for sacrifice, hence it is also called Wenchang Palace.

It was rebuilt in the first year of Daoguang reign (1821).On the west side there are several ancient steles, including steles written by Yao Ying and Zhang Luan.

Xiadong Academy faces southeast from the northwest, composed of the mountain gate, main hall, and corridor rooms on both sides forming a "mouth" (口) shaped layout.

The mountain gate is a three-bay building, with a plaque inscribed "Wenchang Palace" hanging above.

The main hall is three bays wide and three bays deep, a building with an overhanging gable roof (xuanshan) and swallow-tail ridge, freely and enthusiastically unfolding against the background of concrete lines.

The interior timber frame uses a mixed tailiang (beam-lifting) and chuandou (column-and-tie) frame; the dougong details and carvings are all very exquisite, matching the ridge purlin colored paintings, forming a contrast with the exterior image and permeating with an elegant and simple atmosphere.

推荐级别：★★

漳州石牌坊

No.266
Zhangzhou Stone Archway
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：漳州芗城区修文西2号
类型：宗教建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
礼制建筑石结构石牌坊位于漳州芗城区老城之中修文西路与香港路的交叉口之北从漳州文庙出发沿老城的小路漫步街道两侧均是南方特有的骑楼式商铺贩卖着充满时代感的小物件地面上铺着青石砖回响着的已经不是布履的声音在与香港路的交叉口眼前豁然开朗两座石牌坊映入眼帘
中文 Chinese

石牌坊位于漳州芗城区老城之中，修文西路与香港路的交叉口之北。从漳州文庙出发，沿老城的小路漫步，街道两侧均是南方特有的骑楼式商铺，贩卖着充满时代感的小物件。地面上铺着青石砖，回响着的已经不是布履的声音。在与香港路的交叉口眼前豁然开朗，两座石牌坊映入眼帘。

石牌坊包括两座明代石坊，均为南北向，两坊相距约30米。南侧一座匾额两侧分别刻有楷体的"尚书"、"探花"；北侧一座则刻有"三世宰贰"、"两京易历"。尚书探花坊为明万历三十三年（1605年）林士章所立。

林士章是漳浦人，嘉靖探花，后任南京礼部尚书。而三世宰贰坊则是万历四十七年（1619年）为南京吏部右侍郎蒋孟育，及其父蒋玉山、祖父蒋相所立。两座石牌坊均是石构仿木构的建筑形式，正面均是三开间，落十二柱。牌坊出檐有自然的起翘，檐下设有两根垂花柱。

正匾上竖书"恩荣"二字，下为石构的梁枋。梁枋上有大量精致的雕刻，多为人物场景，也有一些龙纹、云纹、花草纹、动物纹饰等。采用了阴刻、浮雕、透雕、双面雕等手法，极具表现力。另外，一些建筑构件也巧妙地利用雕刻手法形成独特的造型，包括斗拱、雀替、垂花柱等构件。

English

The stone archways are located in the old city of Xiangcheng District, Zhangzhou, north of the intersection of Xiuwen West Road and Hong Kong Road.

Starting from Zhangzhou Confucian Temple, strolling along the small roads of the old city, both sides of the street are arcade-style shops unique to the south, selling small objects full of a sense of the times.

The ground is paved with bluestone bricks, and what echoes is no longer the sound of cloth shoes.

At the intersection with Hong Kong Road, the view suddenly opens up and two stone archways come into view.

The stone archways include two Ming Dynasty stone archways, both oriented north-south, with the two archways about 30 meters apart.

On the south archway, the two sides of the plaque are respectively engraved with the regular script characters "Shangshu" (Minister) and "Tanhua" (third-place jinshi); the north archway is engraved with "Sanshi Zai'er" (Three Generations of Deputy Ministers) and "Liangjing Yili" (Serving in Both Capitals).

The Shangshu Tanhua Archway was erected by Lin Shizhang in the 33rd year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1605).

Lin Shizhang was from Zhangpu, a Tanhua of the Jiajing reign, later serving as Minister of Rites in Nanjing.

The Sanshi Zai'er Archway was erected in the 47th year of Wanli reign (1619) for Jiang Mengyu, Right Vice Minister of Personnel in Nanjing, his father Jiang Yushan, and his grandfather Jiang Xiang.

Both stone archways are in the architectural form of stone structure imitating timber structure, with the front both three bays wide and twelve columns.

The archway eaves have natural upturns, with two pendant column capitals under the eaves.

On the main plaque, the two characters "Enrong" (Imperial Grace) are written vertically, below which are stone-structured beams and lintels.

On the beams and lintels there are a large number of exquisite carvings, mostly figure scenes, as well as some dragon patterns, cloud patterns, flower and grass patterns, animal ornamentation, etc.

Techniques such as intaglio, relief, openwork, and double-sided carving are used, highly expressive.

In addition, some architectural components also cleverly use carving techniques to form unique shapes, including components such as dougong, sparrow brackets (queti), and pendant column capitals.

推荐级别：★★★★

正德石坊

No.267
Zhengde Stone Archway
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：漳州芗城区新华东路
类型：民居·礼制建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
石仿木结构石雕装饰故事表现在短短的新华东路上伫立着三座石牌坊从南向北分别为勇壮简易闽越雄声两座清代石坊以及明代的正德石坊通常来讲勇壮简易坊和闽越雄声坊因为造型类似而与老城内香港路上的尚书坊三世宰贰坊并称漳州石牌坊是漳州石坊的代表新华东路现在被用作菜市场附近的居民都在这里采购生活必需的食物
中文 Chinese

在短短的新华东路上，伫立着三座石牌坊。从南向北分别为"勇壮简易"、"闽越雄声"两座清代石坊，以及明代的正德石坊。通常来讲，"勇壮简易"坊和"闽越雄声"坊，因为造型类似，而与老城内香港路上的尚书坊、三世宰贰坊并称漳州石牌坊，是漳州石坊的代表。

新华东路现在被用作菜市场，附近的居民都在这里采购生活必需的食物。道路不算宽敞，两侧同样是骑楼式的建筑。小贩们摆起铺子，使通道越发狭小。嘈杂和失控之间，仿佛只是生理极限，与石牌坊的精神力量毫不相干。新华东路是一条南北向的斜街。从南侧的入口进入，首先看到的就是"勇壮简易"坊。

"勇壮简易"坊建于清康熙四十六年（1707年），赐与漳浦人氏蓝理。蓝理曾任天津总兵、福建提督、左都督，挂镇朔将军印。在清初统一台湾的行动中战功显著，曾在澎湖血战中救施琅出重围。康熙帝于四十二年、四十五年先后御书两匾赐之。分别为"勇壮简易"和"所向无前"。"勇壮简易"坊同样是由十二根坊柱分隔为三间。

正楼四坡顶，顶部檐下正中置镂雕一满布龙纹的竖匾，上"御书"二字。其下是两面分刻康熙帝御书的正匾。正匾以下，石构仿木构的梁枋划分出三层。中层一层刻有楷书诰布，上下层则是人物场景为主题的镂空双面雕花板，反映了蓝理在战场上的英勇形象，再下为额枋。

在勇壮简易一侧的边楼上，还可以清晰认出雕刻有戴礼帽、穿洋装的外国人形象，体现了漳州作为海上丝绸之路起点的影响。在雕刻作品中尚属少见的情况。"闽越雄声"坊为康熙帝于六十一年（1722年）赐予漳州海澄人许凤的。许凤与蓝理同为清初平台大将。

牌坊两侧刻有"闽越雄声"、"楚滇伟绩"的字样。在"闽越雄声"坊上，可以看到更多外国人的形象，包括外国人与中国人对话的场景也有所反映。再向北走，会看到街道内的一所小学——岳口小学。仔细观察可以发现，小学的大门是由一座石牌坊改造而成的。这就是本节真正的主角，漳州现存最早的石坊建筑——正德石坊。石坊最初是东岳庙的正门，寺庙毁后，遗址上建起小学，石坊也就变为小学大门了。

石坊造型古朴，由四根石柱支撑。顶上是一巨型条石，两端微微起翘。其下为几层石制梁枋，上书"正德七年正月初八日立"（1512年）。

English

On the short Xinhua East Road, three stone archways stand.

From south to north are respectively the two Qing Dynasty archways "Yongzhuang Jianyi" (Brave, Strong, Simple, Easy) and "Min Yue Xiong Sheng" (Heroic Voice of Min and Yue), as well as the Ming Dynasty Zhengde Stone Archway.

Generally speaking, the "Yongzhuang Jianyi" archway and the "Min Yue Xiong Sheng" archway, because of their similar shapes, together with the Shangshu Archway and Sanshi Zai'er Archway on Hong Kong Road in the old city, are collectively called Zhangzhou Stone Archways, representing Zhangzhou's stone archways.

Xinhua East Road is now used as a vegetable market, and nearby residents all come here to buy food necessary for life.The road is not very wide, and both sides are likewise arcade-style buildings.

Vendors set up stalls, making the passage even narrower.

Between noise and loss of control, it seems merely a physiological limit, having nothing to do with the spiritual power of the stone archways.

Xinhua East Road is a diagonal street running north-south.Entering from the south entrance, the first thing one sees is the "Yongzhuang Jianyi" archway.

The "Yongzhuang Jianyi" archway was built in the 46th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1707), bestowed upon Lan Li, a native of Zhangpu.

Lan Li served as Commander-in-Chief of Tianjin, Provincial Commander of Fujian, Left Commander-in-Chief, holding the seal of General Zhenshuo.

He had remarkable military merits in the action to unify Taiwan in the early Qing, once rescuing Shi Lang from a heavy siege in the bloody battle of Penghu.

The Kangxi Emperor successively bestowed two plaques in his own calligraphy in the 42nd and 45th years, respectively "Yongzhuang Jianyi" and "Suo Xiang Wu Qian" (Invincible Wherever He Goes).

The "Yongzhuang Jianyi" archway is likewise divided into three bays by twelve archway columns.

The main tower has a four-slope roof, with an openwork-carved vertical plaque full of dragon patterns placed in the center under the top eaves, inscribed with the two characters "Imperial Calligraphy.

" Below it are the main plaques with the Kangxi Emperor's imperial calligraphy engraved on both sides.

Below the main plaque, the stone-structured timber-imitating beams and lintels are divided into three layers.

The middle layer is engraved with regular script imperial edicts, while the upper and lower layers are openwork double-sided carved panels with figure scenes as the theme, reflecting Lan Li's heroic image on the battlefield, and below that are the architraves.

On the side tower of one side of Yongzhuang Jianyi, one can also clearly recognize carved images of foreigners wearing top hats and Western suits, reflecting Zhangzhou's influence as the starting point of the Maritime Silk Road, a situation still rare in carved works.

The "Min Yue Xiong Sheng" archway was bestowed by the Kangxi Emperor in the 61st year (1722) upon Xu Feng, a native of Haicheng, Zhangzhou.

Xu Feng and Lan Li were both great generals in the early Qing pacification of Taiwan.

Both sides of the archway are engraved with the characters "Min Yue Xiong Sheng" and "Chu Dian Wei Ji" (Great Achievements in Chu and Dian).

On the "Min Yue Xiong Sheng" archway, one can see more images of foreigners, including scenes of foreigners conversing with Chinese people also reflected.

Walking further north, one will see a primary school in the street — Yuekou Primary School.Careful observation reveals that the school's main gate was converted from a stone archway.

This is the true protagonist of this section, the earliest surviving stone archway building in Zhangzhou — the Zhengde Stone Archway.

The stone archway was originally the main gate of the Dongyue Temple; after the temple was destroyed, a primary school was built on the site, and the stone archway thus became the school's main gate.

The stone archway has a simple and ancient shape, supported by four stone columns.On top is a giant strip stone, with both ends slightly upturned.

Below it are several layers of stone beams and lintels, inscribed with "Erected on the eighth day of the first month of the seventh year of Zhengde" (1512).

推荐级别：★★★★

芝山三亭

No.268
Three Pavilions in Zhishan
级别：市级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳州芗城区胜利西路
类型：公共设施·亭
特征标签 Highlights
石结构遗迹凭吊漳州芝山是紫芝山之简称在市区北隅原名登高山为漳州古城的主山和名胜景点明洪武十三年380年山上长紫芝知府徐恭表上赐名紫芝山俗称芝山山有三峰峰上各筑一亭威镇亭后名威镇亭仰止亭甘露亭合称芝山三亭
中文 Chinese

漳州芝山是紫芝山之简称，在市区北隅，原名登高山，为漳州古城的主山和名胜景点。明洪武十三年（380年）山上长紫芝，知府徐恭表上，赐名紫芝山，俗称芝山。山有三峰，峰上各筑一亭，威镇亭（后名威镇亭）、仰止亭、甘露亭，合称芝山三亭。我们没有寻访到这三亭，只是看到芝山公园中的新亭子，古亭子大概在军事禁区内吧。

回来在网络上搜索，读到一些长者的感叹："漳州市区内最高的山就是芝山了，在一中校园内。那时的芝山，树木少，相思树最多，山上还可以采到可以吃的野果……在我童年的记忆中，芝山是漳州最美的地方……现代楼群已经密密麻麻地把芝山围个水泄不通，山下是围墙，整座山长满了高大茂密的树林，根本无法看到'庐山真面目'，据说盛名之下的三亭仅剩二亭，有的说只剩下一亭。"芝山上树木苍翠，浓荫蔽日。

原来三亭鼎立，寺院众多，想必别有一番幽深。三亭中万寿亭为八角平面，余为六角，均通体石结构。只有通过老照片一睹芳容了。

万寿亭在北峰，原称威镇亭，因与城内威镇阁相望而得名，始建于明弘治年间（1488—1505年），嘉靖年间（1522—1566年）重修，清康熙五十二年（1713年）再修，后改名"万寿纪恩亭"，俗称万寿亭。

甘露亭在中峰，《漳州府志》载明嘉靖十六年（1537年）甘露降，御史李元阳作表祝此祥瑞，知府孙裕特建亭以志瑞。仰止亭，明嘉靖十四年（1535年）在东岗之半建亭，取名"仰止"，在当地有个俏皮的谐音名字"老鼠亭"。

English

Zhishan in Zhangzhou is the abbreviation of Zizhi Mountain (Purple Glossy Ganoderma Mountain), located in the northern part of the urban area, originally named Denggao Mountain (Climbing High Mountain), the main mountain and scenic spot of the ancient Zhangzhou city.

In the 13th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1380), purple glossy ganoderma grew on the mountain; Prefect Xu Gong reported it to the court, and the emperor bestowed the name Zizhi Mountain, commonly called Zhishan.

The mountain has three peaks, with a pavilion built on each peak: Weizhen Pavilion (later named Weizhen Pavilion), Yangzhi Pavilion, and Ganlu Pavilion, collectively called the Three Pavilions of Zhishan.

We did not visit these three pavilions, only seeing new pavilions in Zhishan Park; the ancient pavilions are probably within a military restricted area.

Upon returning and searching online, I read the lament of some elders: "The highest mountain in the Zhangzhou urban area is Zhishan, within the No.1 Middle School campus.

At that time, Zhishan had few trees, with the most acacia trees, and one could even pick edible wild fruits on the mountain...

In my childhood memories, Zhishan was the most beautiful place in Zhangzhou...

Modern building groups have already densely surrounded Zhishan, with walls at the foot of the mountain, and the entire mountain is covered with tall and dense forests, making it impossible to see the 'true face of Lushan'; it is said that under the great reputation, only two of the three pavilions remain, and some say only one remains.

" On Zhishan, the trees are verdant and the thick shade blocks the sun.Originally the three pavilions stood tripod-like, with numerous temples, presumably having a special seclusion.

Among the three pavilions, Wanshou Pavilion has an octagonal plan, while the others are hexagonal, all entirely of stone structure.One can only catch a glimpse of their beauty through old photos.

Wanshou Pavilion is on the north peak, originally called Weizhen Pavilion, named because it faces Weizhen Pavilion in the city; it was first built during the Hongzhi reign of the Ming (1488–1505), repaired during the Jiajing reign (1522–1566), and repaired again in the 52nd year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1713), later renamed "Wanshou Ji'en Pavilion" (Longevity Gratitude Pavilion), commonly called Wanshou Pavilion.

Ganlu Pavilion is on the middle peak; the "Zhangzhou Prefecture Gazetteer" records that in the 16th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1537), sweet dew fell, and Censor Li Yuanyang wrote a memorial celebrating this auspicious sign; Prefect Sun Yu specially built a pavilion to record the auspiciousness.

Yangzhi Pavilion was built halfway up the eastern hill in the 14th year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1535), named "Yangzhi" (Looking Up in Admiration), with a playful homophonic local name "Laoshu Ting" (Mouse Pavilion).

推荐级别：★★

中正和平坊

No.269
Zhongzheng Heping Archway
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：漳州龙文区蓝田镇西坑村
类型：礼制建筑·石结构
特征标签 Highlights
斗拱拆换下来的老构件官府立坊皇帝赐匾读书人得到这样的荣耀夫复何求啊榜样的力量挺立了几百年引得无数借助时运而发迹的商人也板起脸来教子读书了中正和平坊是明崇祯年间1628至1644年为表彰蓝田本地人万历进士晋东阁大学士林钎的功绩而建牌坊两侧正中的中正和平澹泊宁静匾便是对林钎的颂扬牌坊也因此得名
中文 Chinese

官府立坊，皇帝赐匾，读书人得到这样的荣耀夫复何求啊！榜样的力量挺立了几百年，引得无数借助时运而发迹的商人也板起脸来教子读书了。中正和平坊是明崇祯年间（1628—1644年）为表彰蓝田本地人万历进士、晋东阁大学士林钎的功绩而建。牌坊两侧正中的"中正和平"、"澹泊宁静"匾便是对林钎的颂扬，牌坊也因此得名。

这也是一座石构，高9.2米，宽9.5米，深2.2米。推敲起牌坊的仿木结构设计，还是很有味道的。牌坊共用石柱12根，而最核心的四根在进深的中线上，也用料最硕壮，形成三间的格局，其实是模仿四柱三楼的木牌坊。

但是石结构出檐部分则不如木结构一般悬挑自如，石材的节理会造成结构隐患，于是支撑屋檐的立柱就是必不可少的。最终，左右两翼成为重檐亭子一样的结构，其顶上再承载当心屋顶的重量。常见的大型多柱石牌坊结构一般如此。中正和平坊不重装饰，更清晰地表达了这个结构逻辑。

English

The government erects an archway, the emperor bestows a plaque — what more could a scholar ask for with such honor!

The power of example has stood for hundreds of years, causing countless merchants who prospered through luck to also put on serious faces and teach their sons to read.

The Zhongzheng Heping Archway was built during the Chongzhen reign of the Ming (1628–1644) to commend the merits of Lin Qian, a native of Lantian who was a jinshi of the Wanli reign and Grand Secretary of the Jinshendong Pavilion.

The plaques "Zhongzheng Heping" (Upright and Peaceful) and "Danbo Ningjing" (Detached and Tranquil) in the center of both sides of the archway are praises of Lin Qian, and the archway is thus named.

This is also a stone structure, 9.2 meters high, 9.5 meters wide, and 2.2 meters deep.Deliberating on the timber-imitating structure design of the archway, it is quite flavorful.

The archway uses a total of 12 stone columns, with the four most core ones on the central line of depth, also using the most robust materials, forming a three-bay layout, actually imitating a four-column three-story wooden archway.

However, the eave part of the stone structure is not as freely cantilevered as timber structure; the grain of stone can cause structural hazards, so the columns supporting the eaves are indispensable.

Ultimately, the left and right wings become structures like double-eave pavilions, with their tops further bearing the weight of the central roof.

Common large multi-column stone archway structures are generally like this.The Zhongzheng Heping Archway does not emphasize decoration, more clearly expressing this structural logic.

推荐级别：★★★

白礁慈济宫

No.270
Ciji Temple in Baijiao
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州角美白礁村
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构慈济宫是为了纪念保生大帝吴夲而兴建的保生大帝即吴夲是宋代闽南地区的神医除了厦门的青礁慈济祖宫慈济宫在福建和台湾数量众多可以看出保生大帝在闽台文化的影响之大而位于漳州角美白礁村的慈济宫据考证是保生大帝最早的古庙最早兴建于南宋绍兴二十年1150年
中文 Chinese

慈济宫是为了纪念保生大帝吴夲而兴建的。保生大帝，即吴夲，是宋代闽南地区的神医。

除了厦门的青礁慈济祖宫，慈济宫在福建和台湾数量众多，可以看出保生大帝在闽台文化的影响之大。

而位于漳州角美白礁村的慈济宫，据考证是保生大帝最早的古庙，最早兴建于南宋绍兴二十年（1150年）。该建筑为三进殿宇，随着地势起伏逐步升起，造型雄伟。油得朱红的木结构映衬着古朴的石雕，别有一番意趣。

梁枋之上，精美的木雕星罗棋布，名人题词、历史的故事等题材的壁画也随处可见。最为令人震撼的是建筑内悬挂着无数的匾额，它们不仅来自当地居民，还来自海峡那边的台胞们。每年都有无数台胞前来举行盛大的祭祀仪式，歌颂着保生大帝的恩德，赞扬着行医救世的善举。

这些都表达着闽台人民世世代代对于保生大帝的感念之情，彰显了闽台文化的独特魅力。

English

Ciji Temple was built to commemorate Baosheng Dadi (Great Emperor of Life Protection) Wu Ben.

Baosheng Dadi, namely Wu Ben, was a divine doctor in the Minnan (southern Fujian) region during the Song Dynasty.

Besides the Qingjiao Ciji Ancestral Temple in Xiamen, Ciji Temples are numerous in Fujian and Taiwan, showing the great influence of Baosheng Dadi in Minnan-Taiwan culture.

The Ciji Temple located in Baijiao Village, Jiaomei, Zhangzhou, according to research, is the earliest ancient temple of Baosheng Dadi, first built in the 20th year of Shaoxing reign of the Southern Song (1150).

This building is a three-courtyard hall complex, gradually rising with the terrain, with a majestic shape.

The vermilion-oiled timber structure sets off the ancient stone carvings, with a special charm.

On the beams and lintels, exquisite wood carvings are scattered everywhere, and murals with themes such as celebrity inscriptions and historical stories can also be seen everywhere.

The most shocking is that countless plaques hang inside the building, not only from local residents but also from Taiwan compatriots across the strait.

Every year, countless Taiwan compatriots come to hold grand sacrificial ceremonies, praising the kindness and virtue of Baosheng Dadi and extolling the good deeds of practicing medicine to save the world.

These all express the gratitude of the Minnan-Taiwan people for Baosheng Dadi from generation to generation, highlighting the unique charm of Minnan-Taiwan culture.

推荐级别：★★★

白礁王氏家庙

No.271
Ancestral Temple Complex for Wang's Clan in Baijiao
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州角美白礁村
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
寺院格局木结构角美镇白礁村的王氏家庙位于漳州东部与厦门交界处庙里有台湾名人王金平的供奉相传王氏祖先源自河南唐末入闽建立闽国后又代代相传庙始建于永乐十年1412年清康熙乾隆光绪年间多次重修是一座占地面积约1600平方米坐北朝南的小型家庙
中文 Chinese

角美镇白礁村的王氏家庙位于漳州东部与厦门交界处，庙里有台湾名人王金平的供奉。相传王氏祖先源自河南，唐末入闽建立"闽国"，后又代代相传。庙始建于永乐十年（1412年），清康熙、乾隆、光绪年间多次重修，是一座占地面积约1600平方米，坐北朝南的小型家庙。

主要建筑有前殿，大殿（世飨堂）以及左右厢房。宗族观念在闽南仍旧根深蒂固，家庙虽然只是一个简单的院落，然而装饰丰富，雕刻精美，显得较为堂皇。大殿的屋架采用抬梁结构，油饰彩画繁简得当，热烈不失庄重。内部悬挂的各类匾额或图文信息，显示着家庙在如今仍旧承担着重要的宗族作用。

English

The Wang Clan Ancestral Temple in Baijiao Village, Jiaomei Town, is located at the junction of eastern Zhangzhou and Xiamen, with the enshrinement of Taiwan celebrity Wang Jin-pyng in the temple.

According to legend, the Wang clan ancestors originated from Henan, entered Fujian in the late Tang and established the "Min Kingdom," and then passed down from generation to generation.

The temple was first built in the 10th year of Yongle reign (1412), and repaired multiple times during the Kangxi, Qianlong, and Guangxu reigns of the Qing; it is a small ancestral temple covering about 1,600 square meters, facing south from the north.

The main buildings include the front hall, the main hall (Shixiang Hall), and the left and right wing rooms.

Clan concepts are still deeply rooted in Minnan; although the ancestral temple is only a simple courtyard, it is richly decorated with exquisite carvings, appearing rather grand.

The roof frame of the main hall uses a tailiang (beam-lifting) structure, with oil paint and colored paintings appropriately complex or simple, warm yet solemn.

The various plaques or graphic information hung inside show that the ancestral temple still plays an important clan role today.

推荐级别：★★★

海澄文庙

No.272
Temple of Confucius in Haicheng
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳州龙海县海澄镇龙海二中
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
文庙格局石作大殿木结构被簇拥在龙海二中的教学楼当中不知道海澄文庙是否感受到了它在今天的尊严图书馆牌子下门的大锁或者说明文庙的中学藏书楼功能和它应有的地位不大相称诉说着一个短暂时代终结前的犹豫海澄县志载文庙是明隆庆元年1567年郡守唐九德创建的崇祯六年1633年知县梁兆阳重俢清乾隆二十六年1761年知县王作霖再修
中文 Chinese

被簇拥在龙海二中的教学楼当中，不知道海澄文庙是否感受到了它在今天的尊严。图书馆牌子下门的大锁，或者说明文庙的中学藏书楼功能和它应有的地位不大相称，诉说着一个短暂时代终结前的犹豫。

《海澄县志》载，文庙是明隆庆元年（1567年）郡守唐九德创建的，崇祯六年（1633年）知县梁兆阳重修，清乾隆二十六年（1761年），知县王作霖再修。

最近的修缮是1990年，品位尚在恢复的年代。于是不难解释为什么校园里的古迹也长得像张牙舞爪的龙虾，或者是煮熟的螃蟹。好在文庙在教室楼中传来的朗朗读书声中显得安详了，是今天功能烘托古迹的好氛围。现存文庙坐东北朝西南，正对二中校门，花坛之后就是古泮池，今天已经"面目一新"了。过了拱桥就是大成门。

大成门面阔五间，明三间开门。抛开屋面瓦作不谈，盘龙柱、墙面和基础石作是真正的古迹，用料大方，形制井然，工艺细腻。可惜没有缘分联系到文物局的管理人员，无法入得室内，只好从旁门进去窥见两庑、月台、大成殿、崇圣祠等建筑的面貌。

大成殿面阔五间，进深三间，重檐歇山顶。殿前有青石蟠龙浮雕，油饰彩画之下是工艺水平颇佳的木雕和尺度硕壮的斗拱，前廊处便可见一斑。

English

Surrounded among the teaching buildings of Longhai No.2 Middle School, one wonders whether Haicheng Confucian Temple feels its dignity today.

The big lock on the door under the library sign perhaps indicates that the Confucian Temple's function as a middle school library building does not quite match its due status, telling of the hesitation before the end of a short era.

The "Haicheng County Gazetteer" records that the Confucian Temple was founded by Prefect Tang Jiude in the first year of Longqing reign of the Ming (1567), repaired by County Magistrate Liang Zhaoyang in the sixth year of Chongzhen reign (1633), and repaired again by County Magistrate Wang Zuolin in the 26th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1761).

The most recent repair was in 1990, an era when taste was still recovering.

Thus it is not difficult to explain why the ancient relics in the campus also look like baring their fangs and brandishing their claws like lobsters, or cooked crabs.

Fortunately, the Confucian Temple appears serene amid the sound of loud reading coming from the classroom buildings, a good atmosphere where today's functions set off the ancient relics.

The existing Confucian Temple faces southwest from the northeast, directly facing the gate of No.

2 Middle School; after the flower bed is the ancient Pan Pond, which today has been "completely renovated." Crossing the arch bridge is the Dacheng Gate.

The Dacheng Gate is five bays wide, with the central three bays having doors.

Leaving aside the roof tile work, the dragon-coiled columns, wall surfaces, and foundation stonework are true ancient relics, with generous materials, orderly forms, and exquisite craftsmanship.

Unfortunately, there was no opportunity to contact the management personnel of the Cultural Relics Bureau, so one could not enter the interior, and had to go in through the side door to glimpse the appearance of buildings such as the two side wings, moon platform, Dacheng Hall, and Chongsheng Shrine.

The Dacheng Hall is five bays wide and three bays deep, with a double-eave hip-and-gable roof.

In front of the hall are bluestone dragon-coiled relief carvings; beneath the oil paint and colored paintings are wood carvings of quite good craftsmanship and dougong of robust scale, which can be glimpsed at the front corridor.

推荐级别：★★★

江东桥

No.273
Jiangdong Bridge
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：宋
地址：漳州台商投资区角美镇跨九龙江
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
古石桥遗迹跨度与结构形式无论是不是在台商投资区桥都会一样繁忙取代江东桥的新桥如此古代江东桥也是一样作为横跨九龙江北溪下游的被列为世界最大的石梁桥如果没有十足的必要没有充分的利用何以为桥呢江东桥曾经相继以浮桥和木桥的形象出现然而浮桥飘摇木制的前身终毁于火灾因此于宋嘉熙元年1237年筹资建石桥石桥历经近千年仍旧屹立不倒在新中国成立后甚至还是324国道上的要塞
中文 Chinese

无论是不是在台商投资区，桥都会一样繁忙，取代江东桥的新桥如此，古代江东桥也是一样，作为横跨九龙江北溪下游的被列为世界最大的石梁桥，如果没有十足的必要，没有充分的利用，何以为桥呢？

江东桥曾经相继以浮桥和木桥的形象出现，然而浮桥飘摇，木制的前身终毁于火灾，因此于宋嘉熙元年（1237年）筹资建石桥。石桥历经近千年，仍旧屹立不倒，在新中国成立后甚至还是324国道上的要塞。不过如今，古桥终究难以承担主要交通的重任了。由于洪灾，江东桥曾几度危难。

经过修复，古桥得以完整保留，然而却不再能够通过汽车了。现如今，桥体上起保护作用的现代混凝土构件也显得较为突出，桥面上已经无法真正找到古代的印记。不过漫步桥上，感受却是异乎寻常的"穿越"，江波映衬着草木，那似乎就是千年之前横渡九龙江的闽地人民所看到的景象。

English

Whether in the Taiwanese Investment Zone or not, a bridge will be equally busy; so is the new bridge replacing Jiangdong Bridge, and so was the ancient Jiangdong Bridge.

As the stone beam bridge spanning the lower reaches of the North Stream of the Jiulong River, listed as the world's largest, if there were no absolute necessity and no充分 utilization, how could it be a bridge?

Jiangdong Bridge once appeared successively in the forms of a floating bridge and a wooden bridge; however, the floating bridge was飘摇, and the wooden predecessor was finally destroyed by fire, so funds were raised to build a stone bridge in the first year of Jiaxi reign of the Song (1237).

The stone bridge has stood for nearly a thousand years, still standing firm, and even served as a strategic point on National Highway 324 after the founding of New China.

However, today, the ancient bridge can hardly bear the heavy responsibility of main traffic after all.Due to floods, Jiangdong Bridge was once in danger several times.

After repairs, the ancient bridge was completely preserved, but it can no longer allow cars to pass.

Nowadays, the modern concrete components playing a protective role on the bridge body also appear rather prominent, and ancient marks can no longer truly be found on the bridge deck.

However, strolling on the bridge, the feeling is an extraordinary "time travel"; the river waves set off the plants, which seems to be the scene seen by the people of Fujian crossing the Jiulong River a thousand years ago.

推荐级别：★★

林氏义庄

No.274
Lin's Family Mansion
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州角美镇杨厝村过井社
类型：公共建筑·砖木结构
特征标签 Highlights
建筑功能结构与装饰义庄之义在于人心在于修养在于参悟生活的意义林平侯是龙溪县二十九都白石保吉尚村潭头人士这个地方今天叫作角美镇杨厝村过井社林平侯走了一条当年的致富路远行台湾并终于发迹有了家业林平侯心怀家乡疾苦适逢灾劫决心捐助赈济便于嘉庆二十四年1819年在潭头地方筹建林氏义庄经近两年营建而成
中文 Chinese

义庄之"义"在于人心，在于修养，在于参悟生活的意义。林平侯，是龙溪县二十九都白石保吉尚村潭头人士，这个地方今天叫作角美镇杨厝村过井社。林平侯走了一条当年的致富路——远行台湾，并终于发迹。有了家业，林平侯心怀家乡疾苦，适逢灾劫，决心捐助赈济，便于嘉庆二十四年（1819年）在潭头地方筹建林氏义庄，经近两年营建而成。

从此林氏义庄开始办理赡赈，直至民国时代方才终止，是当时该地区著名的慈善机构之一。今天的林氏义庄成为了人们观瞻之处。这里的建筑仍然保持着古典大方、简朴素雅的造型特征。义庄前有水潭，倒影之中，更显端庄。入口开在前坪之侧，院内整体结构为三座平排两进大厝。水井依然，残墙凋敝，义庄早已失去了往日的喧闹。院中只有少量管理人员在此工作居住，气氛倒是显得恬静肃穆。

建筑内构造精巧，还保留着古老的石碑、牌位等，共同讲述着林氏义庄百年善举。

English

The "righteousness" of the Righteous Manor lies in the human heart, in self-cultivation, and in comprehending the meaning of life.

Lin Pinghou was a native of Tantou, Jishang Village, Baishi Bao, 29th Du, Longxi County; this place is today called Guojing She, Yangcuo Village, Jiaomei Town.

Lin Pinghou took a path to wealth in those days — traveling far to Taiwan, and finally prospered.

Having established a family fortune, Lin Pinghou bore in mind the hardships of his hometown; coinciding with a disaster, he resolved to donate for relief, and in the 24th year of Jiaqing reign (1819) began to prepare the construction of the Lin Clan Righteous Manor at Tantou, completed after nearly two years of construction.

From then on, the Lin Clan Righteous Manor began to handle relief support, which did not cease until the Republican era, and was one of the famous charitable institutions in the region at that time.

Today's Lin Clan Righteous Manor has become a place for people to visit.The buildings here still maintain the modeling features of classical grandeur and simple elegance.

In front of the Righteous Manor there is a water pond, in whose reflections it appears even more dignified.

The entrance opens on the side of the front courtyard, and the overall structure of the courtyard is three parallel two-courtyard large mansions.

The water well remains, with dilapidated remnant walls; the Righteous Manor has long lost its former bustle.

Only a small number of management personnel work and live in the courtyard, and the atmosphere appears quite tranquil and solemn.

The interior of the building is exquisitely constructed, still preserving ancient stone steles, spirit tablets, etc., together telling the century-old good deeds of the Lin Clan Righteous Manor.

推荐级别：★★★

石码杨氏大夫第

No.275
Residence of Councilor Yang in Shima
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州龙海市石码镇下庵路
类型：民居建筑
特征标签 Highlights
民居格局石作装饰杨氏大夫第躲藏在石码镇的老街巷中好在城市不大人们都知道下庵路的所在在欧洲也会遇到不欢迎访客的古老住宅我们在石码的经历或许还算不错年轻的主人允许我们在前院拍摄了几张照片杨家做了官于是开始修造府第即使在清末的光绪甲辰年1904年这个风气也没有变住宅坐北朝南前后三进比较幽深但建筑规模不大厅堂都是面阔三间的东西两侧还各带一列护厝
中文 Chinese

杨氏大夫第躲藏在石码镇的老街巷中，好在城市不大，人们都知道下庵路的所在。在欧洲也会遇到不欢迎访客的古老住宅。我们在石码的经历或许还算不错，年轻的主人允许我们在前院拍摄了几张照片。杨家做了官，于是开始修造府第，即使在清末的光绪甲辰年（1904年）这个风气也没有变。

住宅坐北朝南，前后三进，比较幽深，但建筑规模不大，厅堂都是面阔三间的，东西两侧还各带一列护厝。门楼石门框上刻着"门庭光显"。进门后前坪宽敞，铺墁讲究。前厅大门之上则镶嵌石匾"大夫第"。再深的二进大厅为"述志堂"，三进为西洋式二层楼房"开心楼"，又名梳妆楼。

其他还有书房、暖阁、客房、仓库、花园、鱼池、假山、拱桥、猴洞等。从对我们开放的前院看前厅和左右旁门，就强烈地感觉杨家不惜工本的心气，建造得毫不留白，满满的都是装饰，使用了不少瓷砖、缸砖等近代材料；而由于石材色泽相对统一，远看也并不感觉过分花哨。

English

The Yang Clan Dafu Di (Residence of a Grand Master) hides in the old streets and alleys of Shima Town; fortunately the city is not large, and everyone knows where Xia'an Road is.

In Europe one also encounters ancient residences that do not welcome visitors.Our experience in Shima was perhaps not bad, as the young owner allowed us to take a few photos in the front courtyard.

The Yang family became officials, so they began to build a mansion; even in the Jiachen year of Guangxu reign of the late Qing (1904), this custom had not changed.

The residence faces south from the north, with three courtyards front and back, quite deep and secluded, but the building scale is not large; the halls are all three bays wide, with a row of side wings on each of the east and west sides.

On the stone door frame of the gate tower is engraved "Gate and Courtyard Gloriously Distinguished." After entering, the front courtyard is spacious, with exquisite paving.

Above the front hall gate is inlaid a stone plaque "Dafu Di" (Grand Master's Residence).

The deeper second-courtyard main hall is "Shuzhi Hall" (Hall of Stating Aspirations), and the third courtyard is a Western-style two-story building "Kaixin Building" (Happy Building), also known as the Dressing Building.

There are also a study, warm pavilion, guest rooms, warehouse, garden, fish pond, rockery, arch bridge, monkey cave, etc.

Looking at the front hall and left and right side gates from the front courtyard open to us, one strongly feels the Yang family's willingness to spare no expense; the construction leaves no blank space, full of decorations, using many modern materials such as ceramic tiles and enamel bricks; however, because the stone colors are relatively unified, it does not feel overly gaudy from a distance.

推荐级别：★★★

镇海卫

No.276
Zhenhai Garrison
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳州龙海市隆教畲族乡镇海村
类型：城防设施
特征标签 Highlights
遗址石构造做法痕迹镇海卫古城不仅临海而且坐落在一片突出入海的山地上北边是南太武山南边是汇入大海的鸿儒江而东南方向旗尾山与台湾浊溪口的连线就是东海南海的交界线一提其名就给人大气磅礴的感觉镇海卫明洪武年始置洪武二十年1387年筑城次年建卫周围2910米高7.3米垣面广4.3米女墙1660垛窝铺20间垛口720个辟东西南北四门另开一水门所谓各有城墙城下倾陡以海为壕
中文 Chinese

镇海卫古城不仅临海，而且坐落在一片突出入海的山地上。北边是南太武山，南边是汇入大海的鸿儒江，而东南方向，旗尾山与台湾浊溪口的连线就是东海、南海的交界线。一提其名，就给人大气磅礴的感觉。镇海卫明洪武年始置。洪武二十年（1387年）筑城，次年建卫。

周围2910米，高7.3米，垣面广4.3米，女墙1660垛，窝铺20间，垛口720个，辟东、西、南、北四门，另开一水门，所谓"各有城墙，城下倾陡，以海为壕"；设卫指挥使司及前、后、左、中、右五个千户所，六鳌、铜山、悬钟三守卫所各千户属；成化年间改属漳州卫；明正统十三年（1448年），指挥同知桂福修城建卫堂，建置渐齐备；明弘治年间，指挥使袁信重修卫城；嘉靖三年（1524年），建镇海卫文庙；嘉靖四十年（1561年），饶平叛寇张琏从卫城水门潜入陷城；隆庆三年（1569年），总兵张元勋对卫城重加修治；清顺治十八年（1661年）迁界，卫城渐废；清康熙六年（1667）裁卫；康熙五十七年（1718年），漳浦知县汪绅文修城，添设炮台；乾隆二年（1737年）、五年（1740年）又两次修城。

《镇海卫志》载，卫城内原有坊表十余座，建有卫指挥署和各千户署，配以东岳庙、关帝庙、天后宫、神祖庙、文公祠等祀，建制十分完备。几经沉浮的历史，令镇海卫浸透了沧桑。古城原有四门和水门，均有城楼，如今仅城台依然，水道可寻。城门的拱门和墙体都是花岗岩条石垒砌，虽杂草丛生但依然稳固。

南门瓮城之内，尚保留有"父子承恩"石坊；城内古街失修，却依稀正是古老时代的面貌；明天启二年（1622年）建造的"福德祠"小石屋和文庙遗址朴素而深沉，城隍庙、东岳庙等公共建筑虽经重修，庙内石作仍古朴非凡，义学碑、昭毅将军碑、七星井、椰树井、象乳泉等古迹，似乎只是在提醒你，细心的人或许能够发现更多古人想告诉我们的东西。

English

The ancient city of Zhenhai Garrison not only faces the sea but also sits on a mountainous land protruding into the sea.

To the north is South Taiwu Mountain, to the south is the Hongru River flowing into the sea, and in the southeast direction, the line connecting Qiwei Mountain and the mouth of the Zhuoxi River in Taiwan is the boundary between the East China Sea and the South China Sea.

Just mentioning its name gives one a feeling of grandeur and momentum.Zhenhai Garrison was first established during the Hongwu reign of the Ming.

In the 20th year of Hongwu (1387), the city was built, and the garrison was established the following year.The circumference is 2,910 meters, height 7.3 meters, wall top width 4.

3 meters, with 1,660 merlons on the parapet, 20 guard rooms, 720 crenellations, opening four gates east, west, south, and north, plus one water gate, so-called "each has its own city wall, the city below is steep, using the sea as a moat"; it established a Garrison Commander's Office and five Thousand-Households of front, rear, left, center, and right, with the three garrisons of Liu'ao, Tongshan, and Xuanzhong each having their Thousand-Households under it; during the Chenghua reign it was transferred to Zhangzhou Garrison; in the 13th year of Zhengtong reign of the Ming (1448), Vice Commander Gui Fu repaired the city and built the garrison hall, with the establishment gradually becoming complete; during the Hongzhi reign of the Ming, Garrison Commander Yuan Xin rebuilt the garrison city; in the third year of Jiajing reign (1524), the Zhenhai Garrison Confucian Temple was built; in the 40th year of Jiajing reign (1561), the rebel Zhang Lian from Raoping sneaked in through the water gate of the garrison city and captured it; in the third year of Longqing reign (1569), Commander-in-Chief Zhang Yuanxun heavily repaired the garrison city; in the 18th year of Shunzhi reign of the Qing (1661), due to the relocation policy, the garrison city gradually fell into disuse; in the sixth year of Kangxi reign (1667), the garrison was abolished; in the 57th year of Kangxi reign (1718), Zhangpu County Magistrate Wang Shenwen repaired the city and added artillery batteries; in the second year (1737) and fifth year (1740) of Qianlong reign, the city was repaired twice more.

The "Zhenhai Garrison Gazetteer" records that within the garrison city there were originally more than ten memorial archways, with a Garrison Commander's Office and various Thousand-Household Offices built, equipped with Dongyue Temple, Guandi Temple, Tianhou Palace, Shenzu Temple, Wengong Shrine, etc.

, with a very complete establishment.The history of several rises and falls has made Zhenhai Garrison saturated with vicissitudes.

The ancient city originally had four gates and a water gate, all with gate towers; today only the gate platforms remain, and the water channels can still be traced.

The arched gates and walls of the city gates are all built of granite strip stones, still stable despite overgrown weeds.

Within the south gate's barbican, the "Father and Son Receiving Grace" stone archway is still preserved; the ancient streets in the city are in disrepair, but faintly retain the appearance of ancient times; the small stone house "Fude Shrine" built in the second year of Tianqi reign of the Ming (1622) and the Confucian Temple site are simple and profound; public buildings such as the City God Temple and Dongyue Temple, although repaired, still have extraordinary ancient stonework inside; ancient relics such as the Free School Stele, Zhaoyi General Stele, Seven-Star Well, Coconut Tree Well, and Elephant Milk Spring seem only to remind you that attentive people may discover more things the ancients wanted to tell us.

推荐级别：★★★★★

锦江楼

No.277
Jinjiang Building
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州市漳浦县锦东村锦江村
类型：民居
特征标签 Highlights
土楼独特的造型居住单元分配方式材料和结构独特的形式或者来自设计灵感或者来自岁月沉淀锦江楼的形式不可谓不奇特平面三环并不像普通城堡那样外高内低而是相反外环一层中环路略有三层门楼内环三层局部四层远远看去赫然昭塞尔金字塔一般的造型
中文 Chinese

独特的形式或者来自设计灵感，或者来自岁月沉淀。锦江楼的形式不可谓不奇特——平面三环，并不像普通城堡那样外高内低，而是相反。外环一层，中环路略有三层门楼，内环三层局部四层，远远看去，赫然昭塞尔金字塔一般的造型。

事实上，锦江楼令人叫绝的体型是岁月的产物，乡人称升泽于清乾隆五十六年（1791年）始建内环，随着家族人丁繁衍，清嘉庆八年（1803年），其妻李灿续建中圈，清中期后世再续建外环。

锦江楼内环直径25米，高三层，局部四层，内墙厚0.5米，首层外墙石构，正北设祖堂；以上为三合土版筑，二楼木结构内向通廊，三楼无隔间；主楼四层，可通三层楼顶，楼顶双坡顶，外墙高于屋顶，作女墙式。中环直径42米，高三层，隔为24间。

其中正南一间为门道，余三间一组，共七组，另正北二间为公厅；门上为三层门楼，双坡顶，可从门楼两边小门登上楼墙；楼顶作内向单坡顶，外墙高于楼顶0.7米，沿墙边亦设有宽0.7米的人行道，为防御而设。

外环直径58米，双坡顶平房，墙厚0.45米，隔为37间；每户有一座厅间和1至3间房间不等；楼门前留宽16米的通道，铺设三层砖埕，埕前50米处为戏台，供祭祀祖神时用。

想起当地著名的"五星三楼"——慎修楼、瑞安楼和锦江楼，唯有锦江楼保留至今，另两座都已倒塌，不觉唏嘘感叹。

English

The unique form may come from design inspiration, or from the sedimentation of years.

The form of Jinjiang Building can be said to be quite peculiar — a three-ring plan, not like ordinary castles with high outside and low inside, but the opposite.

The outer ring is one story, the middle ring slightly has a three-story gate tower, and the inner ring is three stories with partial four stories; from afar, it strikingly has the shape of the Zoser Pyramid.

In fact, the amazing body shape of Jinjiang Building is a product of the years; villagers say that Shengze first built the inner ring in the 56th year of Qianlong reign of the Qing (1791); as the family population multiplied, in the eighth year of Jiaqing reign (1803), his wife Li Can continued to build the middle ring, and later generations in the mid-Qing continued to build the outer ring.

The inner ring of Jinjiang Building has a diameter of 25 meters, is three stories high with partial four stories, with inner walls 0.

5 meters thick; the first floor outer wall is of stone structure, with an ancestral hall set in the north; above is rammed earth of three-in-one soil; the second floor has an inward-facing corridor of timber structure, and the third floor has no partitions; the main building is four stories, with access to the third-floor roof; the roof has a double-slope top, with the outer wall higher than the roof, in a parapet style.

The middle ring has a diameter of 42 meters, is three stories high, divided into 24 rooms.

Among them, the room directly south is the entrance passage, the remaining rooms are in groups of three, totaling seven groups, with another two rooms directly north as a public hall; above the gate is a three-story gate tower with a double-slope roof, allowing access to the building wall from small doors on both sides of the gate tower; the roof has an inward single-slope top, with the outer wall 0.

7 meters higher than the roof, and a 0.7-meter-wide walkway along the wall edge, set for defense.The outer ring has a diameter of 58 meters, single-story houses with double-slope roofs, walls 0.

45 meters thick, divided into 37 rooms; each household has one hall room and 1 to 3 rooms不等; a 16-meter-wide passage is left in front of the building gate, paved with three layers of brick courtyard, and 50 meters in front of the courtyard is a stage, used for sacrificing to ancestral deities.

Thinking of the famous local "Five Stars Three Buildings" — Shenxiu Building, Rui'an Building, and Jinjiang Building — only Jinjiang Building has been preserved to this day, while the other two have both collapsed, one cannot help but sigh with emotion.

推荐级别：★★★★★

蓝氏宗祠

No.278
Ancestral Temple Complex for Lan's Clan
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州漳浦县赤岭石椅村
类型：礼制建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
凭吊记得漳州新华东路的勇壮简易坊吗那就是为了纪念清代早期平定台湾的畲族大将蓝理的当时康熙帝于四十二年四十五年先后御书两匾赐之勇壮简易之外还有所向无前后者就悬挂在老家漳浦赤岭石椅村蓝氏宗祠的种玉堂中祠堂中当然也少不了蓝理氏弟平台大将军蓝廷珍和廷珍之子蓝鼎元的位置碑刻记载祠堂始建于明嘉靖二年1523年至清康熙三十四年1695年蓝家因蓝理而兴祠堂得以重修
中文 Chinese

记得漳州新华东路的"勇壮简易坊"吗？那就是为了纪念清代早期平定台湾的畲族大将蓝理的。当时康熙帝于四十二年、四十五年先后御书两匾赐之"勇壮简易"之外，还有"所向无前"。后者就悬挂在老家漳浦赤岭石椅村蓝氏宗祠的种玉堂中。祠堂中当然也少不了蓝理氏弟"平台大将军"蓝廷珍和廷珍之子蓝鼎元的位置。

碑刻记载，祠堂始建于明嘉靖二年（1523年），至清康熙三十四年（1695年）蓝家因蓝理而兴，祠堂得以重修。建筑群朝向偏西南，祠堂前有大埕，立旗杆石二组，埕前原有七星潭。

主体部分仅一进院落，单体建筑包括门厅、正堂及两边耳房，其中门厅左侧墙上嵌康熙三十四年"重修祖庙碑记"，记述了蓝理重修种玉堂的事迹。正堂五间，屋顶做三段处理。木结构之外，花岗石圆柱、鼓形柱础、石门鼓等石作是最值得端详的作品。祠堂之后还有小石山及象征日月的两座水潭。

English

Remember the "Yongzhuang Jianyi" (Brave, Strong, Simple, Easy) Archway on Xinhua East Road in Zhangzhou?

That was to commemorate Lan Li, the She ethnic general who pacified Taiwan in the early Qing Dynasty.

At that time, the Kangxi Emperor successively bestowed two plaques in his own calligraphy in the 42nd and 45th years; besides "Yongzhuang Jianyi," there was also "Suo Xiang Wu Qian" (Invincible Wherever He Goes).

The latter hangs in the Zhongyu Hall of the Lan Clan Ancestral Temple in Shiyi Village, Chiling, Zhangpu, his hometown.

Of course, the ancestral temple also cannot be without the positions of Lan Li's younger brother, the "Pacifying-Taiwan Grand General" Lan Tingzhen, and Tingzhen's son Lan Dingyuan.

Stone inscriptions record that the ancestral temple was first built in the second year of Jiajing reign of the Ming (1523); by the 34th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1695), the Lan family prospered because of Lan Li, and the ancestral temple was repaired.

The building complex faces slightly southwest, with a large courtyard in front of the ancestral temple, two groups of flagpole stones erected, and originally a Seven-Star Pond in front of the courtyard.

The main part is only one courtyard, with individual buildings including the gate hall, main hall, and side rooms on both sides; among them, on the left wall of the gate hall is embedded the "Record of Repairing the Ancestral Temple" from the 34th year of Kangxi, recounting Lan Li's deeds in repairing Zhongyu Hall.

The main hall is five bays, with the roof treated in three sections.

Besides the timber structure, stone works such as granite cylindrical columns, drum-shaped column bases, and stone door drums are the works most worth examining carefully.

Behind the ancestral temple there are also small stone hills and two water ponds symbolizing the sun and moon.

推荐级别：★★

蓝廷珍府第

No.279
Residence of Lan Tingzhen
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：福建省漳浦县湖西畲族乡顶坛村
类型：民居建筑
特征标签 Highlights
院楼搭配木作石作蓝廷珍蓝日宠蓝元枚一家三代都是清朝身居要职的军事将领这在漳浦当地畲族子弟中是非常罕见的这样的家族会修造什么样的府邸呢会是宁德半月里观音亭寨一样的样子还是那种更加朴素的黑黑的大屋原来蓝府当时也是潮流的跟随者采用了闽南地区常见的院落布局不过新颖之处在于院中还加建土楼了
中文 Chinese

蓝廷珍、蓝日宠、蓝元枚一家三代都是清朝身居要职的军事将领，这在漳浦当地畲族子弟中是非常罕见的。这样的家族会修造什么样的府邸呢？会是宁德半月里、观音亭寨一样的样子？还是那种更加朴素的黑黑的大屋？

原来蓝府当时也是潮流的跟随者，采用了闽南地区常见的院落布局，不过新颖之处在于院中还加建土楼了。府第大致始建于康熙末年，落成于雍正五年（1727年），其后未再扩建和大规模维修。府第建筑群坐西朝东，前有宽广大埕场，条石铺砌。

沿中轴线有主要建筑门厅、正堂、后堂、主楼与后罩房，左右两侧有护厝，四周建筑封闭性很强，有院城之称。如果说附近的赵家堡、诒安堡可称为"老城"，这里便是"新城"。府第大门面阔五开间带左右耳房，金柱上安门扇，左右抱鼓高大而浮雕精美，斗拱曲额雕刻细腻。

门内不设屏风，通视天井及正堂。正堂五间，硬山顶，空间开敞，前有卷棚檐廊，斗拱和花饰雕刻技巧超群，后设屏风。正堂两侧漏窗花墙分隔解决了公共功能与私密空间之间的冲突。后堂供奉神佛、祭祀祖宗。后堂两侧敞廊和正堂的后廊连成一气，形成全宅最大的室内空间。

后堂之后有一座木构土石为墙的两层"日接楼"，是主人的卧房。楼的木结构毁于20世纪40年代的火灾，土石墙体尤存，墙上木构件痕迹依然。此楼平面九间，左右隔间各作"田"字形，中间为厅，厅后设梯。楼墙底层系方整条石砌筑，上层系三合土夯筑。整座土楼只有一个大门，窗户疏朗而狭小，石框石棂。

第五落是后罩房，当敞厅，两端设后门，再侧单元连接，用作族人卧房。左右护厝则是附属用房。暑气渐收的季节，品尝着湖西的龙眼，远远地、静静地端详昔日人声起伏的大宅中，别有一番情调。

English

Lan Tingzhen, Lan Richong, and Lan Yuanmei — three generations of one family — were all military generals holding important positions in the Qing Dynasty, which is very rare among the She ethnic youth in Zhangpu.

What kind of mansion would such a family build?Would it be like Banyueli or Guanyin Tingzhai in Ningde?Or the plainer, dark black large houses?

It turns out that the Lan mansion was also a follower of trends at the time, adopting the courtyard layout common in the Minnan region, but the novelty was that a tulou (earthen building) was also added in the courtyard.

The mansion was roughly built in the late Kangxi reign and completed in the fifth year of Yongzheng reign (1727), after which it was no longer expanded or underwent large-scale repairs.

The mansion building complex faces east from the west, with a wide large courtyard in front, paved with strip stones.

Along the central axis are the main buildings: gate hall, main hall, rear hall, main building, and rear wing rooms, with side wings on the left and right; the surrounding buildings are highly enclosed, known as a "courtyard city.

" If the nearby Zhaojiabao and Yi'an Fort can be called the "old city," this is the "new city.

" The mansion gate is five bays wide with left and right side rooms, with door leaves installed on the golden columns; the left and right drum stones are tall with exquisite relief carvings, and the dougong and curved lintels are delicately carved.

No screen is set inside the gate, allowing a view through to the courtyard and main hall.

The main hall is five bays, with a gable roof (yingshan), open space, with a curved-roof eave corridor in front, dougong and floral ornament carvings of superb skill, and a screen set at the rear.

The lattice window and flower wall partitions on both sides of the main hall resolve the conflict between public functions and private space.

The rear hall enshrines deities and Buddhas and sacrifices to ancestors.

The open corridors on both sides of the rear hall and the rear corridor of the main hall connect together, forming the largest indoor space in the entire residence.

Behind the rear hall is a two-story "Rijie Building" with timber structure and earth-stone walls, the master's bedroom.

The timber structure of the building was destroyed in a fire in the 1940s, but the earth-stone walls still remain, with traces of timber components on the walls still visible.

This building has a plan of nine bays, with the left and right compartments each in a "tian" (field) shape, the center as a hall, with a staircase behind the hall.

The bottom layer of the building wall is built of square strip stones, and the upper layer is rammed with three-in-one soil.

The entire tulou has only one main gate, with sparse and narrow windows, stone frames and stone lattice.

The fifth section is the rear wing rooms, serving as an open hall, with rear doors at both ends, connected to side units, used as clan members' bedrooms.

The left and right side wings are auxiliary rooms.

In the season when the summer heat gradually recedes, tasting the longans of Huxi, gazing from afar and quietly at the former large mansion with rising and falling human voices, there is a special charm.

推荐级别：★★★★

六鳌城

No.280
Liu'ao Fort
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳州漳浦县六鳌镇
类型：城防设施
特征标签 Highlights
遗址石构造做法痕迹六鳌半岛狭长地伸入海中北边沙滩狭长地连接着大陆六鳌城则在半岛末端山腰上一围从容地瞭望并扼控着海湾今天的城已是一座空城一切在蛰伏之中只有榕树在恣意生长好像热带雨林中的吴哥窟要是根除了大树石构也会散落一地的样子自从元朝这里就建有小城当为沿海防御倭患海寇所设
中文 Chinese

六鳌半岛狭长地伸入海中，北边沙滩狭长地连接着大陆。六鳌城则在半岛末端山腰上一围，从容地瞭望并扼控着海湾。今天的城已是一座空城，一切在蛰伏之中，只有榕树在恣意生长。好像热带雨林中的吴哥窟，要是根除了大树，石构也会散落一地的样子。自从元朝这里就建有小城，当为沿海防御倭患、海寇所设。

明洪武二十年（1387年），周德兴大规模扩建；清初迁界，城被部分拆除；复界后重修，设水师；20世纪80年代后，城中居民迁出。这是一座官军建造的城堡，城墙、城门、水门以及城中的配套设施建设反映了明初城池建造工艺特点，材料则因地制宜。

全城平面略呈三角形，周长1930米；城墙厚2米至3米，全部采用长约0.6米至0.9米、厚0.3米的长条石砌筑。

城墙随山势起伏，或直接借助天然岩石，一些地方墙内侧与路面同高；南、西南、北三面建城门，城门石构券顶，原曾建有城楼；西南门外建瓮城，立石坊，南门两边马面三座，内侧作藏兵洞；全城水门五座；城中青山之中建有观察台、兵营，城北门外为校场。

城外有关帝庙，城内有妈祖庙，均明代所成。军事城堡中的民居有严格的规划，等级制度和标准化特点森严。

English

The Liu'ao Peninsula extends narrowly into the sea, with a narrow beach on the north connecting to the mainland.

Liu'ao Fort encircles the mountainside at the end of the peninsula, calmly observing and controlling the bay.

Today the fort is already an empty city, everything in dormancy, with only banyan trees growing wantonly.

Like Angkor Wat in a tropical rainforest, if the large trees were eradicated, the stone structures would also scatter to the ground.

Since the Yuan Dynasty, a small city had been built here, presumably established for coastal defense against Japanese pirates and sea bandits.

In the 20th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1387), Zhou Dexing carried out large-scale expansion; during the early Qing relocation policy, the city was partially demolished; after the relocation was lifted, it was repaired and a navy was established; after the 1980s, residents in the city moved out.

This is a castle built by official troops; the city walls, gates, water gates, and the construction of supporting facilities in the city reflect the characteristics of early Ming city-building craftsmanship, with materials adapted to local conditions.

The entire city plan is slightly triangular, with a circumference of 1,930 meters; the city walls are 2 to 3 meters thick, all built with long strip stones about 0.6 to 0.9 meters long and 0.

3 meters thick.

The city walls rise and fall with the mountain terrain, or directly use natural rock; in some places the inner side of the wall is level with the road surface; city gates are built on the south, southwest, and north sides, with stone arched tops, originally having gate towers; a barbican was built outside the southwest gate, with a stone archway erected, three horse-face towers on both sides of the south gate, with soldier-hiding caves on the inner side; the entire city has five water gates; observation platforms and barracks were built among the green hills in the city, and outside the north gate was a parade ground.

Outside the city there is a Guandi Temple, and inside the city there is a Mazu Temple, both built in the Ming Dynasty.

The vernacular dwellings in the military fortress have strict planning, with strict hierarchy and standardization characteristics.

推荐级别：★★★★

明诚堂

No.281
Mingchengtang Academy
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳州市漳浦县城东郊石斋村
类型：文教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
天方盘凭吊福建人文悠久至今备受推崇的除了南宋朱熹及其门徒之外明末不贰忠臣漳浦人黄道周1585至1646年就是那位写下纲常万古节义千秋的夫子也是一座丰碑明诚堂即黄道周故居和讲学的东皋书舍在明亡之后修建命名之所1646年黄道周殉国后南明隆武帝赐表文明书院今天这里顺理成章地成为了黄道周纪念馆书舍始建于黄道周迁居至此的明万历三十七年1609年风雨飘摇三十几年之后大明帝国轰然倒塌先生欲于闽中力挽狂澜所以要明诚
中文 Chinese

福建人文悠久，至今备受推崇的除了南宋朱熹及其门徒之外，明末不贰忠臣漳浦人黄道周（1585—1646年），就是那位写下"纲常万古，节义千秋"的夫子，也是一座丰碑。

明诚堂，即黄道周故居和讲学的东皋书舍在明亡之后修建、命名之所，1646年黄道周殉国后，南明隆武帝赐表"文明书院"。今天这里顺理成章地成为了黄道周纪念馆。

书舍始建于黄道周迁居至此的明万历三十七年（1609年）。风雨飘摇三十几年之后，大明帝国轰然倒塌，先生欲于闽中力挽狂澜，所以要"明诚"。先生殉国后，居然此地得到清廷的保护，每年春秋致祭。

纪念馆规模很小，主体部分只一进院子。建筑也异常朴素，虽有斗拱，但了无雕镂。建筑群面南而建，周围一圈围墙，于东南面开前门，是当地常见的门座样式。主体部分门厅和正堂都是面阔五间，也按当地常见的做法把梢间做得比次间更宽。

门厅后廊与院内廊庑相连，正堂则进深三间，前进深做檐廊式内有卷棚轩顶。最为独特的是天井部分。天井虽不大，中间摆一石盘，称天方盘，作为建筑群的核心。

天方盘正方形，边长4米，盘面刻一万多个小方格和八个同心圆，方格和圆圈纵横交错，是黄道周手制演绎易经用的。先生有专著《易象正》、《三易洞玑》，但至今无人能参透其中奥妙。

English

Fujian has a long humanistic tradition; besides Zhu Xi of the Southern Song and his disciples, who are still highly revered today, Huang Daozhou (1585–1646), the unwavering loyal minister of the late Ming from Zhangpu — the master who wrote "Confucian ethics endure for ten thousand years, integrity and righteousness last for a thousand autumns" — is also a monument.

Mingchengtang, namely the former residence of Huang Daozhou and the Donggao Study where he lectured, was the place built and named after the fall of the Ming; after Huang Daozhou died for his country in 1646, the Longwu Emperor of the Southern Ming bestowed the title "Wenming Academy.

" Today this place naturally became the Huang Daozhou Memorial Hall.The study was first built in the 37th year of Wanli reign of the Ming (1609), when Huang Daozhou moved here.

After more than thirty years of precarious times, the Ming Empire collapsed with a crash; the master wished to turn the tide in central Fujian, hence the name "Mingcheng" (Clarity and Sincerity).

After the master died for his country, this place unexpectedly received protection from the Qing court, with sacrifices held every spring and autumn.

The memorial hall is very small in scale, with the main part only one courtyard.The architecture is also exceptionally plain; although there are dougong, there is no carving at all.

The building complex faces south, surrounded by a wall, with the front gate opened on the southeast side, a common gate-seat style in the area.

The main parts, the gate hall and main hall, are both five bays wide, also following the common local practice of making the end bays wider than the secondary bays.

The rear corridor of the gate hall connects with the corridors in the courtyard, while the main hall is three bays deep, with the front depth made as an eave-corridor style with a curved-roof ceiling inside.

The most unique part is the courtyard.

Although the courtyard is not large, a stone plate is placed in the center, called the Tianfang Plate (Heaven-Square Plate), serving as the core of the building complex.

The Tianfang Plate is square, 4 meters on each side, with more than ten thousand small squares and eight concentric circles carved on its surface; the squares and circles crisscross, made by Huang Daozhou's own hand for deducing the I Ching.

The master has monographs "Correct Images of Change" and "Three Changes Subtle Mechanism," but to this day no one can fully comprehend their mysteries.

推荐级别：★★★

文庙大成殿

No.282
Hall of Great Achievement in Temple of Confucius
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明
地址：漳州市绥安镇后沟巷
类型：宗教建筑·木结构
特征标签 Highlights
格局木结构彩画遗存为什么寻找一座省级文物保护单位会如此不易过去的年头里文庙难道不是一方胜地更是一方圣地的吗或许是马上就会得到维修的缘故我们需要钻过一扇窗方才进得漳浦文庙的院内杂草掩盖着散落的石构件大木构件互相搀扶着站立在我们眼前
中文 Chinese

为什么寻找一座省级文物保护单位会如此不易？过去的年头里文庙难道不是一方胜地更是一方圣地的吗？或许是马上就会得到维修的缘故，我们需要钻过一扇窗，方才进得漳浦文庙的院内。杂草掩盖着散落的石构件，大木构件互相搀扶着站立在我们眼前。

那是补间铺作的真下昂，交互斗下的花板，柱头铺作栌斗下出挑的华拱，截面向前的各类斗子，造型缓和的平梁和劄牵……翼角在转交铺作的支撑下骄傲地昂着头，努力地保持着生命的姿态。是相信马上就会得到维修的缘故，已经不会流泪的我详细地拍摄了无数张照片。原因你懂的。

English

Why is it so difficult to find a provincial-level cultural heritage protection unit?In past years, wasn't a Confucian Temple not only a scenic spot but even more a sacred place?

Perhaps because it will soon be repaired, we needed to crawl through a window before we could enter the courtyard of Zhangpu Confucian Temple.

Weeds cover the scattered stone components, and the large timber components stand before our eyes, supporting each other.

Those are the true lower ang of the intermediate bracket sets, the patterned boards under the interactive dou, the hua-gong protruding from under the cap block of the column-top bracket sets, the various dou blocks with cross-sections facing forward, the gently shaped flat beams and tie beams.

..The wing corners proudly hold their heads high under the support of the corner bracket sets, striving to maintain the posture of life.

Believing that it will soon be repaired, I, who no longer shed tears, took countless detailed photographs.You know the reason.

推荐级别：★★★★★

诒安堡

No.283
Yi'an Fort
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州市漳浦县湖西乡城内村
类型：城防·民居
特征标签 Highlights
堡墙设计土石工艺诒安堡也叫作诒安城是一座边缘并不规整像一把大锁一样的城城是清初佐助朝廷收复台湾的一品功臣黄性震1638至1702年于康熙二十六年1687年建造的城堡一圈设南东西3个城门以诒安迎曦毓秀为名南门至西门前有10米宽护城河
中文 Chinese

诒安堡也叫作诒安城，是一座边缘并不规整、像一把大锁一样的城。城是清初佐助朝廷收复台湾的一品功臣黄性震（1638—1702年）于康熙二十六年（1687年）建造的。城堡一圈设南、东、西3个城门，以诒安、迎曦、毓秀为名。南门至西门前有10米宽护城河。

城墙周长1200米，高6.7米，厚2.2米，用条石筑成马道，马道外侧建2米高的女墙，365个垛口合周年天数。城内每隔50米设登城石阶，转角处设敌楼，用于瞭望和射击。

诒安堡内至今还居住着黄氏后裔，内部的居住单元接近军事化营盘，一排10间，一共95排的民房，每排之间有8米宽的石板街，排水设施完备。更有土楼一座，日久残颓，仅余土壁。

堡中必不可少的还有黄氏宗祠，祠前旗杆高耸，石埕宽阔，并拓一汪半月池塘，是民众的公共空间。诒安堡的名声及其在建筑史上的地位丝毫不必借助黄性震的历史功绩，而黄性震的平台功勋难道不是时代大势之下的小波澜吗？

English

Yi'an Fort is also called Yi'an City, a city with irregular edges, shaped like a large lock.

The city was built in the 26th year of Kangxi reign of the Qing (1687) by Huang Xingzhen (1638–1702), a first-rank merit official who assisted the court in recovering Taiwan in the early Qing.

The castle has three city gates on the south, east, and west, named Yi'an (Bequeathing Peace), Yingxi (Greeting the Morning Sun), and Yuxiu (Nurturing Excellence).

There is a 10-meter-wide moat from the south gate to the west gate.The city wall has a circumference of 1,200 meters, is 6.7 meters high and 2.

2 meters thick, with a horse path built of strip stones, and a 2-meter-high parapet on the outside of the horse path, with 365 crenellations matching the number of days in a year.

Every 50 meters inside the city there are stone steps for climbing the wall, and watchtowers are set at the corners for observation and shooting.

Descendants of the Huang clan still live in Yi'an Fort today; the internal residential units are close to a military camp, with 10 rooms in a row, a total of 95 rows of houses, and an 8-meter-wide stone street between each row, with complete drainage facilities.

There is also a tulou (earthen building), which has long been dilapidated, with only earthen walls remaining.

Indispensable in the fort is also the Huang Clan Ancestral Temple, with tall flagpoles in front, a wide stone courtyard, and a half-moon pond dug out, a public space for the people.

The reputation of Yi'an Fort and its position in architectural history need not rely at all on the historical merits of Huang Xingzhen; and isn't Huang Xingzhen's merit in pacifying Taiwan just a small wave under the general trend of the times?

推荐级别：★★★★

赵家堡

No.284
Zhao's Family Fort
级别：全国重点文物保护单位
年代：清
地址：漳州漳浦县湖西乡硕高山西北麓
类型：城防·民居
特征标签 Highlights
堡墙设计土楼设计园林设计赵家堡是诒安堡的姊妹城赵家堡是姐姐姊妹之间只有十分钟的车程不过赵家堡的身世要显赫得多是曾经改姓避祸的南宋皇族硕高筑堡记中说得清楚余祖宋闽冲郡王决意卜庐入山楼建于万历庚子1600年之冬堡建于甲辰1604年之夏
中文 Chinese

赵家堡是诒安堡的姊妹城，赵家堡是姐姐，姊妹之间只有十分钟的车程。不过赵家堡的身世要显赫得多，是曾经改姓避祸的南宋皇族。

《硕高筑堡记》中说得清楚，"余祖宋闽冲郡王……决意卜庐入山……楼建于万历庚子（1600年）之冬，堡建于甲辰（1604年）之夏……"，这个皇室后裔聚居之所的创始人就是此文的作者，隆庆五年进士，赵范。

城堡因山就势，方圆随形，辟四门，门上建城楼，北门筑瓮城为正门。石砌城墙，坚实厚重，厚达2.5米，高3米至4米，墙上垛口高约1.5米。沿墙建马面6座，并有墩台、藏兵洞之设。

城内东侧更有内城，内有赵范所谓之"楼"，是一座3层的方土楼"完璧楼"，意思是不用隐姓埋名，终归赵家。还有一座三合院，平时并不住人。

土楼的台基用以花岗岩条石纵横砌筑，墙体以三合土夯筑，高20米，周长88米。首层有房10间，二层9间，三层通廊。楼底有地道通往城外。

至于赵范所谓"堡"的部分，则由公共性的广场、关帝庙、石坊、戏台，以及先后建造的大型和小型住宅院落和园林组成。宅院俗称"官厅"，规模井然。园林中更有书院，桥、亭、塔、山石、水面、绿植互为映衬，山林野趣、文人气息并重。

English

Zhaojiabao is the sister city of Yi'an Fort, with Zhaojiabao being the elder sister, only a ten-minute drive between the sisters.

However, Zhaojiabao's origins are far more illustrious — it was the Southern Song imperial family who once changed their surname to avoid disaster.

The "Record of Building the Fort at Shuogao" clearly states: "My ancestor, the Prince of Minchong of the Song...resolved to choose a dwelling in the mountains...

the building was built in the winter of Wanli Gengzi (1600), and the fort in the summer of Jiachen (1604)...

" The founder of this place where imperial descendants gathered was the author of this text, Zhao Fan, a jinshi of the fifth year of Longqing reign.
