destroyed by bandits in the fourth year of Tongzhi reign, and rebuilt as Wenchang Temple on the old site in the tenth year" clearly explains this historical process.

Fortunately, today's alignment appropriately demonstrates the Chinese emphasis on literary fortune and excellence in learning.

Perhaps we can also say that today we have converted Zhao'an Wenchang Temple into the Zhao'an County Museum, as a further annotation of history.

The existing appearance of the Wenchang Temple building was finalized by the renovation in the tenth year of Tongzhi reign (1871), with later maintenance in 1991.

The main courtyard of Wenchang Temple has two sections, with a temple courtyard in front; along the central axis are sequentially the gate tower, worship pavilion, main hall, and rear building, with the courtyard enclosed by corridors on both sides.

The gate tower has three overlapping eaves, with its width divided into five bays by columns below, forming a form between a memorial archway and a gate base, quite distinctive of the local style; the main hall has a single-eave hip-and-gable roof, three bays wide and thirteen purlins deep, enshrining the Wenchang Emperor (God of Literature) moved from the Wenchang Shrine in the Confucian Temple by County Magistrate Luo Yunduan during the Tongzhi period; the rear building is two stories, three bays wide and eleven purlins deep, enshrining Kuixing (the God of Examinations).

推荐级别：★★★

悬钟千户所城墙

No.310
City Wall of Xuanzhong Thousand-household Bureau of Defense
级别：省级文物保护单位
年代：明—清
地址：漳州诏安县梅岭镇南门村
类型：城防设施
特征标签 Highlights
城墙和关帝庙石构造做法痕迹诏安的防御设施早于县城的设立针对的是倭寇和海寇悬钟千户是明初最基本的军事组织制度主官为正五品嘉靖间俞大猷戚继光曾屯兵于此抗倭悬钟城在诏安湾据民国诏安县志记载明洪武二十年江夏侯周德兴奉诏建置周长五百五十丈砌以条石垣面广一丈高二丈女墙八百六十一窝铺一十五东西南北四门上各有楼其东西二门阻海北门通路南门塞之环海为壕隆庆六年1572年重修与龙海镇海卫城漳浦六鳌城古雷城东山铜山城等构成一道漳州沿海防御城堡
中文 Chinese

诏安的防御设施早于县城的设立，针对的是倭寇和海寇。悬钟千户是明初最基本的军事组织制度，主官为正五品。嘉靖间俞大猷、戚继光曾屯兵于此抗倭。

悬钟城在诏安湾，据民国《诏安县志》记载，"明洪武二十年，江夏侯周德兴奉诏建置，周长五百五十丈，砌以条石，垣面广一丈，高二丈，女墙八百六十一，窝铺一十五，东西南北四门上各有楼，其东西二门阻海，北门通路，南门塞之，环海为壕……"，隆庆六年（1572年）重修，与龙海镇海卫城、漳浦六鳌城、古雷城，东山铜山城等构成一道漳州沿海防御城堡。

与其他城堡命运相近，清顺治十八年（1661年）迁界后城废，康熙五十八年（1717年）再度重修。城依山临海而建，遥对南门村东南海边小山上嘉靖五年（1526年）的望洋台。

古城现尚存东南西三门，东门设瓮城，分为内外城门，外城仅存城墙，内城门保存完好。在悬钟城西门果老山下保存始建于明洪武十一年（1378年）的关帝庙一座，庙内有门楼、拜亭、正殿等建筑。

庙后果老山上更有30多处明代隆庆、万历年间戍城将官所题的摩崖石刻，被当地人排在漳州市东的云洞岩之后，称为"漳州第二碑林"，是边防制度和风俗的珍贵史料。

English

Zhao'an's defense facilities predate the establishment of the county seat, targeting Japanese pirates and sea bandits.

Xuanzhong Thousand-Household was the most basic military organizational system in the early Ming Dynasty, with the commanding officer holding the fifth rank.

During the Jiajing reign, Yu Dayou and Qi Jiguang once stationed troops here to resist Japanese pirates.

Xuanzhong City is in Zhao'an Bay; according to the Republican-era "Zhao'an County Gazetteer," "in the 20th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming, Zhou Dexing, Marquis of Jiangxia, was ordered by imperial edict to build it, with a circumference of 550 zhang, built with strip stones, the wall surface one zhang wide and two zhang high, with 861 parapets and 15 guard posts, with towers above each of the four gates east, west, south, and north; its east and west gates are blocked by the sea, the north gate has a passage, the south gate is sealed, with the sea surrounding it as a moat.

..

" It was repaired in the sixth year of Longqing reign (1572), and together with Longhai Zhenhai Guard City, Zhangpu Liu'ao City, Gulei City, and Dongshan Tongshan City, formed a line of defensive castles along the Zhangzhou coast.

Similar to the fate of other castles, after the territory relocation in the 18th year of Shunzhi reign of the Qing (1661), the city was abandoned, and rebuilt again in the 58th year of Kangxi reign (1717).

The city was built against the mountain and facing the sea, facing the Wangyang Terrace from the fifth year of Jiajing reign (1526) on a small hill by the sea southeast of Nanmen Village.

The ancient city now still retains the east, south, and west gates; the east gate has a barbican, divided into inner and outer city gates, with only the city wall remaining of the outer city, and the inner city gate well preserved.

Under Guolao Mountain at the west gate of Xuanzhong City, a Guandi Temple first built in the 11th year of Hongwu reign of the Ming (1378) is preserved, with buildings such as a gate tower, worship pavilion, and main hall inside the temple.

Behind the temple on Guolao Mountain there are more than 30 cliff inscriptions by city-defending generals during the Longqing and Wanli reigns of the Ming, ranked by locals after Yundongyan in eastern Zhangzhou City, called the "Second Stele Forest of Zhangzhou," precious historical material for the border defense system and customs.
